articleTitle: AI-Enhanced 5G Networks: Machine Learning Approaches for Network Management
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper explores how applying machine learning techniques can aid the optimization of the 5G network’s operations. It is summarized that the primary goals are to achieve higher efficiency, overcome long reaction times, and increase precise accuracy in network management jobs. Significant progress was made using three separate machine learning models: The machine learning techniques used for load balancing are reinforcement learning, energy-saving options are regression models, and for handover management are decision trees. The above analysis indicated that the developed ML models improved operational efficiency by a median of 92% against the initial 78% of conventional methods while bringing the reaction time to 50 milliseconds from a higher area of 120 milliseconds. The performance for prediction tasks was enhanced significantly; this classification task achieved up to 96 percent accuracy by a machine learning procedure and a more enhanced accuracy in contrast to the eighty-two percent precision from conventional approaches. The work employed a strict set of features: volume of traffic, signal strength, and energy consumption obtained from surfaces of a natural 5G network log. It used these for both the training and validation of the recommended models. The p-values were obtained through statistical tests, revealing that the ML procedures were superior. 05, indicating the increase in efficiency by magnitudes compared to older methodologies. Furthermore, a realistic application analysis on a metropolitan area illustrated that the formulated machine learning scheme provided concrete benefits. It decreased the network congestion rates from 30% to 10%, proving effective. Also, energy consumption was CROSSED by 30%, and operating expenses were CROSSED by 25%.

articleTitle: IDNLS: A Robust Development Of Multiple Sclerosis Segmentation And Classification Methodology Using Intelligent Deep Neural Learning Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: One of the most important ways to diagnose Multiple Sclerosis (MS) and track the disease's course is via magnetic resonance imaging. There have been some efforts to use AI to segment MS lesions, but completely automated analysis is still not accessible. This article presents an experimental investigation of the process of MS classification and segmentation using Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). Identifying the quantity of experimental lesions allows for exact tracking of lesion growth level, which in turn allows for correct assessment of pharmacological effects in medical tests, and therefore knowledge of MS lesions. Because MS lesions can change size and shape over time and aren't always easy to spot in different people's anatomy, accurately identifying them in MRI scans is an extra challenging task. An innovative deep learning technique, Intelligent Deep Neural Learning Scheme (IDNLS), was presented in this study. To test how well it performs, it was cross-validated with an existing model, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Accurate segmentation can tell you this; manually segmenting it would be a huge pain due to the high degree of expertise required and the extra time it would take. Automated lesion segmentation requires the determination of inter- and intra-expert variability. In addition, we went over the pros and cons of using AI in MS diagnosis, so that researchers and practitioners may refine their methods and make automated MS diagnoses more accurate. Some of the problems with automated multiple sclerosis diagnosis include: collecting a big enough reliable dataset; keeping patients' data private; developing ML models that are both accurate and easy to understand for those without medical training; and finally, the difficulty of differentiating MS from other diseases that present similar symptoms.

articleTitle: Design of Miniaturized and Lightweight PIF Antenna for Mobile LIDS System to Detect Unwanted Aerial Objects
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents the development and analysis of a planar inverted-F (PIF) antenna optimized for the mobile LIDS CUAS. The PIF antenna offers several advantages, like compact size, low profile, and compatibility with modern mobile communication systems. The design process involves optimizing the parameters of antenna through simulation using HFSS to achieve desired characteristics such as wide bandwidth, directional radiation pattern, and impedance matching. Further the optimized values antenna are used for the fabrication of antenna on substrate FR4 via photolithography followed by etching. The experimental and simulation results shows return loss of -12 dB which agrees with the values obtained from the simulation. The functioning of PIF antenna showcase the potential for efficient communication and signal processing within the counter-unwanted aerial system framework. The results demonstrate significant improvements in detection range and accuracy, making these antennas ideal for various applications such as surveillance, security, and communication systems within the LIDS framework.

articleTitle: Investigation of High-Capacity OAM based OCDMA-DWDM-FSO system
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Recently, free space optics has fulfilled numerous advantages over radio frequency transmission in underwater, atmospheric and deep space. Optical code division multiple access technology in dense wavelength division multiplexing offers high security, high data rate, long-reach as well as low cost transmission. Maximum 250-750m range is obtained with signal power of 51.43 to -73.65dBm, -51.64 to -73.87dBm and - 51.53 to -73.75dBm for all three codes under air and light-to-heavy rain climates. Besides, the system with signal noise ratio at input of 101.813dB offers 0.00151803 and 0.000198434W signal at input and output respectively. It offers best performance over existing ones.

articleTitle: Automated Fruit Classification Using KNN and Decision Trees for Enhanced Agricultural Efficiency and Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Industrial and agricultural use requires fruit colour, size, shape, and texture classification. Classification enhances sorting, grading, quality control, and customer satisfaction. Autoclassification is rapid and accurate, while manual classification is slow and erroneous. Premium food demand is rising. This paper proposes using KNN and DT algorithms for automated fruit classification to improve efficiency and accuracy. Kaggle provided 490 training and 166 test pineapple and coco photos. Data visualization, principal component analysis, and binary classification with KNN and DT classifiers were used. DT was 86.45% accurate, much behind KNN's 96.99%. This study found that KNN and DT algorithms improve fruit categorization accuracy and efficiency, lowering post-harvest losses, preserving product standards, and improving agricultural supply chain stakeholder decision-making. Better agricultural technology, precision agriculture, integrated systems, and sustainable practices will benefit producers and consumers.

articleTitle: Embedded System for the Detection of Breast Cancer using Edge AI
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper focuses on the most common type of cancer, Breast cancer which is growing at faster rate as people in India. There are about 1,78,000 cases in India every year. The objective of this project is to focus on a diagnostic method called thermography which uses an embedded MLX90614 Temperature Sensor array to detect breast cancer. It is identified that the particular area of the tumor show up temperature variations of (>=0.3 to <=5) degree Celsius. Data is gathered by the temperature sensor array and processed by the Arduino Nano microcontroller Board. The data collected from the temperature sensors are processed in the Arduino Nano microcontroller board and the difference in the temperature variations is used to detect the cancer cells. This system uses Naive Bayes, KNN, SVM and Logistic regression which processes the dataset containing the temperature values and gives the output for the data in the real time. The output is displayed in the blynk application. This system uses an edge AI technology and hence data can be processed at the edge with an accuracy of 94.5% giving immediate response. The system is compact for women who can periodically monitor for tumors at the comfort of their homes..

articleTitle: A High-Performance, Energy- Efficient CMOS Transmission Gate Full Adder in 45nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Continuous advancements in the realm of IC chip applications, covering rapid calculation, document transmission, large-scale storage, and micro-electromechanical systems, underscore the importance of optimizing transistor usage and operational requirements to achieve effective, durable, and intelligent integrated circuit performance. The efficient processing of broadcast signals in a timely manner demands the implementation of complex algorithms like the Fast Fourier transform, differential cosine transform, and discrete cosine transform for intricate data extraction and processing activities. The crucial function of adder logic is essential for the successful execution for these algorithms. The subsequent analysis of the simulation results of the logic circuit indicates a substantial reduction in product delays exceeding 45% for the circuit employing transmission gate- defended full adder, aligning with the primary goal of deploying high-performance rapid combination of CPUs.

articleTitle: Pixel-Level Reconstruction of Noisy Underwater Images Using Advanced Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Reconstructing noisy underwater images at the pixel level is a persistent challenge in computer vision due to changing water conditions, noise, and complex environments. Traditional methods struggle to address these challenges effectively, prompting exploration into deep learning approaches. In this study, we propose a novel Deep Progressively Learning Models (DPLMs)-based method for noisy underwater photo reconstruction. Our method harnesses deep learning to learn and reconstruct images efficiently at the pixel level, gradually refining iterations to accurately capture underlying structures. To overcome scarcity in underwater datasets, we train Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models using datasets enhanced with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), coupled with a pixel-by-pixel self-supervised training method to enhance the structural resemblance of synthetic and authentic photos. The experimental results confirm the method's usefulness and superiority, offering insights for crucial underwater vision tasks in marine engineering, pollution monitoring, fish detection, and shipwreck detection. Our proposed deep neural network architecture, incorporating winding and recurrent neural networks trained via supervised and unsupervised methods, along with advanced imaging algorithms, significantly improves underwater image reconstruction, outperforming cutting-edge techniques for both computational efficiency and optical quality.

articleTitle: Multi-class Bearing Fault Classification using Deep Learning and Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the modern age of industry 4.0 and state-of-the-art manufacturing, automated inspection plays an essential role. The bearing in the rotary machine is a vital and critical component as it provides support and stability to the rotary elements of machines. The defect in the bearing is responsible for the increase in vibrations, noise and reduction in reliability and safety of the rotating machines. It is very challenging to humanly detect different faults in these bearings. This work highlights the methods of multi-class bearing fault classification using Deep Learning (DL) and Transfer Learning (TL) models. The different DL models such as Artificial Neural Network (ANN), and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) are used along with the TL models such as VGG16 and MobileNet. The models perform with good classification accuracy ranging from 88% to 98%. The Transfer learning models perform better for both binary and multi-class fault classification of the bearings.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Lung Cancer Classification: Performance Analysis of State-of-the-Art Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Lung Cancer is one of the most fatal diseases caused by the bacteria and viruses in the alveoli. The area of biomedical research has been continuously widening and influenced by Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning (DL). In this research article, the Lung Cancer classification analysis is done using the X-ray scans of the patients. The transfer learning approach utilized for the classification includes the usage of pre-trained weights. The model is fine-tuned to address the categorical analysis of huge datasets with more than one training. The DL algorithms used for the analysis are VGG16, InceptionV3, and EfficientNetB0 for the class of Lung cancer into 4 differing types. The comparative analysis shows that the performance of EfficientNetB0 is higher as compared to the other DL models. The accuracy of the EfficientNetB0 model is 94%. The training and validation loss of the model is also lower as compared to the other DL models utilized in this research article. The correct predictions of the model made it viable to take precautions in advance and undertake a healthy lifestyle for a long sustainable life. The EfficientNetB0 model is useful for the early detection of Lung Cancer and classification analysis for the different lung cancer types for early diagnosis.

articleTitle: Detection Of Oil Spill in Satellite-Based Synthetic Aperture Radar Images by Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A combination of airborne and satellite-based remote sensing techniques is used to monitor oil spills globally. Satellite-based synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery offers a broad view of extensive ocean areas. Along with surveillance aircrafts, SAR imagery is used to accurately detect the region of oil-spillage. SAR imaging stands out for its effectiveness in detecting oil spills on a large scale, due to its all-weather capabilities and extensive scope. Neural network methodology has been utilized to identify oil spill percentage from SAR images.

articleTitle: Hyperparameter Tuning and SMOTE Utilization on a Synergistic Approach to Predicting Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Usually known by the acronym DM, or diabetes. Patients suffering from this kind of metabolic disease have problems with their blood sugar because of aberrant production and release of insulin. Your cells absorb glucose into them for energy consumption thanks to the pancreatic hormone insulin. Diabetes increases the risk of complications with the eyes, kidneys, nerves and heart. Diabetes is linked with some tumours as well. Its extensive and chronic character makes effective prediction methods essential to managing and reducing its consequences. This paper looks at applying machine learning techniques, namely Random Forest (RF), to predict diabetes. Improvement of prediction accuracy through hyperparameter tuning and class imbalance in the dataset resolution by Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) are the main goals. First, missing values are managed, data is standardised, and category variables are converted into numerical representations in a large-scale dataset. The model is improved by a thorough hyperparameter tuning process using Grid Search Cross-Validation (GridSearchCV) in order to find the optimal parameter combination. The findings demonstrate that adding hyperparameter modification greatly improves the prediction performance of the Random Forest model. In addition, SMOTE application increases the sensitivity and accuracy of the model; 95% of accuracy is anticipated following prediction. For healthcare professionals and academics, this work offers perceptive information on how well Random Forest, hyperparameter tweaking, and SMOTE may be integrated to deliver reliable diabetes prediction.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Fungal Detection In Dried Chilli: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The project aims to create an automated system for detecting fungal contamination in dried red chilies using advanced deep learning algorithms such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Visual Geometry Group (VGG16), and Residual Neural Network (ResNet). Fungal contamination poses a significant threat to the quality and safety of food products, and its early detection is crucial for ensuring consumer health and preventing economic losses in the agricultural sector. To train and evaluate the performance of the CNN, VGG, and ResNet models, the proposed system uses a dataset that includes custom images of dry red chilies, both contaminated and uncontaminated. The CNN is used to extract spatial features, whereas the VGG model is known for its depth and efficacy in image recognition tasks. The proposed system employs a dataset comprising custom images of dry red chilies, both contaminated and uncontaminated, to train and evaluate the performance of the CNN, VGG, and ResNet models. The CNN is used for its ability to extract spatial features, and the VGG model is known for its depth and effectiveness in image recognition tasks. Additionally, ResNet is employed to capture temporal dependencies in the dataset, considering the potential evolution of contamination over time. The study involves a comprehensive comparison of the output accuracy of these three algorithms, considering metric accuracy. The findings from this research contribute to the development of a robust and reliable automated system for the food industry, facilitating timely and accurate identification of fungal contamination in dry red chilies. This work aims to assist in the enhancement of food safety measures and the overall quality control processes in the agricultural and food processing sectors.

articleTitle: Scribe: A DCNN Approach for Handwritten Text Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent times, the ability to convert handwritten text into its digital counterparts has risen in importance. Traditional methods of converting handwritten documents into digital ones often involve methods such as manual typing, which is tedious, or require expensive scanning equipment. However, the emergence and growth of mobile technology have paved the way for convenient and accessible solutions. Our solution presents the design, development and implementation of a handwritten text-to-digital PDF mobile application. The proposed methodology employs a model architecture that consists of residual blocks and Bi-LSTMs (Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory), alongside a user-friendly app that provides an interface for users to capture images of their handwritten notes using their mobile’s camera, which are then processed by the model to generate the PDF documents.

articleTitle: AI-powered Lung Cancer Diagnosis: The Potential of Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The persistence of lung cancer on the global health scene necessitates the need for early and accurate techniques that may improve patient survival. Recent breakthroughs in Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) have shown potential in medical image analysis mainly used in detecting and classifying lung cancer from imaging data including clinical datasets. The current study investigates the utilization of ANN models in detecting lung cancers using datasets classified into malignant and benign. The approaches involve elaborate data preprocessing, optimizing ANN architecture with different activation functions, and incorporating dropout mechanism to reduce overfitting. Furthermore, findings indicate that optimized ANN models give high accuracy rates of up to 95% comparable to traditional machine learning techniques thus establishing their efficiency in noninvasive lung cancer detection.

articleTitle: Pose estimation from Low-Resolution Images
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Human pose estimation deals with inferring the spatial configuration of human bodies from images or videos. It is a fundamental task in computer vision engaged in the analysis of form and measurement of range of motion for the purpose of improving performance in sports, postural analysis for healthcare such as rehabilitation and improvement of postural distortion, detection of characteristic movements from images from surveillance cameras, and detection of trespassing. Most studies involving deep learning for pose estimation assume the input images are clear and of a high quality. However, we often come across old and blurred images from which application programs need to extract and estimate the pose of individuals in real life systems. This study aims to observe the effects of low image quality on pose estimation, and to explore methods that can demonstrate high accuracy even in low-quality images. A modified and fine-tuned ResNet 50 model is trained on the MPII Human Pose Dataset containing 22,246 images after lowering their resolution. Training consists providing an input image of a person and estimating the coordinates of the joint position with as little error as possible in the test. The PCKh@0.5 averages show a difference in accuracy with decreasing image quality as expected. However, the overall results demonstrate that pose estimation can be performed while maintaining a certain degree of accuracy even under low image quality.

articleTitle: Enhanced Early Detection of Diabetes Using Optimized Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Diabetes is a common long-term illness that can lead to serious health problems if it is not found and treated early on. Using a large dataset of medical and demographic factors, this study looks at how well different machine learning models can predict when someone will get diabetes. The study checks how well the Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forest and Naïve Bayes algorithms work. Naïve Bayes was the most effective classifier, beating out other models with a score of 76.62%. The Naïve Bayes model does a great job because it can handle large amounts of data and understand how different traits interact with each other. This makes it perfect for tasks like medical prediction.

articleTitle: Elevating Precision in Eucalyptus Rust Severity Classification: CNN-GNN Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Eucalyptus rust disease is a big problem in forestry. Accurate and successful ways to classify it. This new study uses a mix of two types of networks, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Graph Neural Networks (GNN), to classify eucalyptus leaf images into five categories based on how severe the rust is. A set of 7,500 high-quality pictures was carefully gathered and labeled. This collection is what the model learned from to see how good it is at doing its job. The combined mixer model did superbly with a 96.8% total accuracy rate for telling bad rust levels apart. Good checking methods, like accuracy, finding everything, and the F1 score showed that the model was reliable. Also, it gave clues on how to improve its abilities in different levels of seriousness. This study sets a new standard for classifying Eucalyptus rust disease. It also signals the start of an exciting time in precision forestry research. This will help correctly identify diseases and manage them wisely going forward.

articleTitle: Research on Multi sensor Data Fusion Algorithm Based on Distributed Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A sensor network is a network composed of a large number of distributed sensor nodes, utilised for collecting, processing, and transmitting information within the environment. Sensor nodes in sensor networks usually possess limited energy and computing power. This paper presents a multi-sensor data fusion algorithm based on distributed Kalman filtering, which offers relatively low computational complexity as each sensor is only required to update its local filter without processing data from all sensors. Experimental results demonstrate that the algorithm’s performance is comparable to that of conventional Kalman filtering algorithms. However, the distributed Kalman filtering data fusion algorithm reduces overall energy consumption by decreasing transmission energy consumption.

articleTitle: An Efficient Deep Neural Network for Cardiovascular disease prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease (CVDs) is forecasted and diagnosed in medical informatics using deep learning-based algorithms. These models can identify the optimum course of action, identify phenotypes for complex disorders, and recognize clinical signs. Using a big dataset of patient medical data, a deep learning model can be developed as a means of predicting CVDs. This work examined CVDs for early prediction using deep learning-based regression analysis on a dataset of 70,000 medical records from Kaggle that included age, symptoms, and CVD data. We suggest using long short-term memory-based deep neural networks in regression analysis to detect CVD early on. It has been shown that the overlapping symptoms of the diseases increase accuracy when the diseases are simulated in pairs. 95% of the forecasts for cardiovascular sickness are identified, according to the study's results, and 92% of those predictions correctly identified dyspnea. However, examining the three cases—cyanosis, dyspnea, and chest discomfort—could increase the accuracy to 93%. Weakness, emptiness, and exhaustion all had 92% percentages. Our proposed study illustrates combos with fever, combining Weakness and Fatigue, Dyspnea, Chest Pain, Cyanosis, Emptysis, and Pressure Pain in the Chest, with optimal accuracy levels approaching 95%. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our suggested strategy on a number of evaluation parameters.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Driven Grid Integration of Hybrid Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Due to their intermittent nature, renewable energy sources (RES) are becoming more and more integrated into the power system, which presents substantial issues for grid management. This study investigates the application of artificial intelligence (AI) approaches for grid integration of hybrid renewable energy sources and maximum power point tracking control strategy for renewable energy sources (RES) (AI). The potential of several AI techniques, including machine learning, deep learning, and optimization algorithms, to maximize energy storage use, improve grid stability, and ease demand-response management is examined. Additionally, the paper examines the role of AI in enabling grid operators to efficiently manage the variability and uncertainty associated with RES, thereby ensuring reliable and cost-effective operation of the power grid.AI-driven grid integration strategies for hybrid renewable energy sources, ultimately contributing to the transition towards a cleaner and more efficient energy infrastructure. Through case studies and examples, this paper highlights the development and evaluation of an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) based Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithm for a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator (PMSG) in a wind energy conversion system and PV system. The simulation results demonstrate that the ANN MPPT algorithm is more efficient and reliable, generating greater power output under varying wind speed profiles.

articleTitle: Weed Disease Classification using CNN and Inception V3 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The identification and regulating of weed diseases in modern agriculture is very significant because it is a direct factor that may influence crop quality and productivity. To advance the clinical precision and effectiveness of weeds diseases identification, this research focuses on the incorporation of the Inception V3 model with the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Once trained on a large number of pictures of weeds at a high-resolution level, the model then reached an amazing accuracy rate of 92%Augmentation and normalization were some of the key preprocessing techniques used to improve model performance by 8%. Proposed system is a highly efficient tool for early-stage disease detection in precision farming, which is far more competent than conservative methodology by a lot. More advanced meta-learning and reinforcement learning approaches can be combined further to enhance model accuracy and flexibility which will be an area of interest for future research

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 2D Object Similarity Detection using Hu’s Moments
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Object similarity detection is the process of searching and identifying similarities between the target image and the test images. It is crucial for tasks like object recognition and automated inspection systems. This paper presents a novel methodology for object similarity detection using template matching. It employs Hu's moments renowned for their invariance properties. The first stage involves preprocessing the images through grayscale conversion and resizing to standardize their dimensions. Raw moments are computed to capture the spatial distribution of pixel intensities within both the target and the test images. Centroids are then determined to characterize the centroidal location of pixel intensities. Following this, moment normalization is conducted to ensure the robustness of features against translation and rotation variations. Template matching is accomplished through a sliding window technique, wherein local regions of the test image are compared with the target object using the extracted moments. Polynomial regression is performed to calculate the acceptable deviation range between Hu’s moments of the target image and the test images. The identified similarities serve as indicators of object correspondences, thus demonstrating the efficacy of the proposed method across diverse rotations and translations.

articleTitle: Design of Frequency Re-Configurable Microstrip Patch Antenna for Ultra Wideband Application
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Modern communication frameworks require portable, compact, and wide-range antennas. The 30 × 26.40 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> dual-notch-band rectangular reconfigurable antenna is printed over a FR4 lossy dielectric substrate with a permittivity of εr = 4.3 and is fed by micro strip feed lines. In order to obtain dual-band notched features, the patch antenna structure must be embedded with notches or gaps, typically resembling a staircase. The antenna's measured bandwidth for VSWR <= 2 spans the full UWB spectrum (3.10 GHz to 10.60 GHz). This antenna is ideal for WIFI transmission at 5.00 GHz while minimizing interference from spacecraft communication, interplanetary interactions, terrestrial broadband, radar and amateur radio at 8.75 GHz. The antenna is reconfigurable, allowing changes to its radiation pattern, frequency response, polarization, and other characteristics without requiring physical modification. Using CST STUDIO SUITE 2023, simulated results were found for parameters such radiation structure, gain, VSWR, and S Parameter. This study enhances wideband antennas, addressing the growing demand for robust and efficient communication systems in modern scenarios.

articleTitle: Improved MRI based Automatic Brain Tumor Categorization Employing Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Accurately identifying and categorizing brain tumor is necessary for the lifesaving therapy. They allow the computational networks to perform in a dynamic manner. For brain tumor categorization the traditional classifiers require large dataset, more computational time and suffer from vanishing and exploding gradient problems. In this research three pretrained deep learning models namely ResNet152, VGG19 and EfficientNetB1 have been employed for categorizing the Magnetic Resonant Images into two classes. The Kaggle dataset is applied to our pretrained models. The evaluation metrics used for vali-dating the model are the accuracy, precision, Recall, F1score, ROC-AUC, Cohen Kappa score and confusion matrix. The VGG19 model has attained the highest scores such as 99% of accuracy, 99% of precision, 99% of Recall, 98.99% of F1 score, 0.9998 as ROC-AUC e and 0.98 as Cohen Kappa score.

articleTitle: Spatial Variations in Wind Direction along the Western Inner Periphery of India
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Wind direction plays a critical role in determining the energy output of individual WTGs in a wind farm. Therefore, wind resource estimation exercises require wind direction details as well as with wind speed profile. Most of the windy sites in India lie in the states along the western boundary of India. The basic characteristics, Weibull parameters, wind speed and wind direction of 11 sites along the western inner periphery of India have been analyzed. ERA5 data at 100 m level from of the nearest grid for the period from 2006 to 2021 have been used for the analysis. The results of the analysis have been provided in the paper. A useful information from the analysis is that the wind direction gradually shifts from SW (225°) at Site 1 to W (270°) at Site 11 as we move from North to South. A more detailed wind direction analysis is required to get a deeper understanding.

articleTitle: Advanced Encryption: Harnessing Hybrid Model with Password Manager Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The proposed system seamlessly combines text encryption and password management through a user- friendly graphical interface (GUI). The graphical interface facilitates easy input which undergoes encryption algorithms to transform it into unreadable cipher text, thus guaranteeing confidentiality. Users can efficiently generate and organize secure passwords within the GUI, associating them with specific encrypted data for comprehensive protection. The securely stored encrypted data and passwords reside within the system's database, with an additional layer of encryption applied to stored passwords for heightened security. User interaction with the system and data management are performed, by a user- provided master password. A database is created which stores encrypted data that is entered on GUI. For maintaining data security double encryption hybrid model is used. In the propose system, the vulnerability of the encrypted data is checked using SQL Injection attack on the MYSQL database.

articleTitle: Federated CNNs for Enhanced Dust Detection and Classification on Solar Panels
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research study introduces a novel approach to optimising solar panels’ effectiveness using a federated learning approach with a Convolutional Neural Network to identify dirty surfaces of photovoltaic modules. Dust build-up can significantly reduce power generation by solar panels in their lifetime, implying that cleaning strategies should be conducted optimally. Such practices may lead to either over-cleaning or under-cleaning with conventional methods employed in an organization with existing dust intensity without considering the current dust level. To address these challenges, our study proposes that the federated CNN overcome them. This model is designed to accurately classify solar panel photos into four categories, depending on the degree of dust present. Specifically, they are cleaning, light, moderate, and hard dusting. Information collected from multiple solar farms was used to train and evaluate the model, and the efficiency reached 95%.Moreover, high selectivity or precision, association or recall, and F1-Score ranged or were higher than 92%. The discussed federated learning strategy ensured the privacy of the data by computing the data at each node, reducing the amount of data that needs to be transferred from node to node, thus ensuring the model is a solution for large-scale, efficient real-time monitoring. The federated CNN approach is a significant improvement compared to traditional cleaning practices, allowing for more accurate and timely actions to eliminate previously discussed issues that could lead to increased efficiency and protection for solar panels. Future studies of the said topic will focus on including environmental factors in the creation of the model and extending its application from different climatic scenarios, with the vision of continuously improving the existing maintenance schedule and optimising the energy output.

articleTitle: Optimizing Spyware Detection with Combined Neural Networks and Random Forest Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Spyware attacks are always a danger to the safety of digital settings and need improved monitoring systems to find them. By mixing machine learning and deep learning methods, this research study shows a new way to find the solution for detecting spyware attack. In a planned way, our approach blends the strengths of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Random Forest methods. The Random Forest and the ANN can both analyze data and make decisions as a group, but the ANN is better at automatically pulling the subtle traits needed to find complex malware trends. The method for finding Spyware was carefully made to work well with both old and new threats, giving a strong security. The suggested fusion method has been put through a lot of tests and results analysis. This study improves the success of protection measures by offering a method that blends the good things about deep learning and machine learning. With Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Random Forest designs working together, user can protect the system strongly from software attacks that cause many problems. This fusion technique is shown to be a strong and flexible way to make digital communities safer in reaction to the growing number of digital dangers.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Ticketing System with Integrated Multi-Payment and Cancellation Features
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In today's fast-paced world, digitalization is at the forefront of our daily lives. Entertainment events, such as movies, concerts, and theatre performances, have become integral to our social fabric. With the increasing reliance on digital solutions, the need for efficient, automated systems to manage these events has never been more critical. This paper presents an innovative solution to meet these demands by leveraging FPGA and Verilog HDL technologies to create an automatic movie ticket booking and cancellation system, demonstrating significant advancements in speed, reliability, and user convenience. The system features real-time booking and cancellation, high-speed transaction processing, and robust error reduction mechanisms. Through detailed simulation utilizing the ModelSim software tool, the system demonstrated significant improvements in speed and reliability compared to traditional software-based solutions. This advancement is particularly important as it meets the growing demand for automated, error-free, and rapid transaction processes in the entertainment industry. Additionally, while this paper focuses on a movie ticketing system, the underlying design is highly reconfigurable and can be adapted for various other applications, such as automated event ticketing systems, smart parking management, and secure access control systems. This flexibility showcases the potential of FPGA technology to address diverse requirements, further enhancing its applicability in different domains.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 8-bit Flash ADC and R-2R DAC in Cadence 45nm CMOS Process for Biomedical Application
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: When working with mixed-signal circuits, a micro-electronic system needs both digital-to-analog (D/A) and analog-to-digital (A/D) converters. In this work, present a medium-speed, low-power flash ADC with an R2R DAC. The 45nm CMOS process was used to design the 8-bit ADC and DAC, which have a 0.7 V supply. A dynamic comparator, an 8-bit flash A/D logic unit that simulates an array's binary search logic, a two-stage operational amplifier, and an 8-bit D/A converter are the important components. The Flash ADC circuit uses 14.33 μW at a sampling frequency of up to 5 MHz, and R2R DAC uses 1.125 mW, according to the simulation findings.

articleTitle: ManahSeva-Mental Health Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: ManahSeva is a robust mental health platform that delves into the diverse realms of emotional well-being. Its core objective is to provide users with an extensive collection of mental health blogs and resources, aiding them in their pursuit of improved mental wellness. Boasting an interactive chatbot for enhanced engagement and assistance, along with dedicated discussion groups fostering a sense of community, ManahSeva ensures users feel supported and connected. Emphasizing safety as paramount, the platform employs advanced Machine Learning algorithms to swiftly detect and address any instances of harmful behavior, establishing a secure environment conducive to open expression. This proactive approach helps to maintain a secure environment in which users are free to express themselves without fear of negative consequences. Moreover, ManahSeva introduces a distinctive daily diary feature, enabling users to regularly document their thoughts and emotions. The Platform enables users to gain insight into their emotional patterns and helps them better understand the mental health journey, by analysing sentiment from these diaries. The users are empowered by this innovative approach to take proactive steps towards personal improvement and emotional well being

articleTitle: An Efficient Model for Early Detection of Maize Leaf Disease using Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Maize plays a fundamental role as a staple food for millions worldwide. However, the significant threat posed by various diseases to maize cultivation has led to substantial yield losses on a global scale. Early and accurate detection of these diseases is essential for prompt intervention and effective treatment strategies. In this regard, the development of advanced detection methods employing deep learning and image processing has gained attention, offering the potential to revolutionize disease identification and management practices. Accordingly, this research introduces a Deep Convolutional Neural Network model combined with Transfer Learning techniques, reducing the training time for the AI model. Furthermore, Data Augmentation practices are employed to improve accuracy by addressing dataset variability. The projected model achieves an impressive accuracy of 98.6%, crucial for mitigating current crop wastage resulting from undetected diseases. Enhancing accuracy further is essential for improving current crop yield conditions impacted by undetected diseases. Moreover, a GUI-based application model is developed for early detection of maize diseases, aiding farmers in their fields. This accuracy can be further increased by incorporating additional parameters. Traditional image recognition and Deep Learning approaches are progressively making their way into the field of plant disease recognition.

articleTitle: Surface CrackFinder: CNN-based Detection Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Surface cracks present serious risks to structural integrity and safety in a variety of engineering contexts, such as manufacturing, transportation, and infrastructure. Conventional techniques for detecting cracks frequently depend on manual inspection or specialized tools, which can be labor-intensive, time-consuming, and prone to human mistake. Deep learning methods, in particular Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have become increasingly effective tools for automated crack identification in recent years. This research provides a unique CNN-based method for surface crack detection. The suggested technique makes use of CNNs' capacity to automatically extract discriminative characteristics from unprocessed input images, allowing for precise and effective crack detection. Model use a collection of annotated photos with a variety of surface fracture patterns under different lighting circumstances to train the CNN model. Next, unseen data is used to test the trained model and assess how well it performs in practical situations. The outcomes of our experiments show how reliable and efficient our method is in identifying surface fractures with a high degree of accuracy. In addition, verify the superiority of our CNN-based strategy by comparative studies with current approaches. All things considered, this study advances automated surface crack identification and establishes the groundwork for the creation of robust and useful fracture detection systems for a range of applications.

articleTitle: Synthetic Image Generation using StackGAN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The generation of artificially created images which resemble actual photos is known as synthetic image generation. Due to the many potential uses of synthetic image generation, it has drawn a lot of interest. Conversational chatbots that produce contextual visuals based on user input are one example of such an application. This ability is very beneficial in situations like drawing criminals from their descriptions. The field still faces difficulties in producing high-quality images that are aesthetically identical to actual photographs. In order to solve this issue, this paper offers the use of a cutting-edge Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) model, StackGAN, to produce high-quality photos. This main goal of this work is to investigate how well StackGAN can create realistic graphics from inputs that include both images and text embedding from a single dataset. It also seeks to contribute to the development of synthetic image generation techniques and offer a method for producing visually accurate artificial images by overcoming the drawbacks of prior GAN structures. The improved performance of StackGAN is demonstrated in creating high-quality photos with amazing visual fidelity through rigorous experimentation and evaluation.

articleTitle: Improved ML based Load Forecasting using Time-Split Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Load forecasting is the process of predicting future energy consumption patterns. It is crucial for efficient energy management, helping utilities plan and allocate resources to meet demand, optimize grid operations, and ensure a reliable power supply. By leveraging the adaptability and predictive capabilities of machine learning, the accuracy of load forecasting can be enhanced. We aim to improve the accuracy of the standalone machine learning models by utilizing an efficient representation of the dataset. The technique uses CNN (Convolution Neural Networks) to derive a meaningful representation of the dataset by converting time series data to five channels and then training the machine learning models on the derived dataset. The results showed improved performance of all the models in consideration. A noticeable decrease in the losses [MAPE, MAE, MSE] is also reported.

articleTitle: Spit Detection and Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: India is a country where public spitting remains prevalent due to social acceptance and a lack of enforcement by authorities. This behavior is evident in various locations, including railway stations, government buildings, elevators, and public restrooms, where red and crimson stains are commonplace. This not only degrades the environment but also poses a health risk, as saliva from an infected individual can transmit COVID-19 for more than 24 hours. Despite existing legislation, the problem persists due to ineffective enforcement and minimal fines, which fail to act as a deterrent. The objective of the 'Spit Detection and Alert System' is to identify individuals spitting in public spaces and promptly notify the authorities to take appropriate action.

articleTitle: Prevention of Black-hole Attack in Manet’s
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Mobile ad hoc networks, often known as MANETs, are network modes that operate without being dependant on any type of network structure and central access. The quick swift mode of networking makes MANET’s capable of executing all of the complex tasks. Nevertheless, open channels and changing topology present inherent security risks. We demonstrated explicitly that the AAS is resilient against sophisticated attacks, route spoofing using the BAN sense, finicky forwarding, bogus routing, and violent bumps mixing in MANET. If there are any particularly sharp bumps in the network, the AAS might raise the packet’s sending speed around to 40, on a regular basis. There are numerous active routing protocols that it works with.When nasty nodes strike in simulated trials ,AAS resilience is demonstrated by its ability to sustain 79.2 percent of the network's performance. Nearly 1.6 times as many connections occur on average on the network as with the Cap-OLSR protocol, which prevents conspiracy attacks.

articleTitle: Restaurant Recommendation System based on Cosine Similarity
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The plethora of dining options available in the digital age poses a formidable obstacle for patrons seeking to choose restaurant establishments that satisfy their tastes and financial limitations. The focus of this research is to develop an enhanced restaurant recommendation system that uses cosine similarity and k-means clustering techniques to combine average dining costs and customer ratings to address the challenge. Based on average dining costs and customer ratings, the system leverages the inherent similarities among restaurants to provide personalized recommendations. To make it easier to identify clusters with similar dining characteristics, restaurants are first clustered into different groups of clusters cluster [0]-low prices and high rating, cluster [1]-low prices and low rating, cluster [2]-high price and low rating and scattered data of high prices and high rating using k-means clustering and cosine similarity. The similarity between a user's preferences and the centroids of these clusters is then calculated using cosine similarity, allowing for the creation of customized restaurant recommendations. Proposed Restaurant Recommendation System, clustering categorization results scored for cluster-0 (precision 0.94, recall 0.92, F1-score 0.91, support 1094 and accuracy 0.94 percent), cluster-1 (precision 0.95, recall 0.91, F1-score 0.92, support 1545 and accuracy 0.95 percent) and cluster-2 (precision 0.94, recall 0.90, F1-score 0.92, support 130 and accuracy 0.94 percent).

articleTitle: Trust-Based Data Fusion and Machine Learning for Underwater Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks (UWSNs) are essential for a wide range of marine applications, from environmental monitoring to underwater exploration. However, significant obstacles such signal attenuation, multipath propagation, and sensor node mobility make it difficult to sustain flawless communication in dynamic underwater environments. In UWSNs, handover prediction becomes essential for maintaining continuous communication and maximizing the effectiveness of data transfer. This research presents a novel method for precise handover prediction in UWSNs by utilizing machine learning algorithms and real-time maritime data. The system attempts to predict Energy Trust, Environment Trust, and Communication Trust events by examining environmental parameters and past handover events, improving communication efficiency and reliability in dynamic underwater environments.

articleTitle: Small Object Detection & Classification In Cardiac Images For the Improvised Early Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Early diagnosis of cardiac abnormalities plays a crucial role in preventing severe cardiovascular diseases. This paper presents a novel approach for detecting and classifying small objects, such as anomalies, in cardiac images to facilitate early diagnosis and intervention. The proposed methodology integrates various image processing and machine learning techniques, including input image preprocessing, edge detection, boundary extraction, KAZE feature extraction, region mapping, morphological analysis, ensemble learning, and convolutional neural network (CNN) classification, followed by decision-making mechanisms. Initially, the input cardiac images undergo preprocessing to enhance quality and reduce noise, followed by edge detection to identify potential regions of interest. Subsequently, boundary extraction techniques are applied to delineate object boundaries for more accurate analysis. KAZE feature extraction is then employed to capture discriminative features from the identified regions. Next, a region mapping approach is utilized to segment and classify small objects within the cardiac images. Morphological analysis is applied to refine the detected regions and improve classification accuracy. An ensemble learning method is then employed to integrate diverse classifiers for enhanced performance. Furthermore, a CNN classifier is trained on the extracted features to classify the detected objects into relevant categories, facilitating automated diagnosis. Finally, a decision-making mechanism is employed to interpret the classification results and provide actionable insights for healthcare professionals. The proposed approach offers a robust solution for early diagnosis of cardiac abnormalities by effectively detecting and classifying small objects in cardiac images. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed methodology in improving diagnostic accuracy and efficiency, thereby contributing to enhanced patient care and prognosis in cardiovascular medicine.

articleTitle: Interface Defect Density Effects on TiO2/NH2(CH2)2NH3MnCl4/Spiro-OMeTAD Solar
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study aims to advance sustainable energy solutions that are in line with the sustainable development goals (SDGs) by examining the impact of IDDs on the PV performance of NH-PSC. A viable option for the production of renewable energy, perovskite solar cells are inexpensive to produce and have a high efficiency. IDDs between various layers of the solar cell structure, however, can have a substantial influence on device performance, which makes the general adoption of this technology difficult. The optimal findings for IDDs in the considered cell are as follows: PCE: 22.2%, FF: 86.4%, JSC: 17.45mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and VOC: 1.47V at the very least. This effort helps to promote renewable energy sources and lessen dependency on fossil fuels by optimizing the NH-PSC. Facilitating the development of cleaner and more efficient energy solutions is the advancement of materials science and engineering approaches for sustainable energy technology. Several goals of sustainable development are aided by this study. It is inexpensive and clean energy as it encourages the use of renewable energy sources and lessens dependency on fossil fuels. Through the advancement of materials science and engineering approaches for sustainable energy solutions, this study helps industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By reducing greenhouse gas emissions and battling climate change, interface engineering techniques are explored in an effort to prevent climate change. This effort aligns with sustainable cities and communities by boosting access to renewable energy resources and fostering sustainable urban development through the improvement of solar cell durability and efficiency.

articleTitle: Titanic Survival Predictor Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Presumably, one of the most notorious and catastrophic catastrophes in history is the sinking of the RMS Titanic. Unfortunately, the Titanic sank during her inaugural voyage on April 15, 1912, early in the morning after slamming into an iceberg. Out of 2224 passengers and crew, approximately 1502 perished. Social stratification is a situation where people within a society are separated into various ranking on a hierarchical basis. These groups, also known as social classes are ranked as a social order that is made up of a person's education level, income level Next similar models based on machine learning will be chosen to come to a conclusion whether some groups of individuals are candidates to survive the long space travel. The results of application of the distinct machine learning models were illustrated down one after the other and compared through a general viewpoint of precision. Initially, to get a better feeling of how the data is distributed and what the traits are, the datasets were first examined and prepared. Following that, we ran a variety of machine learning models including Logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, naive Bayes classifier and k nearest neighbors (kNN) for prediction. While conducting our research, we benchmarked the performance of each algorithm using strict assessment techniques like evaluation of variables like the required computational effort, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score.

articleTitle: Implementation of an IOT Based System to Improve the Consumption of Domestic Consumers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper offers a comprehensive analysis of how combining the Internet of Things (IoT) with renewable energy sources might increase energy consumption efficiency. Through real-time monitoring and control, the proposed system improves the sustainability and dependability of energy distribution by using state-of-the-art IoT technology. By fixing the inefficiencies in traditional energy systems, this technology reduces operational costs and transmission losses. Because it can save money and benefit the environment, using renewable energy, particularly solar energy, is promoted. A detailed explanation of the methodology, including hardware and software design, is followed by an analysis of the results and observations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cyber Supply Chain Security through Predictive Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the domain of cyber security, supporting the flexibility of supply chains against potential dangers is vital. This review dives into the domain of prescient examination, utilizing progressed AI methods including CatBoost, XGBoost, and Stacking Classifier. Utilizing a complete dataset including a plenty of elements like IsBeta, RtpStateBitfield, and AV-ProductStatesIdentifier, among others, the examination expects to foster strong models fit for estimating digital dangers. By examining markers like HasDetections and Wdft_IsGamer, the models endeavor to distinguish designs demonstrative of potential security breaks. Through fastidious examination of qualities like Firewall status and Census_OSBuildNumber, the review tries to give significant experiences to upgrading digital store network security. By amalgamating different classifiers, this exploration tries to offer a diverse way to deal with danger location, consequently strengthening the digital foundation against arising gambles and guaranteeing the honesty of inventory network organizations.

articleTitle: Adaptive Malware Detection In Windows Portable Executables (Wpes)
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: It's crucial to comprehend the characteristics of malware variants that enable them to elude malware detection methods as they are created with the intention of avoiding detection by means of a variety of evasion strategies. It is done by a framework designed to generate undetectable malware samples on Windows executable files by incorporating various techniques such as adding benign sections and obfuscating code. Creating undetectable malware variants using a framework can successfully evaded numerous anti-malware programs, showing significantly higher evasiveness than both the original malware and a previously suggested solution. By examining various perturbations and their efficacy, our results contribute to the improvement of malware detection algorithms by providing a better knowledge of the categories to which more evasive malware variants may belong and how they might be created. To create anti-malware programmed that are capable of successfully identifying malware varieties that have not been observed before, experimental findings and observations would be helpful.

articleTitle: Audio Emotion Mapping using Enhanced Techniques with Augmented Log-Melspectrograms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Using a novel approach based on log-Mel spectrogram with augmentation, this research piece delves into the realm of audio emotion classification. Although it is much lower than MFCC, the research reveals a reasonable accuracy rate of 63%. On the other hand, it shows how much room there is for improvement. One complex model used in the research is a 2D convolutional neural network (CNN) based on the VGG19 architecture. This model treats the audio characteristics as an image with dimensions of 30x216 pixels. Specialised functions are employed to extract various attributes from datasets like TESS, CREMA-D, SAVEE, and RAVDESS. The significance of quickly recognising emotions through aural signals is emphasised. Results from the 2D CNN model are promising, and it has the potential to outperform more traditional methods. The results can be more quickly interpreted by storing them in a specific class. By bringing together audio and image-based approaches to emotion analysis, this work improves the growing field of audio emotion categorization and opens the door to more accurate and efficient identification.

articleTitle: Design and Investigation of OWC based 16×10Gbps DWDM/MDM System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Today, owing to the feasible demands of artificial intelligence, multi-service, big-data, cloud access, online game etc., the faithful dense wavelength division multiplexing and mode division multiplexing (DWDM/MDM) system should be an important topic for high efficiency and capacity signal connection. A 16×10Gbps optical wireless communication (OWC) based DWDM/MDM system is designed and investigated in this paper. System is designed at HG00 and HG11 modes. Simulation results depicts the reliable OWC range of 395-400km and 355-400km is achieved at 0.5 and 1μrad pointing error. Better performance is obtained at fundamental mode HG00 than HG11 mode. It also offers high output signal and output OSNR of -16.50dBm and 83.49dB respectively, at bit error rate limit of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. System peforms best over other existing ones.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Outage Reduction Scheme for LBT-based RF Powered Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: RF powered network is a sustainable solution for the Internet of Things. Listen Before Talk (LBT) scheme is mandatory in New Radio Unlicensed (NR-U) network which is an important candidate for cellular IoT. In this work, we consider an LBT-based network which is RF powered by Base Station (BS). Two schemes based on congestion level threshold are proposed and their performance is analyzed with respect to the simple RF-LBT scheme with the help of simulations. The proposed schemes reduce the transmission outage at a node while keeping the normalized saturation throughput of the network same.

articleTitle: HNCS: A Robust Development of Deep Learning Based Potato Plant Disease Identification Using Hybrid Neural Classification Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent decades, potato farming has exploded in popularity across India. On the other hand, diseases such as early stages of blight and later blight are making the production of potatoes more challenging and consequently more expensive. The goal here is to digitalize the system and automate the process of disease identification in potatoes so that production can grow. Our proposed algorithm, Hybrid Neural Classification Strategy (HNCS), will be cross-validated with an existing learning algorithm, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), to assess the efficacy of the proposed scheme in diagnosing potato disease using leaf pictures. This article provides a picture of how automated systems based on processing and deep learning may identify and categorize illnesses affecting potato leaves. Image processing is the most effective method for identifying and studying these disorders. Over 4500 images of diseased potato leaves were used for this research; the images came from the plant town database, an open-source dataset on the Kaggle website, and a few pre-built models were used for recognition and characterization. The program's result demonstrates that deep learning outperforms all current tasks in potato disease detection, and it makes predictions with an accuracy of 98.73%.

articleTitle: Design of Triangular Based 4 X 4 Array Microstrip Patch Antenna and Comparing with 2 X 2 Triangular Array Microstrip Patch Antenna for X-Band Application
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The design of a novel 4 X 4 array triangular patch antenna (TPA) is described here and compares its Bandwidth performance with a 2 X 2 array TPA for X-Band (i.e., 8-12 GHz) applications using HFSS software. The Bandwidth performance with a 2 X 2 array TPA (n=27) at 10 GHz frequency is compared with a novel 4 X 4 array TPA (n=27). A pre-test power of 80% was used to compute the 54 samples utilizing sample calculation. The novel 4 X 4 array TPA shows a Bandwidth of 11.78 GHz whereas the 2 X 2 array TPA shows a Bandwidth of 6.59 GHz. This study's significance level is less than 0.001 (p<0.05). The observed results indicate that for X-band applications, significantly the novel 4 X 4 array TPA shows better bandwidth performance than the 2 X 2 array TPA.

Author Keywords: Novel 4 X 4 Array Triangular Patch Antenna (TPA)

articleTitle: Automatic Defect Detection of Spine Vertebrate using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This abstract presents a novel approach to spine defect detection utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and image augmentation techniques. The study focuses on enhancing the accuracy and reliability of defect identification in spinal structures through the application of advanced machine learning models. By leveraging CNNs, the model is capable of analyzing high-resolution images of spinal structures to identify and classify defects with high precision. The incorporation of image augmentation strategies significantly improves the model's robustness against variations in image quality and orientation, thereby ensuring more consistent and reliable detection outcomes. The proposed model achieves state of the art performance in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, demonstrating its potential to significantly contribute to the field of medical imaging and diagnostics. This research contributes to the development of more effective and efficient tools for early detection and diagnosis of spinal defects, ultimately supporting improved patient care and outcomes.

articleTitle: Solar tracking System Generated Low Voltage to Changing into High Voltage with Advanced Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this work, we dive into the benefits of an upgraded Boost converter inside a photovoltaic-based energy framework. Sunlight based energy is acquiring quick reputation as a urgent method for extending sustainable power assets. Amazingly, it has arisen as one of the most encouraging sustainable power sources portrayed by its huge potential for transformation into electrical power. Nonetheless, the test lies in the way that regular sunlight based charger power frameworks stay static. This implies that the sun powered charger won't necessarily in all cases be ideally situated toward the sun, prompting a sub-par usage of daylight force falling onto the sunlight based charger. Subsequently, the sunlight powered charger neglects to work at its most extreme presentation limit. In this exploration, we tirelessly investigate the plan and development of a "Double pivot sun based global positioning framework by utilizing LDR." This framework empowers sun powered development in both even and vertical headings. Our proposed framework depends on a cerebrum like regulator to organize the whole arrangement. Utilizing a light-reliant resistor (LDR), we effectively sense the power of light and send the information to the regulator. In this way, the information is broke down by the regulator which will oversee engine turn in the suitable course. By changing the sun powered charger direction both on a level plane and in an upward direction through two engines, we accomplish effective sun following. Eventually, we will exhibit a completely useful framework to approve our imaginative plan. Our careful endeavors expect to give a savvy, proficient, and fixed nearby planet group arrangement, which displays yield productivity going from 15% to 20%.

articleTitle: Optimizing Electric Vehicle Motor Drive Systems Using a Model Predictive Control Compared With (PID) Controller for Enhanced Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study aims to enhance the efficiency of Electric Vehicle (EV) motor drive systems by implementing Model Predictive Control (MPC) compared to the conventional Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller. A total of 14 efficiency samples were utilized, with each sample obtained by varying the simulation time. The two controllers were evaluated based on their respective impacts on the efficiency of the motor drive systems. The study highlights the notable differences in performance between MPC and PID controllers in enhancing the efficiency of EV motor drive systems. Model Predictive Control (MPC) implementation demonstrated a substantial efficiency improvement, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 92%. In contrast, the PID controller exhibited a comparatively lower accuracy of 78%. The study concludes that the application of Model Predictive Control in Electric Vehicle motor drive systems leads to superior efficiency compared to PID controllers, as evidenced by the statistically significant p<0.05. This research provides valuable insights for advancing the optimization of EV propulsion systems.

articleTitle: Harnessing Distributed Computing Resources with Federated Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this research, we attempt to answer the following questions: Is FRL helpful in lessening computing requirements, enhancing data privacy, and optimizing heterogeneous computing resources? FRL integrates the peculiarities of both FL and RL, such as local decision-making and privacy preservation. Therefore, FRL's performance is far superior to that of conventional RL, with figures revealing an average enhancement of approximately thirty percent across the various domains of smart grid, healthcare, and self-driving automobiles.The performance of the differential privacy strategies stabilized and boosted privacy protection as epsilon values were reduced from about 1. 0 to 0. 25, which makes data breaches rather unlikely. Possible threats had a decent amount of discrimination demonstrated by the area under the curve of privacy attack models, which was 0. 56 on the ROC curve. Some precautions of this work are that the variety of instances in unbalanced classes is different, and the algorithm does not consider the relationship between genes and diseases. It did this by pointing towards aspects that could, perhaps, be enhanced. Twenty-five different experiments of the FRL system led to an average of 30% cut down of the raw resource utilization rates, the CPU, memory, and battery power in particular. Thus, the present outcomes prove the applicability of FRL in natural environments and show how FRL can reach efficient outcomes without compromising users’ rights to privacy. This paper lays the early foundation for further research on FRL systems, with the prospective of enhancing protective guidelines and extending their application in complex and dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Predicting Cervical Spine Fractures Using CNN Model: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study explores the application of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models for the prediction of cervical spine fractures using CT scan medical images. The dataset comprises 4200 CT images, evenly split between 2100 normal and 2100 fractured images. The CNN architecture consists of four convolutional blocks followed by dense layers for classification. Training is conducted over 30 epochs with a batch size of 7, and performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are evaluated. The CNN model achieves high precision and an accuracy of 99%, outperforming traditional machine learning technology like SVM and KNN. These results underscore CNN's efficacy in accurately classifying cervical spine images and its potential to enhance diagnostic accuracy and patient care.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Fruit Ripeness Assessment: The CNN-LSTM Hybrid Approach for Oranges
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The evaluation of the fruit ripeness should be very accurate to ensure a quality uptake and reduced wastage in the agricultural supply chain. This paper proposes a new approach, integrating both CNN and LSTM, for the classification of ripe oranges. The data sampling comprised 10,000 photographs of oranges photographed in their unripe, semi-ripe, and ripe states. The proposed hybrid CNN-LSTM model was trained on the dataset, and the accuracy achieved was as high as 93 % during the tests—2%. Concerning the precision, recall, and F1-score values, they were 92.5%, 93 %, and 92. 7%, respectively. The performance outcome of our developed model is significantly higher than that of other machine learning techniques, such as Support Vector Machines, K-nearest neighbour, or even Random Forest. These models correctly classified 80.2%, 78.9%, and 82.3% respectively. Specifically, the CNN component effectively acquired spatial features from the photos where the LSTM component captured temporal patterns, thus enhancing the model’s predictive capacity. The comparative analysis proved that the proposed hybrid model attained better results than solo CNN and LSTM models with 88. 4% and 85. 7% respectively. The graphical performances were assessed using the ROC curves, confusion matrix heat maps, scatter plots, joint plots, training and validation accuracy & loss curves. It is evident from this research that the integration of CNN and LSTM networks will offer accurate and efficient means of predicting the ripeness status of fruits.

articleTitle: Enhancing Digital Crime Investigation Through Deep Learning-Powered Deepfake Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The increase of deepfake videos compromises the integrity of information delivery since they can be used to spread misinformation, manipulate public opinion, and cause conflict. Detecting deepfake media is a difficult task, especially in forensic circumstances where accuracy is very important. In this study, we developed an advanced deep-learning model specifically for the automated detection of deepfake images and videos. Our approach uses convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to distinguish between real and fake media. In addition, to improve the prediction accuracy, we employed hybrid deep learning methodologies, which include both CNN and Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifiers. Our proposed CNN-SVM hybrid model achieved an accuracy of more than 95%. Furthermore, the algorithm was trained to predict a person’s age and gender from the image, which is significant in digital crime investigation.
