This work is an essential contribution to ongoing attempts to fight against deepfake content and increase trust in multimedia content. Implementing such models will discourage people from creating and spreading deepfake images and videos. As a result, people’s privacy is secured, digital media integrity is maintained, and the credibility of digital media ecosystems is preserved.

articleTitle: Enhancing Human Machine Interface Capabilities using Bluetooth Low Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This article provides a thorough explanation of a system that uses proprietary protocols, Internet of Things technology, and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) connection to diagnose kitchen appliances remotely. The system consists of an Appliance Control Unit (ACU) and Human-Machine Interface (HMI), where consumers can communicate with their appliances by connecting HMI to a smartphone. Data transmission integrity is assured by security mechanisms such as access restrictions and passkey authentication. There are two different approaches for communication: In one approach, GATT (Generic Attribute Profile) is used with multiple services and characteristics, while HMI processes data. Alternatively, an ACU and smartphone can establish direct communication via the HMI acting as a transreceiver. Functions of the system include getting product information, fault codes, managing various components, acknowledging sensor information and accommodating Over-The-Air (OTA) updates. Multiple tests are performed to determine its reliability and effectiveness when used in remote device diagnosis. This research provides useful knowledge on how BLE can be integrated with appliances so it enhances serviceability through user experience.

articleTitle: CV2X Based Ambulance Integrated with 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The Smart Ambulance Traffic System is a ground-breaking project that leverages Vehicle-to-Infrastructure (V2I) communication via cellular networks to enhance emergency medical services and improve traffic management. In today’s fast-paced urban environments, swift ambulance response times are critical for saving lives. SATS utilizes the existing cellular network infrastructure to establish seamless and reliable communication between ambulances and the central control center. The integration of 4G/5G cellular networks ensures low-latency data transmission, even in high-density urban areas. V2I integrates with traffic signal systems to provide green lights for the ambulance, ensuring a clear path through intersections. In this project, the ambulance sends a message to a central server using the cellular network. The server then uses the A* algorithm to calculate the best route for the ambulance after analyzing the traffic conditions and the location of other ambulances. The A* algorithm evaluates potential routes based on the actual and estimated costs, considering the traffic and road conditions, and suggests the most efficient path. The server then sends this information back to the ambulance, which is used to communicate with traffic lights along the route and roadside units to gather information about the road, such as surface conditions, weather updates, and any potential hazards with the help of CV2X(Cellular Vehicle-to-Everything) Technology.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Learning for Dermatological Applications: Multi-Class Skin Disease Detection Using CNN-GAN Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel deep-learning framework that integrates CNNs and GANs to develop a model for enhancing the identification and classification of skin disorders. The main challenges of dermatological imaging include the scarcity of data and the imbalance of classes in place. Thus, the proposed model extends the dataset containing pictures from Dermnet and HAM10000 databases to include synthetic images generated by the trained GANs. The diagnostic performance of the designed CNN-GAN model was thoroughly compared with the general CNN models and is much better. The suggested model achieved an accuracy of 93 percent. 5%, precision of 91. 2%, recall of 92. 7%; and F1-score of 92. 0%. On the other hand, the accuracy rate of the…traditional CNN model was 88. Three per cent and a precision rate of 85, whereas for the full set, it is 97 per cent. 7%, and a high recall rate of 87. precision of 80%, a recall rate of 5%, and an F1-score of 86. 6%. In the present research, it is possible to confirm that the approach based on GANs effectively increases the training dataset with the necessary variety and quantity, thus minimizing the overfitting and enhancing the model’s ability to perform for different skin conditions. The outcomes for the CNN-GAN framework are higher than the present performance using accuracy, and it also demonstrates a potential solution to the difficulties in the tasks arising from the small sample size in medical image analysis. This creates the basis for the further elaboration of diagnostic procedures that are used in clinics.

articleTitle: Development in Detecting False News using Genetic Algorithm and Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Fake news on social media and other media can have disastrous effects on society and the country, which makes it a serious issue. Numerous studies have already focused on finding it. In order to select the best standard machine learning model and use it to develop a product model using a supervised machine learning algorithm, this study reviews the literature on false news identification. Currently in use methods for identifying fake news often involve natural language analysis and machine learning algorithms to determine the veracity of news material. This inspired us to tackle the false news detection problem using a novel genetic algorithm method. In this paper, SVM classifiers and different datasets are used to examine the identification of bogus news. In order to develop a model of a product with supervised machine learning algorithm that can categorize fake news as true or false, this work analyses the research connected to fake news detection and investigates the conventional machine learning models to choose the best.

articleTitle: Safeguarding Hearts using Support Vector Machine (SVM) Analysis for Early Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Support vector machine (SVM) technology that can readily manage a very high proportion of complicated health data is the predictive modelling technique applied in this study. Although most people lead demanding lifestyles nowadays, it is unlikely that more people had actually weak hearts in the past. Heart failure is the condition whereby the heart is not quite pumping as it should be. Twelve features in the dataset allow one to forecast cardiac failure. The SVM's outstanding 88% accuracy rate for classification fits several clinical criteria and risk factors. This study is emphasizing a lot on the need of smart, informed computer approaches as a must to get really good at diagnosing and treating heart failure early—and on the road to far better ideas on monitoring your health.

articleTitle: Deep Fake Identification Made Efficient: The Power of EfficientNetV2-B1
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: As deep fake technology has become a widespread threat for society, this type of manipulation in digital media and its ability to deceive have raised profound issues about misdirection or trust. Using the EfficientNetV2-B1 model for deep fake image classification, the method developed in this paper was proposed. The model is trained on the CIFAKE dataset, made up of 100k images that are either real or AI-generated synthetic rows of pictures in their entirety instead of a single strip nonsense. The method consists of data pre-processing, the model training process of the EfficientNetV2-B1 model, and evaluation using standard metrics. Running the model through continuous training and testing an impressive 92% accuracy was obtained when applied to the CIFAKE dataset. In addition, measured the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve value, as a crucial indicator in classification performance, as 0.97 which exhibits both the strength and reliability of this method for distinguishing between real and deep fake images. By providing an effective method that can be used at scale to address Deep Fake images, this research paper is part of the current push against fake news. The results reveal how advanced deep learning models, such as the EfficientNetV2-B1, can enhance the integrity and reliability of media content through innovation.

articleTitle: Advancements in Veterinary Diagnostics: A CNN-SVM Model for Cattle Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research work aims to propose a solution that adopts the integration of a CNN and an SVM for the precise and steady identification of five standard diseases that affect cows. This integration improves the diagnostic models applied in veterinary medicine in the following way. For the experiment, a set of 5,000 photos was used to develop as well as test the hybrid CNN-SVM model. Different ailing categories, such as Foot and Mouth illness, Bovine Respiratory Disease, Mastitis, Bovine Tuberculosis, and Johne’s Disease had 1000 images each. This model achieved a classification accuracy of 94% while on average Random Forests and a standalone SVM achieved only 85% and 87% respectively. The analysis of the parameters that indicate the accuracy, the recall, and the F1-score shows the efficiency of the proposed model, which typically exceeds the 90% mark in all types of illness. Analyzing the results obtained through the model implementation, it becomes evident that the proposed model reached a 95 % accuracy rate for Foot and Mouth Disease and the recall rate of Foot and Mouth Disease was 96% for Bovine Respiratory Disease, therefore enhancing the model’s proficiency in identifying and sort out these diseases. Despite the good accuracy of the model, the use of this service highly concerns the quality of the input images. If low-quality data is decided to be used, then the condition becomes far worse than 75% accuracy. However, when implementing in such environments that have limited resources, there is a great demand for computing space.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Smart Blind Stick for Enhanced Mobility and Independence of Visually Impaired Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study delves into the innovative design and development of a smart blind stick aimed at revolutionizing the mobility and independence of visually impaired individuals. Traditional white canes have long served as a primary aid for navigation, yet their limitations in detecting obstacles and providing real-time assistance underscore the necessity for a more advanced solution. The proposed smart blind stick integrates cutting-edge technologies such as ultrasonic sensors, artificial intelligence, fall detection and haptic feedback mechanisms to enhance the user’s spatial awareness and navigation experience. By leveraging ultrasonic sensors, the device accurately detects obstacles in the path and provide context-aware guidance. Furthermore, haptic feedback mechanisms deliver intuitive cues to the user, enabling them to distance their self from obstacles. When there is a sudden drop or falls, the accelerometer transmits data to GSM Module and send message notification to the user’s caretakers including the location. There is also an AI camera that allowed the caretaker’s to captured and view the surroundings of visually impaired through a mobile app. The design prioritizes user-centered principles, ensuring comfort, portability, and ease of use. Through rigorous development and iterative testing, the smart blind stick emerges as a promising tool to empower visually impaired individuals, fostering greater mobility, confidence, and independence in navigating their daily lives. The smart cane with overall user satisfaction of 4.11, proves the efficiency and effectiveness of it.

articleTitle: An Improved GPS Assisted Fishermen Tracking System Using Internet of Things with Smart Sensors Association
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research proposes a border alert system for fisherman that is based on the Internet of Things. As a result of their survival tactics, fisherman often unknowingly crosses international boundaries, putting themselves in danger of being seized or killed. The inability to reliably determine international maritime borders is the root source of this problem. This system aims to prevent such incidents and provide prior warning to fisherman about border regions by utilizing cutting-edge GPS and GSM technologies along with Internet of Things (IoT) monitoring. Protecting fishermen from harm is an implanted gadget that uses GPS to notify them to the country's boundaries. In this research, a novel approach to tracking fisherman using the Internet of Things (IoT) is presented; the IoTGPSTM model is cross-validated with the standard AGPST model to assess the effectiveness of the suggested scheme. The ESP8266 Wi-Fi module is used to transfer the obtained GPS position data to the IoT cloud. The navy may then track the data. If the boat's GPS coordinates are within the danger zone, an alarm will be heard through the buzzer, and the motor speed will be decreased to 25%. The fundamental concept is to use a GPS receiver module and a WiFi-enabled NodeMCU microcontroller to notify the fisherman when they are out at sea.

articleTitle: Ensuring IoT Network Integrity: Blockchain with Quadratic Discriminant Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: QDA (Quadratic discriminant analysis) in unison with blockchain technology can be said to be a spirited means of tightening the security of the IoT (Internet of Things) networks. This article attempts to empathize about the issues of information security, integrity, and privacy which arise for Internet of Things networks particularly while being used in the industrial context. Collecting real-time information in addition to analyzing and decision mechanisms, enterprises have been delivered entirely different thanks to the Internet of Things (IoT) networks. However, as they deal with so much sensitive information flow, the fast growth of IoT networks also places major security challenges at risk, involving potentially unauthorized access among others. In face of these issues, academics and industrial experts have tried to model novel approaches that will be used to enhance the IoT security networks. The integration of QDA and blockchain technology in order to overcome such problems is what will be the focal point of the research or we are going to focus on the integration of QDA and blockchain technology to solve the issues of the problem. The outcomes demonstrate the efficiency of the model to detect whether the suspicious network traffic is involved in dishonest activity or not by performing a set of metrics to assess performance. The result of the AUC-ROC was 0.98, and it signified a strong accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score for the model. To follow, the introduction of blockchain technology makes security even better by operating the decentralized and unchangeable record-keeping instruments that guarantee the safety of data, its confidentiality and integrity.

articleTitle: A Deep Neural Networks Model for Intrusion Detection in UNSW-NB15 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The data center and cloud computing systems integration have taken over more and more central tasks in our daily activities. Although it adds more commodes through more linkages, which also implies possibilities of breaches outside human control, cybersecurity is, therefore, an essential instrument to minimize the distortion of information. In that case, the design of a scalable and elastic IDS system would be recommended. It is based on the machine learning (DL frameworks). Such systems, however, use DNNs to attempt to see and the marking, tag and sort the network attacks whether these ones are foreseen or hazy with zero-day attack patterns included. These recordings provide the basis for the automatic implementation of a targeted attack and attack prevention with close to zero chances for success. Experiments are conducted using the UNSW-NB15 dataset that demonstrates similar behaviors to those currently observed on networks with attacks artificially introduced into it.

articleTitle: The U-Net Model and it’s Variants: A Revolution in Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Effective medical image segmentation is a crucial task for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning. An innovative approach combining manual masking with mathematical processing, where the objective is to refine training data, focusing the algorithm on relevant annotations. The mathematical function converts the area of interest pixel value into a specific colour while other region’s pixel values being converted to either 0 or [0,0,0]. Utilizing this mathematical methodology, a specialized dataset is masked, augmented, and trained on U-Net model. The Relative Root Mean Square Error is 0.2275.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning-based EfficientNet Model for Cassava Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Agriculture is the primary means of subsistence for a section of India’s population. It is a vital component of enhancing the country's economy and growth. The demand for food has increased due to the exponential growth of the world's population. Progressively, farmers are adopting various farming techniques that use artificial intelligence to meet this need and increase production. Crop health observation, plant disease recognition and discovery, and weather and commodity price forecasts are some of the most common uses of artificial intelligence. Manually identifying crop diseases, particularly on bigger farms with the assistance of specialists, may be a tedious and costly ordeal, and they constitute a danger to food safety. To tackle this problem, deep-learning methods provide automated procedure oversight, inspection, and robot guidance based on images, which can effectively control pests and diseases. In the proposed work, a cassava leaf disease detection model based on the EfficientNet model has been developed. The cassava leaf disease categorization was performed using a Kaggle dataset. The accuracy of the proposed model was resulted as 92.83%, whereas, the lowest loss of 0.2019 at epoch 16 has been analyzed.

articleTitle: Sign Language to Speech Conversion using Esp32
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Communicating is the only way we can express ourselves or convey information, yet persons with impairments such as the deaf and dumb, struggle to communicate with others. Many deaf and dumb people rely on sign language as their primary form of communication. The goal of the paper is to create a system that uses an ESP32 microcontroller, flex sensors, and a GSM module to interpret sign language movements into speech. The flex sensors detect movements of the hands, which are subsequently processed by the ESP32 to determine the associated sign language gesture. This data will be transformed into spoken output using software. The software may assist individuals who are hard of hearing or deaf by translating sign language into audible speech in real time. It uses a GSM module to send text messages to mobile phones that are far from the individuals. Hence, the proposed system assists the deaf and dumb people by Sign Language to Speech Conversion.

articleTitle: The advanced adder generated using modified square root with AND-OR invert logic
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)

authors.preferredName: G. S. S. S. S. V Krishna Mohan
authors.firstName: G. S. S. S. S. V Krishna

abstract: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division are employed in the microelectronic system. Addition is a fundamental mathematical operation and deemed suspicious, yet the other operations are derived from it. Mobile computing and interaction are a fast-growing technology; thus, a low-power VLSI system is proposed to boost arithmetic operators' efficiency. Adder subsystem innovation is a crucial concern in processing unit VLSI designs. The Error Tolerant Adder outperforms the other adders in power consumption, area, and propagation latency. Using the right computing paradigm to construct an error-tolerant adder from hardware affects performance measures, notably application accuracy. The proposed square root with AND-OR invert logic model represents the three basic adders by the new notion of tolerance for errors in digital VLSI design. For model extension, Kogge-Stone adders are utilized. The model optimizes power, area, and switching activity by improving conventional Kogge-stone adders utilizing Ripple Carry Adders (RCAs) with better selector unit and modified error tolerant adder selector-based design. Compared to approximation adders, the proposed approach decreases latency, power breakdown, and dispersion in a digital circuit, area, power delay product (PDP), energy-delay product (EDP), and area delay product (ADP). It also enhances peak-signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) for picture blending applications.

Author Keywords: modified error tolerant adder selector-based design
modified square root with AND-OR invert logic

articleTitle: Performance Study of various SPWM Technique for Single phase H-Bridge Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive performance study of different carrier-based pulse width modulation (CBPWM) methods for a single-phase H-bridge inverter. The operation of unipolar and bipolar PWM techniques for Sine PWM (SPWM) and Third Harmonic Injection PWM (THIPWM) are studied for a single-phase H-bridge inverter. Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) is considered as the main performance parameter for evaluating various PWM methods. THD performance for each method is observed for different switching frequencies. The implementation of unipolar, bipolar SPWM and third harmonic injection PWM methods are carried out on a DSP [TMS320F28089D]. The experimental results of output voltage for different PWM techniques are illustrated with harmonic spectrum for a single-phase H-bridge inverter. It is observed that the THD of unipolar THIPWM method is the least among the unipolar and bipolar strategies for both SPWM and THIPWM methods and it decreases with increase in switching frequency.

articleTitle: Unequal Power Combiner/Divider for Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The design and analysis of a wideband power combiner/divider to be used as beamforming networks, are discussed in this paper. Efficiently splitting or combining radio frequency signals over a wide frequency range with the least amount of loss and maximum isolation is the main objective of the proposed work. The resultant design provides a workable solution for current and future wireless communication systems by improving signal directionality and reducing interference. The unequal power combining and division has been achieved from a planar structure. The Resulting Performance parameter in terms of S-parameters (reflection coefficient, isolation, and transmission coefficient) has been projected.

articleTitle: Captcha Recognition Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: CAPTCHAs, a stand-in for Fully Automated Public Turing Tests to Tell Computers and Humans Apart, are an essential tool in internet security that can distinguish between automated bots and real people. Although successful in blocking automated attacks, conventional CAPTCHA recognition techniques frequently fail because of intrinsic flaws like low identification accuracy and susceptibility to changing attack tactics. This work investigates the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to automate the solution of CAPTCHAs in response. When compared to conventional procedures, these automated techniques have demonstrated notable gains in accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: Smart Inverters in Low Voltage Networks: Impact Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study evaluates different control strategies for smart inverters to mitigate voltage profile impacts caused by high photovoltaic distributed generation penetration in low voltage networks. Strategies tested include constant power factor, Volt-Watt, and Volt-Var control. Overall, all strategies successfully reduced voltage levels when exceeding nominal values. However, the power factor strategy achieved the closest voltage to 1 p.u. but at the cost of injecting excessive reactive power and increasing losses. Volt-Watt control limited active power injection, diminishing environmental and economic benefits. Volt-Var control, while not restricting generation, performed similarly to Volt-Watt but injected reactive power more efficiently. Identifying the optimal strategy requires balancing factors like losses, economic returns, and voltage profile closeness to 1 p.u. Future research could explore microgrid modeling to enable converter communication for optimal strategy selection. Additionally, investigating mixed control strategies, such as varying between Volt-Watt and VoltVar based on connection point voltage levels, could provide further insights.

articleTitle: Exploring Support Vector Machine and K-Nearest Neighbors for Pigeonpea Leaf Image Disease Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Plant diseases create a significant threat to nearly all -important plant species. Pigeonpea (Cajanus cajan(L.) Millsp), a member of the Fabaceae family. In the semi-arid tropics and subtropics of Asia and Africa, it is a vital legume shrub. However, over 100 diseases, including bacteria, nematodes, viruses, and fungus, attack this crop and cause economic harm. Several times, farmers have been unable to recognize the real disease occurrence and have been unable to manage it, resulting in markable yield reduction with regard to both quality and quantity. Smart agriculture has been used to control pests and eradicate plant diseases. Majority of these methods rely on machine learning or deep learning models as a method of providing disease detection solutions. This paper presents an image processing and machine-learning approach to the discovery of Pigeonpea leaf disease and its classification. In order to test the model proposed, a comprehensive dataset with images of healthy and diseased Pigeonpea leaves was constructed. A unique fusion of CLAHE, Retinex, FFT, and Gaussian algorithm was used for the enhancement of Pigeonpea leaf image. Machine learning classifying techniques SVM and KNN were applied for leaf classification. Accuracy, F1-score, precision and recall were used to determine the efficacy of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Development of a Drowse and Erratic Driving Detection Dashcam using Haar Cascade
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study aims to create and design a Smart Dashcam with a Drowsy and Erratic Driving Detector, incorporating features not commonly found in current dashcam models. The development of the system involves the algorithm design, Haar Cascade. This algorithm uses a total of 68 face landmarks that were used in detecting a person's face in real-time. This Smart Dashcam with Drowse and Erratic Driving Detector specifically detects the eyes and mouth of the driver even at night. A GPS module was also integrated into the system for the additional feature of the dashcam such as speed monitoring, location monitoring, and data transmission. The speed monitoring feature determined the erratic driving detection of the device, and all data gathered was sent to the designated cloud server such as the ThingSpeak. The Smart Dashcam with Drowse and Erratic Driving Detector successfully incorporated multiple innovative features. For drowsy driving detection, it utilized real-time facial recognition and showed good results in detecting drowsy driving even at night by utilizing a web camera. The GPS module demonstrated its capability to accurately detect the driver's current location using latitude and longitude coordinates. After all, it was concluded that the Smart Dashcam with Drowse and Erratic Driving Detector can be improved by customizing the triggering threshold for consistency and accuracy.

articleTitle: EDA and Sequential Neural Networks using a Synergistic Approach to Enzyme Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Combine Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) with a Neural Network (NN) model, this research presents a detailed method for enzyme categorization. In order to classify enzymes in a test set of 253,146 samples, the model uses a dataset consisting of 858,777 labelled amino acid sequences from 10 different species, removing any sequences that are too long. In the preprocessing step, we take into consideration the amino acids (B, Z) that are unique to the training set and remove the uncommon ones (X, U, B, and Z). With an impressive 79% accuracy on the test set after 20 epochs, the Neural Network architecture—which includes an embedding layer, bidirectional LSTM layers, and a dense output layer— produces encouraging results. The effectiveness of the approach is demonstrated by a comprehensive classification report and confusion matrix covering 20 different enzyme classes. By improving enzyme classification approaches, this work proves that bioinformatics and molecular biology benefit greatly from integrating EDA and NN. Investigating new features and optimisation techniques to further improve the model is the next step.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Master Controller for Robotic Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Robotic applications necessitate robust, compact, and adaptable computing solutions to address the demands of real-time control, data processing, and seamless integration with diverse sensors and actuators. This research work endeavors to harness the capabilities of the Raspberry Pi Compute Module to craft an optimized computing platform tailored explicitly for robotic applications. The aim is to give a solution that combines the processing power needed for advanced robotic functionality with the ecosystem flexibility of the Raspberry Pi. The system architecture mandates efficient communication between actuators, sensors, and the master controller. To facilitate this communication, protocols such as CAN Bus, I2C, and EtherCAT are employed. These protocols serve as the conduits through which data is transmitted to and from the respective slave devices. By integrating EtherCAT master firmware and middleware libraries, the system ensures seamless communication with EtherCAT slave devices, thereby guaranteeing deterministic operation and precise synchronization throughout the network.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Price Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The advent of cryptocurrencies, notably Bitcoin, has reshaped finance, introducing decentralized digital assets beyond traditional banking. As the crypto market matures, accurate price prediction becomes vital for investors. In order to develop a robust crypto price prediction model, this project uses machine learning and Python. Exploring the evolution of cryptocurrencies, particularly Bitcoin's inception in 2009, marked by secure blockchain transactions, underscores their global impact. The inherent volatility of the crypto market challenges traditional analysis, necessitating advanced tools. By integrating machine learning algorithms, the project aims to identify patterns and indicators, enhancing decision-making. Through leveraging Python's pliability in tandem with toolkits like scikit-learn, and Pandas, an adaptable arena is established for undertaking such endeavours. Beyond accurate predictions, the project contributes to the discourse on machine learning and deep learning in financial markets, addressing the demand for reliable cryptocurrency price forecasts. This research enriches financial technology, empowering participants in the dynamic realm of cryptocurrencies.

articleTitle: Forecasting Student Attrition Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Exploring the intricacies of student attrition in higher education, this study employs cutting-edge machine learning techniques alongside the Big Five model of personality traits. Utilizing data gathered through a widespread questionnaire with institutional consent, the research seeks to uncover the psychological and behavioral determinants driving dropout rates. Assessing the efficacy of machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), yields a remarkable accuracy rating of 96.25 Moreover, the investigation delves deep into the interplay between student attrition and key personality traits, such as time management and wellness, revealing a significant correlation coefficient of 0.8753. Through meticulous data scrutiny, pivotal links emerge, illuminating the pivotal role these traits play in curbing student attrition. This study’s findings offer invaluable insights to educational institutions, equipping them with tools to pinpoint at-risk students and enact tailored interventions. Emphasizing the necessity of holistic, interdisciplinary strategies for student retention, the research underscores the nuanced nature of student experiences, advocating for approaches that foster academic success

articleTitle: Diabetic Macular Edema Grading by Using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research aimed to develop and evaluate convolutional neural network (CNN) models for predicting edema in retinal images using the IDRiD dataset. Edema, a medical condition characterized by the abnormal accumulation of fluid in tissues, is a significant factor in diabetic retinopathy (DR), leading to vision impairment and blindness worldwide. Early detection and accurate prediction of edema in retinal images are crucial for effective management and treatment of diabetic retinopathy. The IDRiD dataset, a publicly available collection of retinal fundus images, was used for model training. The methodology comprised data preprocessing, model development, training, and evaluation using various CNN architectures. VGG16 demonstrated the highest test accuracy (71.25%), outperforming other architectures like VGG19 and ResNet variants. The discussion highlighted the importance of model performance, architecture comparison, robustness, and future optimization strategies. The study's findings contribute to the advancement of automated diagnostic tools for diabetic retinopathy, emphasizing the potential for improved patient care outcomes through accurate edema prediction in retinal imaging.

articleTitle: Detecting Reconnaissance Activities in IoT Networks Using UNB CIC-IOT 2023 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Cyberattacks are becoming more common at an exponential rate, coinciding with the IoT ecosystem’s stratospheric ascent. Reconnaissance attacks are a crucial part of these dangers because they precede a lot of other negative activities. Because IoT devices and their communication protocols are so diverse and unique, reconnaissance attacks in IoT networks can be hard to detect. This research aims to provide an approach to reconnaissance threat identification that makes use of machine learning (ML). This research makes use of the UNB CIC-IOT 2023 dataset, which offers realistic settings for IoT network traffic. The data set is cleaned up to remove unnecessary information and identify important features before further processing. The next step is to build detection models and test them using various ML approaches including Naive Bayes (NB), Logistics Regression (LR), Adaptive Gradient Boosting (AdaBoost), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). Research shows that XGBoost provides the highest degree of accuracy. From what we can tell, a few of ML algorithms have promising detection capabilities. Different metrics, like as accuracy, recall, F1-score, and precision, have been utilised to assess the predictive usefulness of these models. It has been demonstrated through the data that the strategy that was utilised accurately identifies potential threats to the network and improves the capabilities of Internet of Things devices. Even though, LR, and AdaBoost each had accuracy rates of 71.42%, 86.45%, and 89.21%, respectively, the research showed that XGBoost had the highest accuracy, with a rate of 95.95% on average.

articleTitle: Precision Cardiology using CNN Autoencoder for Accurate ECG Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research study explores the application of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Autoencoders in identifying anomalies in electrocardiogram (ECG) data using the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database. The dataset contains 14,552 samples that are divided into two categories: normal heartbeats and heartbeats affected by cardiac abnormalities. The utilisation of Transposed Convolution has significantly improved the model's performance. This study emphasises the critical need to quickly detect cardiac abnormalities and presents a CNN Autoencoder model designed to efficiently encode and decode ECG data, enabling the detection of irregular patterns. Constructing a robust Autoencoder with encoder and decoder components is essential in this process. The goal is to train these components to minimise errors in reconstruction. The assessment measures showcase the model's impressive accuracy (76.93%), precision (55.23%), recall (89.81%), and F1 score (65.40%). This study highlights the importance of utilising deep learning methods to detect abnormalities in ECG data at an early stage. This approach demonstrates significant promise in enhancing diagnostic abilities and enhancing patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Thermal cut off & SoC estimation of Battery for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: State-of-Charge (SOC) estimation plays a pivotal role in optimizing the performance, lifespan, and safety of rechargeable batteries in various applications. This paper presents a comprehensive review of SOC estimation techniques employed in Battery Management Systems (BMS). The study encompasses an in-depth analysis of traditional methods, such as voltage and current integration, as well as advanced approaches like Kalman filtering, neural networks, and machine learning algorithms. Furthermore, it discusses the challenges faced in accurate SOC estimation, including temperature variations, aging effects, and dynamic loads. The review critically evaluates the advantages and limitations of existing techniques and provides insights into potential future research directions aimed at enhancing the precision and reliability of SOC estimation methods.The thermal management of batteries is a critical aspect of ensuring their safe operation and longevity. This paper investigates various thermal cutoff mechanisms implemented in battery systems to prevent overheating, thermal runaway, and potential catastrophic failures. The study explores passive methods, such as heat sinks and phase change materials, as well as active techniques, including cooling fans and liquid cooling systems. Additionally, it delves into the role of advanced thermal cutoff devices like Positive Temperature Coefficient (PTC) thermistors and thermal fuses in safeguarding batteries from excessive temperatures. The paper also discusses the impact of operating conditions, such as charge-discharge rates and ambient temperature, on the effectiveness of thermal cutoff mechanisms.

articleTitle: IoT-Driven Solutions for Sustainable Street Lighting: A Hybrid Renewable Energy Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper establishes a new concept of the street lighting technique with a new renewable system, which is integrated with IoT. This system incorporates solar and wind power to provide a continuous energy source for street lighting. After an evaluation that spanned six months, the hybrid system saw marked enhancements in energy conservation, as well as a decrease in working expenses. The system cut the mean energy by 40% compared to the conventional street lighting systems; however, while the solar panels produced 60% of the energy, the wind turbines generated 40% of the remaining energy. This culminated in a stable and efficient power supply, features that can be credited for being erect even amidst altered environmental factors. The system had an ecological impact that led to a reduction of carbon emissions by approximately 30 per cent, thus supporting the state’s goal of environmental conservation. Through the application of IoT for monitoring and controlling, the efficiency of the operation was boosted due to real-time data collection for maintenance. This caused a reduction in the time during which the system was offline and an improvement in its reliability. In assessing the ROC curve, the area under the curve was termed AUC, which was equal to 0. The indices scaled down to the number 50, indicating the lowest level of performance. Also, the heatmap of the confusion matrix provided helpful information about the system's performance by maintaining an equal number of true positives and negatives. Specifically, generated energy was 300 kWh in January and increased to 550 kWh in June; energy consumption fluctuated between 200 and 250 kWh per month. In the test period, energy storage capacity escalates from 50kHz to 150 kHz, and energy saving increases progressively from 40% to 65%.

articleTitle: Gesture to Text Recognition using Deep Learning Approach with VGG16 and ResNet50 for Sign Language
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Sign language recognition (SLR) plays a crucial role in enabling communication for individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing. This study explores the application of two prominent deep learning models, VGG16 and ResNet50, in the context of SLR tasks. By employing these sophisticated architectures, we achieved remarkable accuracy rates of 99.92% with VGG16 and 99.95% with ResNet50 in identifying sign language gestures. Our research highlights the exceptional performance of these models in interpreting hand movements and gestures with high precision, thereby enhancing communication for sign language users. Through the application of cutting-edge deep learning methods, this study contributes to the ongoing advancement of SLR systems, offering exciting prospects for fostering inclusive communication and accessibility.

articleTitle: Rain Sensing Wipers With Raspberry Pico And Weather Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The Rain Sensing Wipers project aims to develop a smart automotive accessory that enhances driver safety and comfort by automating windshield wiper operation based on real-time rain and weather data. Utilizing Raspberry Pico microcontroller and weather sensors, the system monitors environmental conditions and adjusts wiper movement accordingly. The integration of rain sensors and the DHT11 sensor enables the system to accurately detect rain and assess temperature and humidity levels. When rain is detected, the system activates a servo motor to control the wiper movement, ensuring clear visibility for the driver. Furthermore, the system provides weather updates through an LCD display and alerts the driver with audible signals via a buzzer. This project demonstrates the potential of IoT technology to improve driving experiences by making them safer and more intuitive.

articleTitle: Yield Optimization in Agriculture Through Advanced Hyperspectral and Geospatial Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Integrating hyperspectral photography and geographic information systems data processing significantly enhances agricultural yields. This study aims to find out how the available technologies can be incorporated to strengthen the crop's health, increase efficiency in the usage of resources, and improve the precision of the yields. What is hyperspectral imaging? It is a method of collecting wealthy spectral data over many bands. This can help in the early detection of crop stress and nutrient deficiencies at a very high degree of accuracy of up to 92—5%. Analyzing geographical information systems (GIS) and remote sensing data proved that the indicators could be mapped accurately, making a 15 % reduction in the efficient consumption of resources such as water fertilizer and pesticides. The integration method was as simple as overlaying spectral data on geographical maps, which led to the creation of complex spatial representations of the health of crops. The gathered data were processed using machine learning approaches, resulting in models with a prediction accuracy of 90%. 1%, while the recall stood at 88. 7%. Many crop types and regions showed high reliability of the models, providing valuable insights for the farmer's and policy makers’ work. The findings agree with the notion that these technologies present some hope. However, the application of these technologies faces some difficulties, such as the necessity of high-quality input data and complex processing algorithms.

articleTitle: Design a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor [PMSM] for Electric Vehicles with a Capacity of 700 kg and a Speed of 60 km per hour
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the search for efficient and powerful electric vehicles (EVs), the development of permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM) plays an important role. This article discusses the design and optimization of high-performance PMSMs specific to electric vehicles. We present a 3 kW PMSM model and discuss the initial design, requirements and dimensions required for efficient EV operation. In this study, finite element model is used to analyze electromagnetic and operating conditions. We also optimized the size and position of magnets, which are important for PMSM performance, and compared the results with conventional machines. Research results show the importance of the PMSM model to improve EV efficiency and driving performance.

articleTitle: Implementing CNNs with Federated Learning for Enhanced Detection of Papaya Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this paper, a novel technique known as Federated Learning (FL) is employed to diagnose and classify papaya leaf diseases with the aid of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). For the model training, it was employed with the Federated Averaging (FedAvg) which involved training the model in multiple scattered clients. This technique was adopted to prevent leakage of users’ information and to minimize the amount of data transferred within the network. The focused diseases that the study entailed were five main diseases of papaya leaves and each of them was categorized into five levels of disease intensity for the study so that accurate identification of the diseases as well as the development of accurate strategies in disease management could be enhanced. The CNN model that was created resulted in an overall classification accuracy of 92%. The accuracy of the plant diseases ranged from 87% in Powdery mildew and 92% in Papaya Leaf Distortion Mosaic Virus. The study highlights the effectiveness of the model in effective diagnosis and differentiation of different diseases which are so vital as to provide help for efficient treatments within the agricultural sector. Additionally, scalability and privacy issues were significantly favorable to FL configuration, which is essential to improving the utilization of technology in agriculture fields that are often particular or widespread. However, the research also noted challenges about how to handle the variety of the data as well as the extra communication overhead that persists in the definition of Federated Learning. The severe problems mentioned above show that more efforts need to be invested in the research for better approaches to the management of data and improving the robustness of models in different agricultural conditions.

articleTitle: Design of Compact Tri Band Antenna for Satellite Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In this paper presents the design and analysis of a tri-band microstrip antenna for satellite applications. The antenna had a total dimension of 15 x 20 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with substrate dielectric constant as 2.2 with 2.4 thickness, and the antenna model contains truncated rectangular patch along with two E-shaped radiators. The antenna model is simulated using Computer Simulation Technology (CST) software. The antenna achieves triple band performance, effectively covering the frequency bands of 7.5GHz, 12.5GHz, and 16GHz simultaneously. Through analysis and simulation, the designed antenna demonstrates excellent return loss characteristics of - 21.0dB, -19.0dB, and -16.5dB at the respective frequency bands. This indicates strong impedance matching and efficient power transfer. The compact size and lightweight nature of the microstrip antenna make it suitable for integration into various communication and satellite systems.

articleTitle: Advanced Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Driving: Performance Insights from DQN and PPO
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Self-driving cars imply a major revolution in the transport industry to create new safer, less congested, and more effective ways of traveling around. Critical to these developments are reinforcement learning (RL) architectures including Deep Q-Networks (DQN) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) that allow self-driving cars to learn within challenging traffic conditions. The performance comparison of DQN and PPO in the studied autonomous driving scenarios such as lane keeping, obstacle avoidance, traffic signal recognition, and dynamic lane changing is given in this research paper. Assessments of these algorithms are done by safety, efficiency, smoothness, and flexibility parameters within a detailed simulation model. The results presented in this paper indicate that PPO surpasses DQN in all aspects and cases. Thus, positioning PPO as a policy-based approach that withstands noise, chaos, and continuous action space, evidently shows lesser collisions with the environment, less time taken to complete the tasks, smooth vehicle movements, and better responsiveness when facing change in the environment. On the other hand, DQN is successful in environments where the number of possible actions is not massive, nevertheless, in complex and continuous environments, it becomes problematic; with many oscillatory movements in the training process and is very sensitive to the batch size. Therefore, this dissertation adds value to the current knowledge of RL algorithms particularly to autonomous driving situating PPO as a top option for dynamic driving conditions. Potential topics for future studies consist of the combination of DQN and PPO, in the hierarchical or transfer learning methods to make those techniques more scalable and robust.

articleTitle: Real-Time Anomaly Detection and Data Integrity in Hospitals Using Blockchain and AI
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The advancement in technology means that most healthcare facilities are now going digital, causing concern over health information security, privacy, and integrity. This research focuses on applying Blockchain with Artificial Intelligence to promote security in managing health information. The proposed architecture is based on the essence of Blockchain to offer data integrity and the usage of AI models for real-time monitoring and threat identification. A 97% accuracy was obtained using a Random Forest model with a simulated data set. It also demonstrated the Precision of 0 and the Recall value of 0. 97 and 0. 99 for standard access patterns and 0 for any other access patterns not included in Figure 1. 92 and 0. Regarding the hyperparameters, we chose n_estimators= 85 for the anomaly detection model. The AUC value, which stands at 0, indicates that the models perform excellently and can be used in clinical practice. R-squared of 0. 95 shows that the model tested can accurately classify the two classes. Concerning the confusion matrix, studies showed a positive rate of 99% and a false positive rate of 1%. 5% is a strong example of the model for preventing present security breaches. The evaluation of feature importance showed that among all the analyzed features, the object’s access location and user ID were the most valuable signals for detecting outliers. The Blockchain layer ensured that every interaction with patients and data regarding them was indelibly documented, enhancing the data's credibility and creating a complete register of alterations to the information.

articleTitle: An Optimized FIR Filter Design for Noise Reduction in Bio-Medical Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In Bio-medical applications, signals like Electro-Oculogram, is a type of biological signal, measuring the parameters of human being’s eye. It requires an optimized method for EOG signal processing for obtaining parameters in a better manner. By using the CSD (Canonical Signed Digit) technique, which is one of the distributed arithmetic methodologies, an efficient hardware can be designed especially for signal processing like Finite Impulse Response (FIR) Filters. The design of FIR filter in which CSD technique is incorporated can minimize the number of adders in the architecture. To improve performance of filters these adders are replaced with Parallel Prefix Adders. The proposed method improves the accuracy of EOG signal processing and reduces delay. Finally, we have deduced a comparative investigation with max delay, min delay, and other resource-specific parameters and presented them to show the computational efficiency of our FIR design using CSD and PPA.

articleTitle: Pill Dispenser for Elderly Care using IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper is to construct to ease the medicine consumption for elderly who forgets the medicine on time. Thousands of cases were affected due to wrong consumption of medicine. This paper aims to construct the automatic pill dispenser for elderly that indicates the alarm between time intervals and records the medicine dispenses and sent the messages to care taker, guardian and doctors through IOT (Things speak and blynk application. The IOT-based pill dispenser is equipped with a microcontroller, sensors, actuators, and a secure network connection, enabling automated medication dispensing at scheduled times. Users, especially those with complex medication regimens or cognitive impairments, benefit from timely and accurate doses, reducing the risk of missed medications. Facial/Finger print recognition technology is integrated into the system to ensure medication administration to the correct patient. Users are identified through facial /finger print biometrics, ensuring that only authorized individuals can access the medication. In cases of unauthorized access or medication errors, the system generates alerts for caregivers or healthcare providers, thus enhancing patient safety. Users must register on the system, providing their personal details, medication prescriptions, dosages, and schedules. This information is stored securely in a database associated with the user's account. Each user is provided with a smart pill dispenser device, which is connected to the internet via Wi-Fi or cellular network. The dispenser has compartments for different medications, each equipped with sensors and actuators for pills [1]The user loads the dispenser with their prescribed medications, ensuring that each medication is placed in the correct compartment.

articleTitle: Neural Network Based Optimization of OFDM System for 5G Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The 5G communication is well known for its very high data rates and promising connectivity. This is achieved by employing the OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) technique for data transmission. However, it is prone to bit errors taking place in the noisy channel resulting in increase in BER (Bit Error Rate) which gives a poor quality of the received signal. In the present work, first of all, a traditional OFDM system is implemented for 5G system using MATLAB, and its BER is investigated. Finally, for improving the BER, the demodulator of this OFDM system is optimized using ANN (Artificial Neural Network) implemented in MATLAB. A comparison of the value of BER value achieved in both the cases is also presented.

articleTitle: A Novel Python Based Fake Jobs Post Identification And Analysis Methodology Using Elevated Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Online job boards and portals have grown in popularity in recent years, making it easier and more effective for people to look for work. False job ads have proliferated with the advent of digital transformation, which is both an opportunity and a threat. People looking for work may fall victim to these misleading listings, which can lead them astray, waste their time, and expose them to scams. The research presents Elevated Learning based Fake Job Prediction (ELFJP), a claim that utilizes learning based classification algorithms to stop fake job advertisements on the internet. To assess the effectiveness of the suggested method, it is cross-validated using a traditional learning model known as Random Forest Classifier (RFC). We find the best job fraud detection model by comparing the results of different classifiers. Web fraud may be detected and prevented with the help of these classifiers. In a sea of seemingly legitimate job ads, it helps to single out the fraudulent ones. This system is able to identify fake job ads on the web by integrating classifiers with an ensemble learning model and then comparing and evaluating the results. In light of the ever-changing strategies used by con artists, the research stresses the significance of being proactive. To keep up with ever-changing fraud tactics, machine learning models are continuously improved and adjusted. The ultimate aim of this proposed approach is to help make a safer online job market by reducing the likelihood of fraudulent ads and increasing confidence among those looking for work.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Multi-Charging Portable Power Generator with Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study focuses on the design and development of a portable power generator that can be charged using multiple sources of energy integrated with a mobile application for monitoring and control purposes. The study uses PZEM 004T as a power meter for AC that is integrated with the ESP32 microcontroller together with a MAX741 voltage and current sensor for DC power. The data from the sensors were processed inside the ESP32 and will be feed to the mobile applications via WiFi connection and will be displayed at the user interface of the mobile application. The system can be charged from both AC outlet using an AC to DC adapter and a Solar panel that produces a 12V DC. During the testing of the developed portable power generator it shows a favorable result with an accuracy of 99% on reading the electrical parameters of the test loads. The researchers had also successfully integrated the real-time monitoring using google sheets that can be viewed anywhere. Using the mobile application the user could access and control the operation of the system as well as monitor the status of the system especially the battery capacity and remaining charging time. Upon completion of the study it is recommended to enhance the mobile application interface of the system adding security as to the user of the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Magnetic Resonance images for the detection of Alzheimer's
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study aims to design a CAD tool for Alzheimer's disease (AD) detection using linear SVM classifiers on MRI scans. Existing approaches often face challenges with high-dimensional feature spaces and limited data accessibility from repositories like ADNI. To overcome these, three SVM-based classifier proposals were explored. Results demonstrated promising accuracy, sensitivity (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</inf>), and specificity (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>), particularly with cross-validation techniques. Notably, classifiers trained with image histograms showed superior performance in differentiating between AD, cognitively normal (CN), and mild cognitive impairment (MCI). Despite successes, initial approaches encountered difficulties, necessitating alternative methods. Challenges in data access and processing highlight the need for improved data management tools. Moving forward, refinements such as feature selection and testing with larger datasets could enhance classifier performance. Exploring deep neural networks as an extension may offer further insights into AD detection methodologies for early diagnosis and intervention.

articleTitle: Advanced Converter Topologies for Efficient Electric Vehicle-to-Load Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents an investigation into advanced converter topologies aimed at enhancing the integration of electric vehicles (EVs) with load systems. With the growing adoption of EVs, efficient bidirectional power flow between vehicles and various loads, such as residential homes and commercial buildings, becomes increasingly crucial. Traditional converter designs may not fully optimize this integration. Thus, this research explores novel converter architectures tailored to facilitate seamless and efficient electric vehicle-to-load integration. By analyzing the requirements and challenges associated with bidirectional power transfer, the study identifies key features and characteristics necessary for advanced converter topologies. Through simulation studies and experimental validation, the proposed converter designs demonstrate improved efficiency, reduced losses, and enhanced performance in supporting bidirectional power flow between EVs and load systems. The findings of this research contribute to the development of more efficient and reliable solutions for integrating electric vehicles into diverse load environments.

articleTitle: Synergistic Approach of Convolutional Neural Networks and Ensemble Methods for Effective Identification of Spinach Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The management of plant diseases plays a critical role in guaranteeing food security on a global scale and promoting sustainable agricultural practices. This study introduces an innovative method for categorizing Alternaria leaf spot disease in spinach leaves by utilizing a hybrid deep learning model that merges Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Support Vector Machines (SVMs). By utilizing a dataset of 1200 spinach leaf images sourced from Kaggle, which includes 600 healthy and 600 unhealthy samples, our model is designed to effectively distinguish between healthy and diseased spinach leaves. The hybrid model structure consists of three sets of convolutional and max-pooling layers, followed by flattening and dropout regularization to prevent overfitting. Subsequently, the extracted feature representations are fed into an SVM classifier for disease classification. The prevention and control of plant diseases are highly vital to the achievement of food security at a global level as well as to the promotion of sustainability in agricultural practices. The model that we use in our study has its efficacy assessed on a specific dataset to guarantee the model's prediction, i.e., it is neither underpredicted nor overpredicted. This hybrid approach using CNNs' feature learning capabilities and SVMs' discriminative power results in an effective model for classifying spinach diseases. We demonstrate through extensive testing and evaluation that our methodology accurately detects Alternaria leaf spot disease in spinach leaves, providing a viable solution for automated disease identification in agriculture.

articleTitle: VGG19's Role in Safeguarding Coral Reefs using a CNN-Based Monitoring Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The use of Transfer Learning and Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to the preservation of coral reefs is the subject of this investigation. To do this, it introduces a dataset of 923 images that label corals as healthy or bleached. This research presents a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based automated photo classification model with the goal of automating the laborious task of manually recognising coral reefs. Given the critical role that coral reefs play and the challenges they encounter, including coral bleaching, this is of utmost importance. This method makes use of training, validation, and test datasets, as well as the VGG19 pre-trained CNN model. Callbacks are used to implement model monitoring. Model hyperparameters like batch size, epochs, and input shape are defined directly. The classification report, confusion matrix, and accuracy are common metrics utilised for evaluating machine learning. In terms of efficiency, scalability, and real-time monitoring, the study emphasises the benefits of the proposed paradigm. Positive results, such as a 74% accuracy rate, show that CNNs can quickly detect coral reefs and monitor their health. In order to make educated judgements and launch conservation efforts, this is crucial.

articleTitle: Verilog Based Efficient Traffic Light System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Traffic management is crucial for reducing congestion, minimizing delays, and ensuring safety at intersections. This paper presents the design and verification of an efficient Traffic Light System using Verilog Language. The system controls traffic at a four-way intersection, considering vehicle counts, pedestrian requests, and emergency signals. The design is implemented using a Finite State Machine (FSM) approach, with a comprehensive testbench developed to validate its functionality under various scenarios. The results demonstrate the system's ability to manage traffic efficiently, respond to pedestrian crossings, and handle emergency situations, thereby improving overall traffic flow and safety. The system's adaptability and responsiveness highlight its potential for real-world applications, addressing the limitations of traditional traffic light systems. Also, Verilog HDL ensures that the system is robust, scalable, and capable of being integrated into larger traffic management frameworks.

articleTitle: Improving Alzheimer's Disease Outcomes: Machine Learning Approaches to Predictive Diagnostics with CNN-SVM Hybrid Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The method for creating and testing a machine learning model to differentiate between the preclinical and severe phases of Alzheimer's disease is presented in this research. Depending on the patient’s data, the model employs extensive data and effective algorithms to differentiate matter phases. A confusion matrix evaluates the model and other vital statistical measures like accuracy, recall, and F1-score. articleTitle: Enhancement of Model Driven Software Development using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The future of the MDSD in this emerging scenario of software engineering is that models are completely converted into Code i.e. program which are completely developed from high-level models, each one representing a various aspects of the parts of system. This work investigates the use of cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) methods to produce UML diagrams, which are essential for software engineering's system architecture visualization. Our methodology, which is based on machine learning algorithms such as natural language processing (NLP) and deep learning, is a reliable approach to automate the generation of UML diagrams from textual software requirements. Our methodology entails preprocessing textual input, using graph-based techniques to create cohesive UML diagrams, and using NLP models to extract important entities and relationships .The system's ability to handle several UML diagram types—such as use case, sequence, and class diagrams— ensures thorough coverage of software design requirements. Our AI-driven approach dramatically lowers manual labor, improves accuracy, and expedites the modeling process, as shown by many testing. The findings point to a viable path for incorporating AI into software development, which might revolutionize current procedures by giving engineers and developers access to an effective tool.

articleTitle: MindWell Solace: Your Mental Health Companion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper introduces "MindWell Solace: Your Mental Health Companion," a Flask-based chatbot application designed to address the critical need for mental health support among college students. The chatbot acts as an intermediary between students and college counselors, engaging in conversations based on symptoms of mental disorders to detect potential issues. Using Firebase for efficient data storage, the chatbot notifies counselors via email when a disorder is detected, facilitating timely intervention. The methodology involved extensive research on prevalent student mental health disorders, ontology creation, questionnaire development, and dataset training using the Random Forest Classifier. Key features include disorder detection, counselor notifications, user privacy prioritization, and effective support delivery. This research underscores the importance of integrating technology to address mental health challenges in educational settings, with potential for broader community impact and continuous improvement through future enhancements.

articleTitle: Five Shades of BERT: Assessing Performance in Question Answering through Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) model has transformed natural language processing, achieving great results across a wide range of applications. In this research paper, we conduct a comprehensive comparative analysis of the five BERT models and their performance for question answering tasks. For the purpose of our comparison, the models we have chosen are BERT, RoBERTa, ELECTRA, ALBERT and DistilBERT. Our methodology involves fine-tuning these models using the SQuAD dataset for extractive question answering tasks and evaluating their performance based on their training and validation losses. Our research provides insights into the similarities, differences and results of fine-tuning on the different BERT models. Our findings provide guidance for selecting an appropriate BERT model to utilise its full potential in real-world applications such as question answering tasks as NLP continues to evolve.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Agricultural Environment Monitoring System Based on LoRa and NB-IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Given the pervasive application of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, current agricultural production environment monitoring often relies on wired communication or traditional wireless methods like WiFi, Bluetooth, and ZigBee, which are fraught with complications such as complex wiring, limited range, and stability issues. This paper presents the construction of a wireless sensor network leveraging LoRa and NB-IoT technologies. The STM32F103RET6 microcontroller serves as the central processing unit, facilitating the deployment of multiple sensors throughout the agricultural production environment, enabling the collection of diverse environmental parameters, and facilitating their transmission to an IoT cloud platform via the newly established wireless network. The system aims to achieve visual management of the agricultural production environment and to control the environment both manually and automatically, thereby providing optimal conditions for crop growth. The test results demonstrate that the system’s network stability is robust, and both the data transmission reliability and data acquisition accuracy align with the established design specifications.

articleTitle: Estimation of Epidemic Contact Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The entire globe is now under the shade of the COVID-19 pandemic, which adversely affects normal human life and their socializing behavior. To break the spread of disease across society, a scientific approach must be evolved. Major strategies to break this spreading chain are contact tracing and modeling the epidemic diffusion. The pandemic spread can be perfectly modeled in the vertex domain using a contact network graph. Contact network enables to identify those contacts who are more susceptible to disease. This research work aims to learn contact network using the Gaussian Markov Random field (GMRF) model and Maximum Likeihood (ML) estimation. Synthetic data is generated using Susceptible-Infected-Recovered (SIR) and Susceptible-Exposed-Infected-Recovered (SEIR) mathematical models. Optimized the results using Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM), Combinatorial Graph Laplacian (CGL), Majorization-Minimization (MM) and Convex Optimization(CVX). Results show that, among the optimization algorithms adopted, CVX outperforms the others.

articleTitle: Advanced Fruit Sorting: Pre-trained ResNet50 Model for Rotten and Fresh Fruit Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning techniques have gained considerable attention in various fields, including image classification tasks. ResNet50 is a pre-trained convolutional neural network architecture, that has demonstrated remarkable performance in image recognition tasks due to its deep structure and skip connections, which alleviate the vanishing gradient problem. In the proposed work, the fine-tuning of the pre-trained ResNet50 model on the fruit dataset has been performed to adapt it to the specific classification task. The results indicate that the ResNet50 model outperforms other models in terms of classification accuracy and robustness. The aim of the model is to accurately classify various rotten and fresh fruits which is a tedious task if done manually. The ResNet50 architecture has proven to be highly effective in image classification tasks due to its deep layers and residual connections, allowing for better feature representation and learning. This model was trained on a dataset containing images of different fresh fruits and rotten fruits, encompassing various shapes, sizes, and colours. Through rigorous experimentation and training, the model achieved a testing accuracy of 93.41%, indicating the model's robustness and capability to generalize better results on unseen data. Additionally, the loss value of 0.1814 demonstrates the model's ability to minimize errors during testing. The results highlight the effectiveness of leveraging deep learning techniques, particularly the ResNet50 architecture, for fruit classification tasks, which holds promise for practical applications in the agriculture and food industry.

articleTitle: Novel Methods for Area Optimization in Static Circuits via IRL Interpreter in T-Spice
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The Information Reversal Logic (IRL) or reversal logics has garnered considerable attention as a burgeoning research area with potential applications across various domains. This paper focuses on implementing different types of static circuits—such as full-adders, full-subtractors, multiplexers, and comparators—using reversal interpreter circuits with minimal quantum gate costs. The reversal interpreter is built using Asher Peres Gate, Controlled-Swap gate, inverter gate and etc. The benefits of these reversal logic gates are efficiency in minimizing quantum gate usage. Information reversal logic is distinguished by the equivalence of input and output lines, ensuring that for an (n, k) function where ‘n’ number of inputs/outputs equal k’’ number of inputs/outputs. This characteristic facilitates both forward and backward operations, enabling the retrieval of inputs from outputs.
