Yet, the XGBoost model demonstrates an accuracy level of up to 98.95%.

articleTitle: Vending Machine Using Verilog (FPGA)
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The design and implementation of a vending machine system using Verilog HDL on an FPGA board. The vending machine is equipped with multiple states including product selection, amount selection, dispensing, out-of-stock detection, refund processing, change calculation, and system reset. The project aims to demonstrate the integration of hardware description language (Verilog) with FPGA technology to create a functional vending machine prototype.The design process involved the decomposition of the vending machine's functionality into smaller modules, each responsible for a specific task. These modules were then integrated to form the complete system. The Finite State Machine (FSM) methodology was employed to model the different states and transitions within the vending machine, ensuring sequential operation and proper functionality.

articleTitle: Beam Sweeping and Beam Selection Using Neural Network Based Approach For Millimeter Wave Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Next generation wireless communication uses millimeter wave (mmWave) band which offers an exceptional opening for increasing the data rate and throughput. Millimeter wave bands suffer from poor propagation losses. Because of these losses it is difficult to obtain channel state information (CSI) accurately. Accurate alignment of transmitter and receiver can be done by the ‘beam sweeping’ and then ‘beam selection’ procedure mentioned in the 5G NR standard. Because of dynamic nature of the wireless channel the transceiver needs to be continuously updated for these changes and hence there is a need for a network which learns itself from the history or training samples as input. Several machine learning based channel estimation schemes are proposed in the literature. The advantage of the accurate channel estimation comes at the cost of complex system structure and reduced energy efficiency. Different types of beam management methods like analog, digital and combination of it Hybrid methods are proposed in standards. To start the research work, authors have studied analog beamforming design with two neural network viz., generator and discriminator forming Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). The neural network is trained with the samples containing GPS location of the receiver and optimal beam pair index. The performance of the model is evaluated for top-K accuracy of selecting beam from K beam pairs, with highest Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP), spectral and energy efficiency plots. By simulating the environment in MATLAB authors found that proposed model achieves nearly 90% accuracy with the less than half beam pair index only compared to other exhaustive search algorithms.

articleTitle: Analysis of Pseudo Static Domino Logic with Diode-Connected Footer Transistors
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Pseudo-static domino logic is widely used in dynamic logic design due to its power efficiency, fast operation, compact design, clock control, and improved noise margin. A comprehensive investigation of the effects of diode-connected devices in pseudo-static domino logic circuit is presented in this work. Through a combination of simulations and analytical modelling, the study explores the advantages and limitations of incorporating diode-connected footers in pseudo-static domino logic circuits compared to conventional domino logic styles. The result shows that pseudo-static domino logic circuits with diode-connected footers consume significantly less power and exhibit enhanced noise margins. This study also provides insights into the trade-offs associated with incorporating additional diode connected footers in conventional domino logic.

articleTitle: A ResNet50 Pre-trained Deep Learning Model for Flower Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Flower classification plays a vital role in various domains, including agriculture, botany, and ecology by facilitating the identification and categorization of different floral species. In recent years, the advancement of deep learning techniques has revolutionized image classification tasks, offering powerful tools for automated flower recognition. In this study, we proposed a ResNet50 model for the classification of different types of flowers. The ResNet50 model is known for its depth and effectiveness in capturing intricate features from raw image data, making it well-suited for complex classification tasks. To achieve accurate flower classification, we leverage the pre-trained ResNet50 model, which has been trained on a large-scale dataset called ImageNet, to extract high-level features from flower images. Transfer learning is employed to fine-tune the model on a specific flower dataset, thereby adapting it to the nuances and characteristics of floral imagery. The dataset used for training and evaluation contains images of various flower species, with annotated labels for supervised learning. In the experimentation process, it has been analyzed that the performance of the ResNet50 model in terms of training and test accuracy has been achieved as 99% and 95.1%, respectively. Additionally, the examination of the model’s ability to generalise to unseen data and discuss any challenges or limitations encountered during the classification process have been also mentioned.

articleTitle: Development of High-Capacity DWDM-FSO system using HG beams
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) is realized as optimum choice for network operators to conquer the communication range, data speed and link capacity to establish customer aggregation and infrastructure of 5G access networks. For an expansion of reach at high speed and data security, Hermite-Gaussian beams are selected nowadays. A high-capacity DWDM-FSO system utilizing Hermite-Gaussian beams is realized at 6*10Gbps data rate. Faithful transmission range of 100-600m with signal power of -33.38 to -61.73dBm, 33.57 to -62.84dBm, as -33.92 to -64.96dBm and -33.73 to -63.78dBm under air, light rain moderate rain and heavy rain is obtained respectively. The design also offers -0.20dB, 0.20dB, -1.31dBm and 96.68dB respective gain, noise figure, received signal and signal noise ratio. This design offers best performance over existing ones.

articleTitle: Enhanced RF Characteristics of Frequency Reconfigurable Microstrip Patch Antenna using Aperture-Coupled Feeding at 5 GHz
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This work presents a novel antenna design that makes use of the aperture coupled feeding technique. By carefully arranging them in different layers, the antenna patch and feed line maximize performance through efficient energy coupling. The antenna is 40 x 22 x 1.01 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> overall. The patch, measuring 17.85 x 16 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, is placed on atop the second substrate, and the feed line is positioned underneath the first substrate. To improve the antenna's RF properties and optimize its size, a thorough parametric study was carried out. Important factors, such as the height of the second patch and the breadth and length of the patch and substrates, were the focus of this iterative optimization process. The ultimate design therefore demonstrated its efficacy in directed radiation with a gain value of 5.4 dBi. The antenna is appropriate for point-to-point communication, Wi-Fi systems, radar systems, medical imaging equipment, and industrial automation systems. It runs at a frequency of 5 GHz. The design has the potential for high-performance applications in various sectors because of its enhanced RF performance and adaptability.

articleTitle: Detection of Melanoma using Deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study presents a comparative analysis between the two approaches for image classification in medical diagnostics, distinguishing between the image of skin lesions into benign or malignant conditions which help to identify if it’s melanoma or not. The first approach involves the development of a Proposed Convolutional Neural Network(CNN) and the second approach uses transfer learning on pre-trained MobileNet V2 augmented with handcrafted features. Through experimentation and evaluation, we observed that the transfer learning approach outperformed the Proposed CNN model in terms of accuracy. This finding shows the efficiency of transfer learning leveraged in the pre-trained model along with handcrafted features improves the performance on medical image classification tasks.

articleTitle: Automate Personal Voice Based Assistant Using Python
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The main purpose of this implementation is to enable natural commerce between humans and machines. Numerous IT companies are using dialogue system technology to establish different kinds of virtual particular sidekicks (VPAs) grounded on operations and disciplines to enhance mortal-machine commerce. For example, Microsoft's Cortina, Apple's Siri, Amazon’s Alexa, Google Assistant. We created our own Python Desktop Assistant, an intelligent software application designed to facilitate user productivity and simplify many tasks in the desktop or computer environment. This paper provides an overview of the key features, functionalities, and potential applications of this desktop assistant. We used Python as a programming language because it has a large library to execute command. Using the Python installation package, assistant can recognize and further process your voice. Voice assistant is a major advancement assistant in artificial intelligence and could change people's lifestyle in other ways as well.

articleTitle: Low Latency Majority Logic Based Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Approximate Computing (AC) presents a compelling approach to reducing energy consumption and footprint by relaxing the requirement for absolute precision. ML-based arithmetic circuits, like multi-bit adders and multipliers, enhance computing accuracy by reducing the propagation of imprecise outputs. This paper introduces a novel multiplier design incorporating a unique Partial Product Reduction (PPR) circuitry derived from the parallel approximation 6:3 compressor, efficiently realized through the application of a novel Wallace tree algorithm. Such approximate adders and multipliers find particular utility in tasks like image processing and machine learning, where speed often outweighs the need for perfect precision. Notably, significant reductions in power and space are achieved without compromising quality, facilitated by the introduction of an approximate 6:3 compressor and a specialized PPR circuit for compression in the multiplier. Furthermore, two distinct multipliers are proposed, each resulting in varied improvements in parameters such as MAE, area, power, and delay. For Design 1, power and delay decrease by 14% and 7%, respectively, while Design 2 exhibits a 16% reduction in MAE and a 2% decrease in delay when compared to an 8x8 existing approximate multiplier.

articleTitle: Power-Efficient Asynchronous FIFO Architecture for Forest Surveillance Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents the first approach to designing a power-aware asynchronous first-in first-out (FIFO) specifically tailored for next-generation forest surveillance systems, offering a novel solution to enhance power efficiency in remote monitoring applications. An asynchronous FIFO design is redesigned with an efficient technique to reduce its power consumption known as power gating. The primary factor contributing to increased leakage power is the supply voltage, which introduces leakage current and consequently escalates power consumption. Power gating scheme is a boon in taking care of this static power. An asynchronous FIFO is engineered to manage data transfer between two different clock periods, and the initiation of a power-saving approach is an extra advantage to the whole circuit. The proposed concept is termed as an alert sleeper - that wakes up in the sense of read/write data and accomplishes a reduction in leakage power by more than 30%.

articleTitle: Apple Leaf Disease Detection using Deep Learning-based Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The apple yield has been significantly affected by four distinct types of leaf diseases: Alternaria leaf spot, Brown spot, Mosaic, and Grey spot. However, a reliable and rapid disease detector for apple leaves is still lacking in the current research, which could threaten the industry’s growth and economy. This research suggests a deep learning strategy for early apple leaf disease detection using an enhanced and pre-trained MobileNet model. In this study, firstly the use of data augmentation and image annotation tools has been built. The apple leaf disease dataset includes both standardized laboratory images as well as images captured in the field. In this study, a MobileNet architecture has been proposed for apple leaf disease detection with multiple disease classes. Finally, the proposed MobileNet model is trained for identifying these prevalent apple leaf diseases using a dataset of 962 images of diseased apple leaves for the hold-out testing dataset. The detection performance of the proposed framework is demonstrated experimentally at 98.86% accuracy. In this study, the work shows that the innovative model offers a high-performance solution for the early identification of apple leaf diseases, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in terms of detection accuracy and detection speed in real time.

articleTitle: Augmenting Bell Pepper Disease Detection: A Deep Learning Approach Incorporating Convolutional Neural Networks and Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research provides evidence of rapid identification and classification of bell pepper illnesses using swelling machine learning matter. Through a dataset having images of bell pepper ailments under stress, such as control Mismatched Wilt Malware, Cucumber Mismatched Malware, Verticillium Wilt Sickness, and Blossom End Murrain, the study of the classification model’s functioning utilizing precision, summon, F1-score, maintain, back number portion, and precision. The results show that the inaccuracy of the classification of illness was quite low, with high appropriateness rates across all disorder groups, which were 88.28 % for Blossom End Rot and 95.83 % for Healthful. To distinguish between memorizing woven foodstuffs, summon rate Allusion price similar to how well a pattern can perceive examples from every overgrown may be done. The values of the F1-score show that there is soundness in the grouping of relevant solutions; with a score organized equal to the associate skilled to pick from precision and fame and varying from 90.55 % for Blossom End Rod and 93.88 % for Health. Additionally, a maintain metric, or illness throng, is specified for every unbalanced line in the dataset, whereas maintain ratios will be given in direct hue proportion. The clustering result precision, which is 92.19 %, presents value for the classification model’s ability to filter and diagnose bell pepper-related illness. Ultimately, this research contributes to the specialty of accuracy making by playing body moat of suitable illness classification and supervising plans.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Evaluation of a Small-Scale Hybrid On-Grid Solar PV with Battery Energy Management System for Study Spaces
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper evaluates the technical and economic viability of a small-scale, on-grid 3-kWp solar PV hybrid system with battery energy storage for study spaces in a grid-dependent academic institutions. The study was conducted at Caraga State University - Cabadbaran City, Philippines. Data on power consumption was gathered by observing students’ typical usage of gadgets and electronic devices in the study spaces, which were used for the simulation. Hourly solar irradiance and temperature data for wet and dry seasons were gathered from weather stations such as Tiempo and AccuWeather. The design integrated a State-of-Charge (SOC) algorithm for the battery energy storage system to ensure dependable and efficient charging cycles. The physical model of the hybrid system was developed and simulated using Matlab Simulink. Simulation outcomes demonstrated the system’s feasibility, projecting a capital expenditure (CAPEX) of 185,215.00 PHP and estimated annual net savings of 29,446.00 PHP over both seasons. The system also indicated a Return On Investment (ROI) of 297.46% over a 25-year lifespan, with a payback period (PBP) of 6.23 years. These results indicate that implementing the small-scale hybrid system in study spaces offers a cost-effective and sustainable solution, delivering substantial energy savings, enhancing energy independence, and ensuring reliable power supply even in off-grid scenarios. This indicates its potential as a viable and beneficial investment for reducing energy expenses in academic institutions.

articleTitle: Symptoms-based Classification of Disease Using Various ML Algorithms and Interpretation using LIME and SHAP KERNELS
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Using a variety of machine learning techniques, this research study suggests a unique method for classifying diseases using symptom-based analysis. To improve model transparency and comprehension, the study makes use of the interpretability tools, SHAP kernels and LIME. The research attempts to close the gap between interpretability and prediction accuracy in medical diagnosis by combining two approaches. A thorough assessment of symptom-based categorization is ensured by the use of many machine learning methods. The application of LIME and SHAP kernels aids in the clarification of model predictions and provides information on the primary symptoms that impact illness categorization. This study advances the creation of accurate and comprehensible illness categorization models, promoting confidence in the use of machine learning methods in healthcare.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of DeepFake Detection Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Deep Learning has played an immensely significant role in leading towards the revolutionary developments in numerous fields namely computer vision, big data analytics, healthcare, finance, cyber security and manufacturing industry. This rapid advancement has led to the emergence of diverse tools and technologies capable of manipulating multimedia. One of the major concerns is the DeepFake Technology which poses a real threat to the national security, democracy and privacy. It can be defined as a technique used to produce images, videos or any digital content that appear to be of high quality and hyper-realistic in nature, which have been produced with the intention of spreading propaganda, false information, inciting hatred and political unrest, or even harassing and blackmailing people. This technique is being actively employed in many different areas of the television industry for the recreation of videos by synthetically producing digital content without reshooting them at a very minimal cost. Additionally, the production and distribution of such content is growing rapidly across all media domains. Thus, it is crucial to develop effective technologies capable of detecting the DeepFake in these type of multimedia in order to abate the eventual harm caused in public. In the initial phases of deepfake detection, conventional methods such as signal processing, image processing, and lip-sync analysis were employed. However, these techniques achieved limited accuracy when integrated with modern deep learning technologies. Therefore, this paper primarily proposes a comparative study of all the diverse techniques which can be employed for the task of deepfake detection on the Celeb-DF dataset using diverse performance metrics. In addition to this, this study also discusses the future trends that should be taken into account to make progress in this field.

articleTitle: Enhanced Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Phonocardiogram Signals Using Deep Learning & Wavelet-Based Denoising
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Heart beat reveals crucial information about the heart condition at an early stage. The AI based diagnosis systems plays a crucial role for classifying heart sounds in CVD diagnosis. To accurately extract information from heart auscultation regarding a heart health condition, it’s essential that the heart sound signals remain uncontaminated by noise. This ensures that misclassification between normal and abnormal situations can be avoided. PCG signal contains crucial details regarding the functioning of heart and this information is used in diagnosis to detect various kinds of heart related diseases. Also, this PCG signals are very much distorted with noise which makes the denoising of the signal important for accurate detection of cardiovascular diseases (CVD). In this study, an automated CVD detection technique is introduced which detects various heart conditions from the PCG signal and also, we integrate a denoising technique to the diagnosis system which denoises the PCG signal if found to have any kind of internal or ambient noises. The findings presented in this paper suggest that our proposed architecture exhibited very good accuracy in detecting five classes of heart diseases with considerable denoising capabilities across various datasets featuring different noise levels and characteristics. This method is rooted on VGG based deep neural network model for detection of cardiac disease and the PCG denoising is done through wavelet denoising technique, represents a groundbreaking advancement aiming to increase the precision of automated CVD detection systems in identifying cardiac diseases within noisy environments.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different BERT models for Document Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Our study focused on evaluating the performance of four state-of-the-art word embedding models viz., Uncased version of BERT, ALBert, DistillBert, and BioBert. These models employ distinct methodologies to embed words into vector representations, thereby potentially influencing the quality of resultant word clusters. By systematically comparing these models, we aimed to discern their respective strengths and weaknesses in producing cohesive and semantically meaningful word groupings. The outcomes of our comparative study provide valuable insights into the performance and applicability of different word embedding models for unsupervised word clustering tasks. Performance evaluation is conducted using the evaluation metrics like F1 score, precision and recall. A subset of the FAO dataset has been carefully selected for the experiments. Among them are the distinct domains of livestock, forestry, land and soil, and fisheries, all of which fall under the larger category of FAO. Through an averaged assessment of performance metrics across all models, we determine BERT-Uncased as the optimal choice for FAO data classification tasks. The model reported a a macro-average F-measure of 83% in clustering domain specific text documents.

articleTitle: A Logical Performance Evaluation Methodology based on Bandwidth Estimation Strategy to Minimize Communication Delay over Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are critical in various applications such as environmental monitoring, smart agriculture, industrial automation, and healthcare. These networks often face significant challenges, including limited bandwidth, high communication delay, energy constraints, and varying environmental conditions. Traditional bandwidth allocation methods in WSNs often fail to adapt to dynamic network conditions, leading to suboptimal performance, increased packet loss, higher latency, and inefficient energy usage. This study presents an adaptive bandwidth estimation strategy designed to minimize communication delay in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). The strategy dynamically adjusts bandwidth allocation based on real-time network conditions through continuous monitoring, precise bandwidth estimation, and adaptive adjustment of transmission parameters. Utilizing the NS-3 simulator, a realistic simulation environment was created to reflect real-world conditions, including varying node densities, traffic patterns, and environmental factors like interference and physical obstacles. The proposed model demonstrated significant improvements over existing models, achieving a packet loss rate of 0.5% compared to 1.2%, a transmission rate of 240 kbps versus 220 kbps, latency of 15 ms against 25 ms, and energy consumption of 50 mW compared to 60 mW. These results highlight the strategy's effectiveness in enhancing WSN performance, maintaining low latency, high reliability, and efficient energy consumption.

articleTitle: Intelligent Solid Waste Sorting System using IoT and Image processing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Solid waste management (SWM) is one of the global challenges due to the lack of an efficient automated real-time waste segregation and reuse system. This work deals with the design, development and testing of an intelligent solid waste sorting system by integrating image processing and Internet of things (IoT). The proposed system utilizes image processing algorithm to detect the e-waste as well as e-waste with plastic content from other wastes. Additionally, the developed system is capable of sorting organic wastes, plastic wastes and metal wastes using respective sensors embedded in the system. The speed of the conveyor belt is synergistically tuned with the processing time of the algorithm for waste detection, signal communication, and response time of the flap, thereby attaining effective sorting. The detection accuracy above 95% is obtained for the present system which is better compared to the existing ones.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of Network-on-Chip Architecture using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A scalable and promising interconnect solution for System-on-Chip (SoC) designs is Network-on-Chip (NoC), intended for high-performance computing platforms. The crucial parameters, including throughput, latency, and total energy, directly affect NoCs’ overall performance. Nevertheless, a cycle-accurate simulator requires much execution time as the system size increases. To predict crucial parameters for network-on-chip designs, this work presents a machine-learning approach that uses several regression models. The proposed work explores Linear regression (LR), Support vector regression (SVR), Decision tree regression (DTR), K-nearest neighbour (KNN), Random forest (RF), and Polynomial regression (PR) models to predict various NoC performance metrics. The obtained results are compared with the cycle-accurate simulator for NoCs. The experimental results showed an R2 score of 0.9997, MAPE and RMSE of 0.0058 and 1.48 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup> respectively. Moreover, the proposed regression model achieves a maximum speedup of approximately 6257.1X compared to a cycle-accurate simulator. This work outperforms existing works regarding R2 score, MAPE, RMSE, and speedup.

articleTitle: Solar Rails: Advancements in Renewable Energy for Transportation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Solar-powered trains are a novel approach with enormous potential to transform rail transportation in the future. These trains have major environmental benefits, such as a large reduction in greenhouse gas emissions and improved air quality, by utilizing clean, renewable solar energy. Because solar- powered trains run on decentralized solar infrastructure rather than conventional fossil fuels, they also contribute to energy independence and security, which goes beyond environmental concerns.Though the initial outlay could be high, solar-powered trains are a financially feasible choice because to the long-term cost reductions and improvements in energy storage and solar panel efficiency. Furthermore, by reducing energy consumption and bolstering grid stability, the integration of solar-powered trains with current rail infrastructure and smart grid systems further maximizes their potential. In general, solar- powered trains are an environmentally friendly and socially conscious method of rail transportation that can lead to a more robust and clean transportation system while fostering innovation and economic progress.

articleTitle: Towards Autonomous Road Maintenance: CNN-FL Integration for Pothole Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The motorists are mad at their cars, but the problem that they always face is the highway potholes. Therefore, the issue that necessitates the utilization of proper detection and repair procedures is the traffic jam it ignites in the city's streets, making it very congested. The suggested method of innovative use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), combined with Federated Learning (FL), to find the optimal scenario for potholes is the one this research proposes. One of the finest features of the smart city idea is that the CNN + FL point about implementation can be scaled up without compromising users' privacy. More effective than the conventional method, this mechanism uses CNN, wherein not a single node trains the model, but the whole pool does. This leads to the final elimination of CNN-mon models. The comparison of the CNN+FL model and a basic CNN-based model resulted in about 2% on average er—the F1 score of 0.8562 demands that there should be a decent balance between the two models. A value of slightly more than 0.87 also reflects accuracy and recall. Deep neural networks can be supplemented with a federated learning system to improve the maintenance of urban infrastructure with concession. The existence of dissimilarities between countries and external factors shows the significance of further studies to put it at its finishing and best-applicable version.

articleTitle: Strategic Approaches to AI Integration in Organizations: Managing Change and Maximizing Benefits
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The proposed paper seeks to understand how artificial intelligence (AI) has become a significant disruptor in organizational decision making, workspace, and manage activity. This research paper aims at examining the role of AI in organizational change management with reference to employing AI change enabling techniques, their main strategies, and likely challenges, as well as, revealing the best practices for effective AI change management within organizations. This research is based on a sequential, exploratory mixed-methods design that involves qualitative data collection from semi-structured surveys of leaders and managers; quantitative data collection from cross-sectional surveys of employees; and secondary qualitative data on the organisation and its industry and from case studies. These insights show that cohesive and communicative leadership, open and honest communication, and a culture of inclusiveness are critical factors that can foster AI implementation. The issues of securing job is another area which employees are skeptical about change process and thus, by addressing employee concerns about getting involve in the change process, acceptance and engagement are boosted. The surveys revealed high percentages of organizational efficiency and productivity enhancement after the implementation of AI, up to 82% said they have noticed enhanced efficiency, and 75% said there is a need to have self-improvement techniques. There is continued uncertainty regarding job security where a quarter of employees reported that they are concerned with it. The preprocessing performance assessment of the proposed AI model set in this study indicates high predictive accuracy and reliability using the Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Explained Variance Score, and Pearson’s R-squared (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) of 0.78. Thus, competition based on state-of-art techniques adds more efficacy to the model under consideration. In this study, findings related to the challenges and possibilities of AI integration in organizations provides an extensive literature review to the existing research on organizational change and AI.

articleTitle: Improving Medical Diagnostics with EfficientNetV2-B1 in Blood Cell Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research paper investigates how deep learning can be applied to classify blood cells, focusing on the architecture of EffectiveNetV2B1. It took a total of 17,092 images to make up the dataset for this study, which were arranged by blood cell, eight groups by and into each. Angle types were white cells Neutrophils, Eosinophils, Basophils Lymphocytes Monocytes Immature Granulocytes, (including promyelocytes for the latter three and myelocytes metamyelocytes), Erythroblasts and platelets or thrombocytes. The mainstay of our method is the training process, and over 40 epochs EfficientNetV2B1 training let us to display its strength. After screening Examination in a comprehensive range of tests, our model shows exemplary performance, achieving an accuracy rate of 92%. This can be further shown by the remarkable accuracy of its Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) value: 99.46%. These findings underscore the effectiveness of deep learning models, especially the EfficientNetV2B1 architecture, in medical image analysis and classification. Our research makes an important contribution to diagnostics in medicine by identifying blood cell types with precision and contains information for medicine, potentially helping care providers diagnose a variety of blood-associated diseases in more efficient ways than before.

articleTitle: Advancing Automotive Safety: Integrated Tyre Pressure Monitoring and Puncture Detection System for Proactive Tyre Health Management
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Integrated Tyre Pressure Monitoring and Puncture Detection Systemis an advanced automotive technology designed to enhance vehicle safety, fuel efficiency, and overall driving experience. This system utilizes sensors embedded in each tyre to continuously monitor the air pressure and detect potential punctures or leaks. The real-time data collected by these sensors is then transmitted to the vehicle's central control unit, providing drivers with immediate feedback on the status of their tyres. The primary purpose of the TPM&PDS is to ensure that all tyres are adequately inflated, thereby reducing the risk of accidents associated with under-inflated or over-inflated tyres. The system employs pressure sensors that are able to accurately measure tyre pressure and alert the driver if any deviation from the recommended pressure level is detected. This active monitoring helps prevent premature tyre wear, improves fuel efficiency, and contributes to overall vehicle stability and handling. Apart from monitoring tyre pressure, the system also has smart technology to notice if there is a puncture. Sensors can detect a sudden pressure drop, which usually means a puncture or leak, and immediately let the driver know through visual or sound alerts. This early warning helps drivers take quick action, such as stopping at a safe location, to prevent accidents and avoid further tyre damage.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance in IoT Networks Using a Temporal Attention Mechanism Based Federated Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the era of Industry 4.0, edge devices in industrial settings generate vast amounts of data crucial for process optimization and Predictive Maintenance (PM). Traditional cloud-based approaches for handling this data are becoming untenable due to cost, latency, and privacy issues. Federated learning emerges as a viable solution, offering localized and efficient data processing while mitigating these challenges. This paper presents a Federated Convolutional Neural Network with Temporal Attention Mechanism (FedCNN-TAM) for PM tasks in Internet of Things (IoT) networks. This model leverages temporal features in sensor data to enhance predictive accuracy. Evaluated on the CMAPSS dataset, FedCNN-TAM outperforms representative models with a significant performance gain. This model exhibits the potential for broader applications in industrial IoT, setting the stage for future research on its scalability and adaptability to multi-modal data types.

articleTitle: Transforming HR with Machine Learning: Data-Driven Strategies for Talent Management
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Human resource management (HRM) deals with personnel management in a given firm or organization and is strategic in ensuring that organizations retain their competitive advantage in today’s business environment. The present research work revolves around studying the use of machine learning (ML) in employment and focusing on the analytical approach to HRM. Various methods of ML will be used in the study, such as predictive analysis (PA), natural language processing (NLP), clustering, and recommending systems (RS) to help in recruitment, performance appraisal, employee categorization, and career planning. The data set is gathered from a multinational corporation and contains rich and detailed participants’ records for five years, which greatly contributes to designing and testing the models. The predictive models, particularly the random forest algorithm, demonstrated superior performance in forecasting employee performance and turnover, achieving an Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.90 and a log-loss of 0.35. The BERT-based NLP model effectively analyzed textual data from resumes and feedback, achieving a Brier score of 0.15. Clustering algorithms, specifically k-means, provided well-defined employee segments with a silhouette score of 0.62. The collaborative filtering-based recommender system excelled in providing personalized training and career path recommendations, evidenced by a normalized discounted cumulative gain (nDCG) score of 0.78. Altogether, the study points to the fact of providing for ethical concerns when employing ML in the sphere of HR, including data privacy and algorithmic bias. Lastly, the findings present an argument that is not only significant in improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the current advanced model and ML-based models but also offers integration solutions to the problems and challenges of implementing ML approaches in HR practices benefiting all organizational customers, current and potential, as well as the overall organization.

articleTitle: Securing Data Privacy in Machine Learning: The FedAvg of Federated Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This research evaluates the FedAvg method that is created for picture categorization, particularly the important aspects of privacy and data security in the machine learning field. The research employs a dataset that has 60.000 training photos and 10.000 test images with ten labels that correspond to different fashion items classifying. The FedAvg technique trains a CNN model by negotiating model updates in several virtual parties where a peer-to-peer server collects the model updates from each of the parties and agglomerates them to optimize the CNN model. The results show high achievement, due to this fact trained model has gained an accuracy of 87.27% on the test dataset. the result of statistics is one indicator of system efficiency since the data is close to the ones of the centralized training approaches. This document, therefore, brings to the limelight the possibility of federated learning as a privacy-preserving method that conceivably manifests both data privacy and general accuracy in picture classification assignments. This technique has the chance to be developed and used in different areas where the confidentiality of data is a matter that has to be considered. The dataset consisted of 60,000 training shots and 10,000 test images, categorized into ten classes: Cotton t-shirt, cotton pair of pants, cotton dress, cotton sweater, cotton coat, cotton sandals, cotton shirt, leather shoes, cotton bag, and cotton boots. After every step, the image showed up as a black and white image with dimensions of 28 by 28. The study demonstrates the positive effect of Federated Averaging on image classification. It reveals the effectiveness of this method and gives results similar to the ones obtained by the centralized training approaches that have been in use until now. This research works out the practical convenience within which Federated learning operates by delivering an accuracy of 87.27%. Therefore, there will be more compliance with the provision of tight data privacy where regulations must be followed.

articleTitle: Enhancing Malware Detection Accuracy: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models with Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The challenge of detecting malware in cybersecurity necessitates the exploration of diverse machine learning models for effective solutions. In this investigation, we assess the performance of several models, including Support Vector Machines (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Randomized Search CV, Grid Search CV, CatBoost, ADA Boost, XGBoost, and Gradient Boosting, using a comprehensive dataset. Our study reveals that CatBoost emerges as the most effective model, achieving an exceptional 99% accuracy in malware prediction. Furthermore, we utilize Lime and Shap explainability techniques to delve into the decision-making process of CatBoost, shedding light on its predictive mechanisms and enhancing transparency in malware detection. By emphasizing the importance of diverse machine learning models and the significance of explainable AI techniques in cybersecurity, our research contributes to the advancement of malware detection methodologies. It underscores the critical role of transparent and interpretable AI systems in fostering trustworthiness and effectiveness in cybersecurity applications.

articleTitle: Technological Advances in Cancer Imaging: A Transformative Impact
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Cancer imaging refers to the use of various medical imaging techniques to visualize and diagnose cancerous tumours or lesions in the body. It plays a pivotal role in the accurate diagnosis, staging, and treatment monitoring of various malignancies. The work carried out presents a comprehensive overview of the recent advancements in cancer imaging techniques, highlighting their transformative impact on the field of oncology. Cutting-edge techniques such as positron emission tomography (PET) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) have revolutionized cancer detection and characterization by providing high-resolution anatomical and functional information. Additionally, molecular imaging approaches utilizing targeted probes and nanoparticles have facilitated early tumour detection and personalized treatment strategies. The integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms for enhanced image analysis, enabling improved risk stratification and treatment response prediction is also discussed. This paper underscores the crucial role of cancer imaging in advancing precision medicine and optimizing patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Generating Event Descriptions from Legal Documents with Bidirectional and Auto-Regressive Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Legal document analysis often requires understanding complex sequences of events, their relationships, and their implications within a legal context. This paper introduces a novel method for event generation by extracting segments from legal documents and generating events based on these chunks. We employ two models, T5 and BART, leveraging their text-to-text transformer capabilities for event generation tasks. Our approach utilizes deep learning methods to handle the complexities and variations inherent in legal texts effectively. The dataset, comprising 246 event descriptions was manually curated to ensure high-quality training and testing data. A comparative study of both models was conducted, and evaluation of results using ROUGE scores demonstrated their proficiency in capturing relevant information. Notably, both T5 and BART achieved the same BERT Similarity score of 0.85, indicating strong semantic understanding and consistency in event generation from legal texts. This study highlights the potential of transformer models in automating and enhancing legal document analysis.

articleTitle: VLSI Technology used in Floating Point Multipliers Used in Vedic Mathematics Calculation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: All digital systems' fundamental components are multipliers. There is a rising need for low-delay multipliers in a variety of applications involving digital signal processing. These applications require minimal latency and fast processing. The necessity for accurate and quick floating-point arithmetic has grown along with the demand for these applications. In this study, a floating-point multiplier is constructed using the Urdhva-Tiryakbhyam (UT) sutra, a method of Vedic mathematics. Our goal is to demonstrate that Vedic multipliers outperform current multiplier technology. Cross-multiplication is the first phase of the Urdhva-Tiryakbhyam method, which is followed by addition.The Vedic Multiplier is next examined, and its results are contrasted with those of an array multiplier. The 90nm standard cell library for Cadence EDA Tool was used to build the designs. The Virtuoso tools are used to perform the benchmarking and comparisons. A traditional multiplier is also created, and its performance is compared to that of the Vedic multiplier using a variety of adders. The multipliers are contrasted in terms of power and latency.

articleTitle: Enhancing Indoor Mobility: A Novel Suspended Drive Wheel Mechanism for Differential Drive Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Robotics has become integral across various sectors, revolutionizing processes, and enhancing safety. The integration of robotic technologies has streamlined operations in a faster and more efficient way. Mobile robotics, especially, has seen significant advancements in addressing diverse needs across industries. Applications of mobile robotics are widespread and diverse, including tasks such as warehouse automation, agricultural monitoring and management, search and rescue operations, environmental monitoring, delivery services, and even space exploration. However, the challenge of maintaining stable wheel contact and eliminating wheel slippage persists, particularly evident in indoor environments where differential drive mobile robots (DDMRs) operate. This work addresses this issue by focusing on strategies to mitigate wheel slippage and enhance traction in DDMRs within indoor environments. A novel suspended drive wheel mechanism design for a DDMR platform is introduced in this paper, which is later analyzed using ADAMS multibody simulation on different types of surfaces. The results of the simulations are discussed, and it is evident that the mechanism can establish a firm and stable contact between the ground and the wheel.

articleTitle: A Machine-Agnostic Approach to Denoising OCT Images of the Retina
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) is a widely used imaging modality in ophthalmology for management of various ocular diseases. However, the presence of speckle noise degrades the quality of OCT B-scan images, affecting the accuracy of diagnoses and treatment plans. Several deep-learning based denoising solutions exist that show promising results; however, these require noise-free training data, which may not be available in all cases. The more traditional filter-based approaches, which do not need such noise-free data, cause significant data loss. Additionally, as OCT images taken from different machines vary significantly in terms of noise distribution, denoising solutions are commonly machine-specific. Therefore, there is a need for a machine-independent solution that can effectively reduce noise in OCT images while preserving features, even when only noisy images are available. In this study, we propose such a solution. Our algorithm works by calculating two separate threshold values for the input image based on its statistical characteristics, and then processing the image independently twice by a thresholding-based algorithm. The outputs of the two iterations are combined into a single composite image, which is the final output. Our algorithm showed promising results on our dataset. To also showcase the generalizabilty of our algorithm, we also used a Kaggle dataset. We performed image classification independently twice on it – once on the raw dataset, and once on the denoised dataset. Results were superior for the denoised data, showing that the proposed method has further applications. We also propose a novel metric to evaluate the noise level in OCT images in the absence of their denoised counterparts. The results demonstrate the potential of our method to improve the overall quality and reliability of OCT images, thereby contributing to more accurate and informed clinical decisions in the field of ophthalmology.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Series-fed Microstrip Patch Array Antenna for Automotive Radar Application
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation of a series-fed microstrip patch array antenna for automotive radar applications operating at 77 GHz. The proposed antenna, configured in a 4x10 array, addresses common challenges in microstrip antennas, such as high loss and complexity in multi-frequency designs. Using Computer Simulation Technology (CST) Microwave Studio Suite for simulation, the antenna demonstrated a gain of 15.02 dBi, a -10 dB bandwidth of 7.05 GHz, and a return loss of -37.53 dB, significantly outperforming traditional 1x10 arrays in terms of directivity, bandwidth, and gain. The design leverages a series-fed technique to minimize complexity and losses, achieving an optimal VSWR and broad beam width suitable for mid-range and long-range radar applications. The optimized dimensions and material properties, including the use of Rogers RO3003 substrate, contribute to the antenna's enhanced performance. This study provides a cost-effective solution for automotive radar systems, essential for collision avoidance and blind spot detection under various weather conditions. Future research will focus on further optimization and real-world testing to validate the antenna's practical applications and explore additional improvements. This work contributes to the advancement of automotive radar technology, enhancing vehicle safety and detection capabilities.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Methodologies for Breast Cancer Classification: Leveraging XAI LIME, SHAP Bagging Boosting, and Diverse Single Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Breast cancer is one of the most common causes for deaths owed to cancer. It is very crucial and necessary to detect cancer at early phases. There are various Machine Learning techniques and computational techniques available for the aim of diagnosis of breast cancer data. This paper offers a Machine Learning model to perform automated diagnosis for the classification of breast cancer. This method employs single classifier model and bagging boosting for feature selection. Also, four algorithms SVM, Decision Tree, KNN and Logistic Regression which gives the highest accuracy of 88%. The system was trailed on BCGENES Dataset. The performance of the system is measured on the basis of accuracy and precision. The incorporation of XAI methods, such as SHAP values and LIME, provides a nuanced understanding of feature importance and individual predictions, elevating model interpretability. The amalgamation of machine learning classifiers, hyperparameter tuning, and XAI techniques contributes to advanced screening tools, fostering trust among clinicians and researchers.

articleTitle: Data Mining and Processing in the Age of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence - Issues, Privacy, and Ethical Considerations
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The integration of big data and AI, which is at present a most crucial development in data mining and processing, can be regarded as the beginning of a new era in the field of science and technology. The research primarily focuses on using ML and data mining methods to forecast cardiac diseases. It also identifies the most efficient and effective approaches for managing enormous datasets and producing accurate forecasts. The results show that LightGBM comes in second with 93.8% accuracy and AdaBoost with 95.2% accuracy. The accuracy rates of other models, such KNN and Naive Bayes, are 88.52% and 90.56%, respectively. These results highlight how sophisticated machine learning algorithms might improve a predicted accuracy of heart disease diagnosis. The paper underscores the necessity of safeguarding data and the importance of stakeholder collaboration to ensure that the advancements in big data and AI are equitable, sustainable, and centred around human well-being.

articleTitle: Advancements in Casting Defect Classification: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The results of research assessing the effectiveness of a defect classification model applied to several casting defect classes are briefly summarized in the abstract. For every defect class—Misruns, Cold Shuts, Hot Tears, Flash, Weld Lines, Sand Inclusions, Metal Penetration, Gas Porosity, Shrinkage Cavities, and Slag Inclusions—precision, recall, and F1-score metrics are presented. These measurements, which fall between about 95% and 98%, show how well the model recognizes and categorizes various casting flaws. The number of instances within the dataset is also reflected in the support scores for each class, which sheds light on the frequency of various fault kinds. The model's estimated 99% total accuracy in classifying casting flaws attests to its excellent performance. The model's accuracy is 90.06% on 12,302 photos, demonstrating its strong image categorization capabilities. To further describe the model's overall performance across all fault classes, macro, weighted, or micro average metrics are offered. About 97% of the macro average accuracy, recall, and F1-score values suggest consistent performance across various defect types. In the same vein, the weighted average measures show excellent performance even after adjusting for class imbalance. Ultimately, the model's overall accuracy, recall, and F1-score are reflected in the micro average metrics, which supports its strong performance in defect categorization. All things considered, the abstract emphasizes how well the defect classification model can discover and categorize casting flaws, therefore highlighting its possible use in industrial quality control procedures.

articleTitle: Precision Quality Assurance in Sheet Metal Working: Fusion of CNN and Random Forest Models for Advanced Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The study's main findings can be read in the abstract, which offers a succinct summary of how well the classification model identified and categorized different manufacturing process flaws. The accuracy of the model in properly recognizing positive predictions for defect classes such burr, wrinkle, dent, hole pull-up, trim pull-up, and trim deform is demonstrated by precision values ranging from 93.92% to 96.22%. Comparably, recall percentages between 93.33% and 96.09% demonstrate how well the model captures a sizable percentage of real positive cases for every kind of fault. The F1 scores, which range from 94.12% to 95.82% and show a harmonic median of precision and recall, highlight the model's well-balanced performance even further. To show the relative distribution of each defect type within the dataset, support percentage values normalize these metrics. Values represent how many instances there are of each class. The model's overall efficacy in reliably recognizing problems across all classes is confirmed by the continuously high accuracy values, which range from 98% to 99%. Furthermore, the model's dependability and consistency across the dataset are shown by the consistent macro, weighted, and micro mean scores for recall, precision, and F1-score—all of which are consistently at 94.9%. These results highlight how the classification model can significantly enhance production quality control processes, which will ultimately result in higher customer satisfaction and better-quality products.

articleTitle: Malicious URL Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: With the advent of digitalization, there has been an unparalleled increase in the use of QR codes and Uniform Resource Locators (URLs). But this increase has also been accompanied by a notable increase in malicious URLs, which presents a serious risk to cybersecurity, especially when shared via QR codes. Strong countermeasures are required because malicious QR codes carry several security risks, such as financial fraud, identity theft, and virus propagation. Traditional QR apps primarily use blacklisting methods, which are difficult to manage and don't sufficiently identify new or unknown malicious URLs. Furthermore, these approaches are static and hinder real-time threat assessment because they require users to upload QR codes for classification. The suggested system takes a novel approach to overcome these constraints. Recently, there has been an increase in the use of machine-learning techniques to enhance the detection of malicious URLs. However, for these methods to be effective, they require a large and continuously updated dataset, as they rely heavily on data. The proposed method aims at classifying URLs according to their lexical characteristics and differentiating between safe and dangerous ones. After testing the model with five different classifiers, the Extra Tree classifier outperformed the others, obtaining a 99.70\% accuracy rate. This system, in contrast to traditional approaches, uses lexical analysis to identify URL characteristics, allowing for proactive mitigation of possible threats.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics in Digital ID Verification for Fraud Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Scams that are associated with identification and traveling documents pose significant challenges to the security of the border and the public. This comparative study offers a systematic approach to applying predictive analytics for PAN and passport authentication which erases the shortcomings associated with manual methods of ID confirmation. To enhance the robustness of the results two very large datasets of 287,114 images of passports and PAN cards were collected from multiple sources across the world and preprocessed. Thus, both, the purpose of the analysis and the type of data collected called for several different procedures to be used in preparation of the data for analysis. Such techniques included; resizing, trimming, conversion to grayscale, image segmentation and image features extraction. Different classification models such as CNN, SVM, ShuffleNet v2, and Efficient Net were used to test on the datasets, where the data sets were split into train and test sets. The performance analysis of the proposed system reveals high accuracy and low loss rate for the false images of PAN card and passport. Comparative research illustrates the efficiency of several models across a variety of datasets, with ShuffleNet v2 94% and Efficient Net 93% outperformed by the categorization of passport data.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Solar-Powered IoT-Based Fire Alarm System with Integrated GPS and GSM for Enhanced Emergency Response
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The prevalence of fire incidents has increased alongside rising global temperatures, necessitating more sophisticated fire alarm systems. This intensity of fire emergency occurrence highlighted the deficiencies in current fire alarm and navigation systems within buildings, often leading to delayed response times, elevated risks, and impeded rescue operations. The limitations of Traditional fire alarm systems, which rely on grid power, render them susceptible to outages, and their absence of critical technologies restricts their effectiveness in prompt emergency communication and response. This study aims to overcome these challenges by designing and developing a solar-powered, IoT-based fire alarm system integrated with GPS and GSM modules, assuring continued operation during power failures and bolstering emergency response capabilities. The integration of solar power ensures sustainable operation, and the Internet of Things (IoT) enables real-time data transmission, optimizing the early detection and response to fire incidents. The incorporation of the Global Positioning System and Global System for Mobile Communications offers real-time monitoring, precise location tracking, and swift communication, fostering timely alerts that improve evacuation processes and support emergency responders. This advancement in fire safety has the potential to significantly reduce response time, minimize property damage, address negative impacts on global warming caused by fires, as well as save lives.

articleTitle: Optimization of Active Rectifier Circuits Utilizing Compact Waffle Layout for Power MOSFETs in 180nm CMOS Process
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper presents the design and optimization of an active rectifier circuit using a compact waffle layout structure for power MOSFETs, implemented in a 180nm CMOS process. The proposed design aims to improve power conversion efficiency (PCE) and reduce the on-state resistance (Rds_on) and dropout voltage (Vds_on) compared to conventional multi-finger layout structures. The active rectifier is tailored for applications in advanced implantable medical devices (AIMDs), requiring high efficiency and minimal area. Simulation results demonstrate that the optimized rectifier achieves a peak output voltage of 3.3V with a PCE of 87.1% at a load of 300Ÿ while occupying an area of only 0.001mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The waffle layout structure exhibits superior performance with an on-resistance of 120mŸ and a significantly reduced dropout voltage compared to traditional layouts. The rectifier's performance was validated through pre-simulation and post-simulation stages, showing consistent results across different corners (tt, ss, ff). The study highlights the advantages of the waffle layout in enhancing PCE, reducing power loss, and minimizing the physical footprint of the device, making it an ideal solution for space-constrained and power-sensitive applications in AIMDs. Future work will focus on further optimization and experimental validation of the proposed design.

articleTitle: Identification and Segmentation of Polyp Using Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a major health problem, and accurate detection of polyps plays a major role in its prevention and treatment. In the past, people often relied on manually extracted lower-level features such as color, texture, and shape, which often had issues capturing global context and lacked robustness to complex scenarios. With the rise in deep learning, more and more rigorous segmentation of medical images dependent on deep learning networks have emerged, making significant progress in this field. This paper aims to develop an efficient model for polyp detection and segmentation using machine learning techniques. The model will assist clinicians in accurately locating and segmenting polyp regions, which will help in the prevention and treatment of CRC. The work will first review traditional methods that are dependent manually on extracted features and deep segmentation algorithms, then detail benchmark datasets relevant for the topic. The two datasets Kvasir-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB are used for implementation. Specifically, we carried out a comprehensive evaluation of recent deep learning CNN methods. The model gave an accuracy with Pranet method of about 99% in polyp segmentation and identification respectively.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Implementation of Parking Spot Detector and Counter using MATLAB and OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In modern urban environments, efficient utilization of parking spaces has become a critical challenge. While recent technologies have made strides in parking management, the identification of problems in scenarios with sparse vehicle density remains a significant hurdle. This project addresses the issue of parking space occupancy detection within distributed parking ecosystems, with a particular focus on lined and commercial parking lots. It focuses on the exploration of computer vision methods to overcome the challenges posed by varying lighting conditions, environmental factors, and sparse vehicle distribution. The primary objective is to develop an advanced system using Computer Vision to identify vacant parking slots and a counter along with image processing to identify image properties using Matlab. The system's effectiveness is based on Computer Vision technologies like OpenCV as well as Matlab tools for image processing.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Predictive Maintenance in Industrial Equipment: Challenges and Application
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the industrial sector, unplanned equipment failures can lead to significant financial losses, safety hazards, and operational inefficiencies. Traditional maintenance strategies, such as reactive maintenance (repair after failure) and preventive maintenance (scheduled maintenance), often prove inadequate in addressing these issues. This not only minimizes downtime but also optimizes maintenance resources and extends the lifespan of equipment. Machine learning models used in Predictive maintenance (PdM) are designed to analyze large volumes of data generated by industrial equipment. Reinforcement learning optimizes maintenance schedules by learning from interactions with the environment, balancing the trade-off between maintenance costs and equipment reliability. Black-box models, such as deep learning, often provide high accuracy but lack transparency. Explainable AI (XAI) techniques are being developed to make these models more interpretable, enabling users to gain insights into the decision-making process and build confidence in the predictions. The deployment of ML models in industrial environments also requires seamless integration with existing systems. This involves addressing issues related to real-time data processing, scalability, and model retraining. Edge computing and cloud-based solutions are being explored to handle large-scale data processing and storage, while online learning techniques allow models to adapt to new data continuously. This paper presents several case studies from industries such as manufacturing, energy, transportation, and healthcare, illustrating the successful application of ML in PdM. In manufacturing, ML models have been used to predict failures in machinery such as turbines, compressors, and conveyor belts, leading to significant reductions in downtime and maintenance costs. The energy sector has employed ML for the maintenance of critical infrastructure, including power grids and wind turbines, enhancing operational efficiency and reliability.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation Of Kmeans clustering, Agglomerative hierarchical clustering And Affinity Propagation for Customer Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Customer segmentation is a critical factor of e-commerce marketing strategies, enabling groups to better apprehend their customer base and tailor personalised studies to beautify client satisfaction and pressure sales. The technique involves categorizing customers into wonderful groups based on similar characteristics and behaviours, permitting e-commerce systems to optimize product tips, marketing campaigns, and ordinary consumer enjoy. This research focuses on comparing the effectiveness of commonly used clustering algorithms, namely K-Means, Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering, and Affinity Propagation, in handling challenges such as large-scale, dynamic customer data and high-dimensional feature spaces. Real-world e-commerce data is utilized for performance analysis, offering valuable insights into the suitability of these algorithms. By understanding the strengths and limitations of each method, businesses can make informed decisions when selecting a clustering approach that aligns with their specific needs and dataset characteristics, ultimately improving customer experiences and driving sales.

articleTitle: Edge Impulse: TinyML Language Classification Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: There is an immense demand for smart production procedures with a requirement of intelligence which is expected in today’s industry due to rapid development. One of those intelligent production techniques gave birth to TinyML, which has the ability to run machine learning models with low processing power and still satisfying the accuracy threshold for effective application. This research explores the implementation of TinyML for conveyor belt systems using Edge Impulse software. The significance of this research lies in the approach of handling a problem such as language identification on products real time and on edge devices. This pipeline was created with data acquisition, model design, training and testing done sequentially to suit our purpose, with getting the results of accurate identification of 4 languages Arabic, Chinese, Hindi and English along with processing time of 1ms and RAM consumption of 4KB. The study shares valuable insights about the practical implementation/ applications of Tiny ML in the smart manufacturing process by bridging the automated systems and human operations.

articleTitle: An Approach for Integrating Behavioral Analytics and Machine Learning for Enhanced Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Data breaches and cyber threats have evolved into increasingly complex and stealthy forms. Conventional anomaly detection based on rules is ineffective in identifying numerous contemporary attacks. Hence, User Behavior Analysis is performed on the network traffic flow data to comprehend, model, and forecast users' actions. Nevertheless, the diversity of the methods makes their understanding exceedingly complex. Therefore, domain experts use machine learning (ML) to accomplish their goals. Thus, this paper aims to suggest an innovative architecture that can detect anomalies in the network traffic flow by analyzing user behavior. The two different sets of data are used for two-class and four-class classification. Both the data are pre-processed for duplicates, missing values, and performing encoding techniques. The correlation analysis is performed to understand the user's behavior before training the ML models. The four different ML algorithms, like Logistic regression LR, KNN, DT, and RF algorithms are applied to the pre-processed datasets. The Random Forest algorithm outperforms by achieving 100% accuracy on two- and four-class classification. The described behavioral modeling approach updates cyber threat detection to match the needs of the modern, ever-changing threat landscape.

articleTitle: Empowering India's Energy Future: Solar-Wind Hybrid Systems for Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The present study endeavors to tackle the growing worldwide need for sustainable energy sources by providing an in-depth examination of a hybrid solar-wind energy generation system. The challenges presented by conventional fossil fuel-based generation can be effectively addressed by the integration of photovoltaic (PV) and wind turbines (WT), especially with regard to cost-effectiveness, environmental sustainability, and operational reliability. By combining solar and wind power technologies in a synergistic way, the research aims to overcome the inherent intermittency of standalone renewable energy systems. The main goal is to create a model for energy generation that is economical, ecologically friendly, and efficient while reducing pollution and meeting the energy needs of various communities. This paper highlights how urgent it is to switch to renewable energy sources and how wind hybrid systems have the potential to provide a sizable amount of the world's energy needs. This research aims to add to the ongoing discussion on sustainable energy solutions that are crucial for the stability of the global economy and environment by analyzing the technical, economic, and environmental aspects of the proposed hybrid system.

articleTitle: Non-Intrusive Alert For Drivers With Fatigue
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Fatigue during driving significantly impairs a driver's reaction time, awareness, and decision-making abilities, leading to an increased risk of accidents. Recognising and mitigating driver fatigue is crucial for enhancing road safety and preventing potential collisions. This research introduces a non-intrusive method to reduce road accidents caused by driver fatigue. Recognising that accidents often occur due to lapses in driver alertness, the system utilises an affordable, high-quality webcam and dashcam. The approach involves extracting essential information through a multi-stage monitoring process to evaluate the driver's state thoroughly. The study includes a detailed analysis of webcam specifications, such as resolution, frame rate, and additional features. It also compares the traditional cascading technique with the advanced MediaPipe method, incorporating facial recognition, eye movement tracking, and head position analysis to detect driver fatigue accurately.

articleTitle: Innovative Solutions for Crop Health A Hybrid Approach to Cotton Root Rot Severity Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The proposed study aims to enhance our comprehension and control of the gravity of cotton root rot by integrating agricultural practices with technological advancements. The combination of a CNN, which possesses knowledge, with an SVM greatly enhances its ability to detect root rot. It possesses great strength, exhibits high adaptability, and demonstrates exceptional speed in task execution. The test results indicate that Cotton, a significant component of global agriculture, is currently confronted with a persistent issue caused by detrimental root rot. The cause of this issue is Phymatotrichopsis omnivora, which has the potential to negatively impact productivity if not well managed. Effectively managing illnesses relies on meticulous and prompt attention to the severity of root rot. Executing this challenging undertaking requires innovative concepts to achieve success. This study used a mixed model as a response. The method combines the properties of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) to develop a sophisticated approach for quantifying the severity of cotton root rot infections. Our inquiry starts with a substantial collection of 9,000 dispersed photographs. These high-resolution photographs depict the several manifestations of root rot in plants in proximity. Demonstrating the effectiveness of our blend model, we present a comprehensive accuracy rate of 98.56%. This demonstrates its proficiency in providing accurate and comprehensive threat assessments. The model’s accuracy, memory recall, and F1 score serve as indicators of its performance.

articleTitle: Enhancing Kiwi Leaf Disease Prediction: A Fusion of Convolutional Neural Networks and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The classification of performance indicators for each of the ten magnitude scale categories is briefly summarized in the abstract.
