articleTitle: Optimal Bandwidth Utilization Techniques for IoT Device Networks using Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The IoT devices have persisted on growing at a very fast pace and this has proven very challenging in managing the network bandwidth. This paper spins the new concept of increasing the IoT networks bandwidth by adopting the edge computing strategies. It also offers data processing near the sources which reduces the load on the central servers and cuts down data transfer requirements. The usage of the Dynamic Bandwidth Allocation algorithm in the proposed method also enhances the priority of the imperative data and scales up the transmission rates according to the network status. The number of data units achieve higher values, the latency is less and overall, better results have been obtained for the total network performance. Consequently, the results obtained presented pathways through which the bandwidth challenge in IoT could be addressed by means of edge computing to enhance IoT capacity in the corresponding surroundings.

articleTitle: Predictive Insights into Electric Vehicle Market Dynamics: An Exploration through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The burgeoning electric vehicle (EV) sector epitomizes a crucial transition towards more sustainable modes of transportation, underscored by the global imperative to mitigate carbon emissions. However, despite the technological strides made in this arena, the pace of EV adoption is tempered by a confluence of factors, including but not limited to the initial purchase cost, the driving range per charge, and prevailing consumer perceptions surrounding EV utility and feasibility. This investigation harnesses the analytical prowess of machine learning (ML) methodologies to delve into the nuanced dynamics of the EV market. By examining a comprehensive array of EV attributes, this study endeavors to distill the determinants that significantly sway consumer adoption patterns. Preliminary findings underscore the paramount influence of variables such as top speed, operational range, and rapid charging capability on the EV's market price, delineated by their pronounced positive correlations. These insights not only illuminate the attributes that consumers value most but also furnish automobile manufacturers with the empirical evidence needed to tailor their development and marketing strategies, thereby catalyzing the transition towards electric mobility.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of FinFET based Analog and Mixed Signal Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: FinFET technology has revolutionized analog and mixed-signal circuit design, enabling performance, savings in electricity, and scale improvements. This article provides a detailed strategy for constructing and improving FinFET-based circuits to overcome their three-dimensional sedimentation and electrostatic forces, characteristics. We examine state-of-the-art, highlighting notable advances and gaps. Optimal absolute authority, objectives, and area (PPA) metrics are accomplished by the incorporation of contemporary design tools and simulation approaches in our process. We demonstrate the realistic technique to implement analog circuits defined by FinFETs, which are much superior than traditional MOSFET designs, from in-depth case studies. Significant increases in both economy and reliability were noticed in the simulated circuits, demonstrating that our optimization processes efforts were beneficial. The conclusions of this study will be useful in influencing the path of FinFET technology going ahead, which should lead to better and more efficient conceptions of the old analog and mixed-signal circuits.

articleTitle: Yield Prediction and Nutrient Enhancement using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Predictive modeling offers a powerful approach to optimize nutrient management strategies and estimate crop yields. This study focuses on five key districts and five major crops in the region of Rajasthan, India. We evaluate the predictive accuracy of three modeling techniques: non-parametric artificial neural network (ANN) with multilinear regression, standalone ANN, and Random Forest model. These models are trained and tested on datasets collected from the study areas. Furthermore, we leverage the model predictions to assess the nutrients like nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium (NPK), water, and light requirements for crop growth, aiming to improve agricultural output.A novel aspect of our work is the application of an ANN-MLR hybrid model for yield prediction, providing new insights into efficient techniques for nutrient management and crop production estimation. The results have the potential to enhance agricultural productivity and sustainability in Rajasthan by informing evidence-based policy-making and agricultural practices. This research underscores the importance of integrating cutting-edge computational methods with traditional agricultural practices to address modern agricultural challenges and promote sustainable development in Rajasthan and beyond.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Approach to Food Spoilage Detection in Refrigerators: A Comparative Study on Methodologies and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper provides an in-depth comparative analysis of various food spoilage detection methods, encompassing gas sensory-based techniques, advanced machine learning approaches, and chemical-based methods. Through a comprehensive literature review and quantitative evaluation, these techniques are examined based on key factors essential for spoilage detection. Additionally, a secondary literature review investigates the main gases released from spoiled foods. The findings indicate that gas sensing is the most effective and cost-efficient method for detecting food spoilage, with methane being identified as the predominant volatile organic compound emitted during spoilage. The paper emphasizes the importance of food spoilage detection for extending shelf life and providing proactive indicators, highlighting the efficiency of gas sensing methods. In the latter part of the paper, the practical application of this concept within a refrigerator is discussed. This includes integrating a MOS-type gas sensor with an Arduino, followed by experiments with both spoiled and fresh food samples. The data obtained from these experiments are analyzed, confirming the effectiveness of this approach for timely spoilage detection in refrigerator environments.

articleTitle: Machine Failure Detection Using Artificial Neural Networks and a Comparison of Various Optimizers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Accurate identification of evolving failures in machines is an essential factor for industrial operations in a venture to reduce costs and disruptions affiliated to machine breakdowns. Machine failures not only compensate for the time lost waiting for the machine to be repaired but also result in costs that are incurred in repairing the damage and most times they lead to loss making instances. This research aims to construct a model of ANNs for predicting these failures. This research improves the current literature by comparing distinct optimization algorithms systematically to improve the ANN model’s performance. The layers include numerous dense layers with Activation function like Relu, several dropout layers for reducing overfitting, and L2 regularizations. The model was trained for 3500 epochs and it incorporated the utilization of different optimizers like Adam, SGD, RMSprop, Adagrad, Adadelta and utilized a binary cross-entropy loss function. The dataset used includes fourteen features vital in determining the condition of the machine and the risk of a failure. Amongst the different optimizers Adam gave the best results.

articleTitle: Building a Compassionate GenAI-integrated ASL Translator for YouTube Video
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Video streaming is crucial for modern entertainment, education, and communication, providing accessible content to a wide audience globally. However, deaf and hard of hearing communities may face barriers due to lack of or inadequate closed captioning, hindering their ability to fully engage with and comprehend streamed content. Our paper navigates through a transformative project centered on the development of a Generative AI for YouTube video translation, integrating Google Cloud with a compassionate approach to enhance accessibility for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing community through American Sign Language (ASL) translations. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as Google Cloud's Gen-AI and the Palm 2.0 Text Bison model, the project aims to revolutionize the landscape of YouTube video content by providing ASL translations for a more inclusive user experience. Key objectives include the creation of an ASL Translation Tool for YouTube videos, emphasizing inclusivity beyond mere translation to engage ASL users effectively. By harnessing Google Cloud technologies and APIs in a seamless and compassionate manner, the project ensures a thoughtful code structure and organized outputs that reflect its commitment to fostering inclusivity, understanding, and accessibility for all, particularly for the ASL community. Through this endeavor, the project endeavors to showcase how technology, when employed with empathy and foresight, can serve as a catalyst for positive change in promoting inclusivity and accessibility for diverse communication needs.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework for Satellite Image Dehazing Using Advanced Computational Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Satellite imagery information is used in many different ways; some of the more common ones are environmental and urban planning and disaster response. That is why haze has a highly negative impact on the quality and visibility of such images and their further usage. The following paper proposes an innovative approach to satellite images dehazing to enhance its value to professionals and researchers in the field. The ideas for the proposed method involve incorporating the use of machine learning algorithms into image enhancement procedures to adequately dehaze the images, increase image resolution, and enhance the efficiency of getting information from satellite images. Our approach involves a three-step process: seen as consisting of preprocessing, a dehazing network, and postprocessing. The preliminary processing generally includes initial enhancement operations such as histogram equalization and color stretch. The foundation of our framework is a deep learning-based dehazing network that uses CNNs, residual blocks, attention mechanisms, and GANs to dehaze and restore the images’ quality. Additional operations are performed in postprocessing; they include details enlargement, the removal of noise , and color correction so as to achieve natural and quality results. We evaluate our framework using two standard satellite image datasets: The users of the mentioned services are SateHaze1k and RICE. The effectiveness of the proposed method is evaluated by means of two quality measures, namely Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio and Structural Similarity Index. Test results portray the efficiency of the proposed technique in dehazing with enhanced PSNR and SSIM values over other conventional and state-of-art works on machine learning-based dehazing methods. That is why our framework can provide the workable and scalable solution for the improvement of the satellite images’ clarity that would be the beneficial for its usage in numerous applications.

articleTitle: Application of Explicit Group Sparse Projection in Optimizing 5G Network Resource Allocation and Topology Design
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The growing adoption of 5G networks in diverse domains like IoT, smart cities, healthcare, and industrial automation necessitates advanced optimization techniques. While existing approaches have shown promise, they are often limited by computational intensity, lack of adaptability, and specific focus on geometric constraints. This paper presents EGSP-5G, a novel methodology employing Explicit Group Sparse Projection (EGSP) for 5G network resource allocation and topology design. Its capability to achieve targeted sparsity levels allows for efficient utilization of network resources, thereby making it a versatile and powerful tool for various optimization tasks. Remarkably, EGSP-5G achieved a resource utilization rate of 90.02% and a throughput of 110.32 in networks comprising 1000 nodes. It stands as a robust and versatile solution for optimizing 5G networks across diverse application domains.

articleTitle: AI-Enabled Efficient Health Monitoring System using IoT-Based WBAN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN) devices enables real-time health monitoring, offering personalized insights and timely interventions. However, challenges like data privacy and regulatory compliance must be addressed for widespread adoption. Despite hurdles, this innovative approach promises to revolutionize healthcare delivery, enhancing efficiency and improving patient outcomes. Potential drawbacks for the AI-enabled health monitoring system using IoT-based WBAN include worries about privacy and data security, difficulties guaranteeing the accuracy and dependability of data acquired, and difficulties integrating various IoT devices and AI algorithms. To address these problems, strong security protocols, stringent testing protocols, and careful consideration of regulatory compliance to ensure the ethical and effective implementation of the system. Accurately identifying heartbeats is critical in the contemporary healthcare context since they are a signal for several underlying cardiac illnesses and a gauge of cardiorespiratory fitness. This method combines embedded sensors and Internet of Things technology to monitor glucose levels at the container level during injections. The system seeks to deliver real-time glucose level data by seamlessly combining various technologies, enabling artificial intelligence algorithms to make dynamic modifications. In this particular scenario, the combination of AI and IoT holds the potential to completely transform diabetes care by providing a more preventive and effective method of insulin administration and health monitoring The Internet of Things' latest developments in interactive apps and cloud computing have compelled researchers to reevaluate the way healthcare is currently provided. IoT systems that are cloud-based allow patients to get remote monitoring and assistance. The recommended approach demonstrates improved detection sensitivity and favorable prediction values when the user is walking after extracting the pertinent features from the input signals. The suggested method outperforms the most recent beat detection algorithms in terms of detection sensitivity and positive predictive values when used in an ambulatory setting. It can be used to reliably identify heartbeats in scenarios where IoT devices' single-channel monitoring frequently fails.

articleTitle: Enhancing Predictive Maintenance in Industrial IoT through Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Significant production losses and increased maintenance costs can arise from unplanned downtime in industrial settings caused by machine faults. In order to identify issues early and prevent significant breakdowns, predictive maintenance approaches make use of data collected from Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled devices installed in operating equipment. Here, we present a predictive maintenance system that employs machine learning methods, namely AdaBoost, to categorize various types of machine pauses in real-time, with a focus on knitting machines. Six different types of machine stops were classified using machine learning: idle stop, Lycra stop, full roll stop, gate stop, feeder stop, and needle stop. We did this by preprocessing and inputting machine learning model data, which included machine speeds and steps. After a rigorous training and optimization process that combines cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning, the model achieves an impressive accuracy rate of 92% on the test dataset. These results highlight how our suggested solution might help the textile sector become more productive and efficient overall by precisely detecting machine stoppage and enabling timely maintenance interventions.

articleTitle: Enhanced Forging Process Defect Prediction: Utilizing CNN-SVM Hybrid Models for Precision and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The main findings of our work on the hybrid CNN-SVM model's forging defect prediction and classification are succinctly summarized in the abstract. The model used consistently achieved high Precision, Recall, and F1-Score values, ranging from 91.67% to 94.19%, across multiple defect classes, including "Unfulfilled section on underfill," "Scale pits," "Col shut," "Flakes," "Surface cracking," "Die shift," "Remaining stress in forging," and "of Incomplete forging penetration." These measurements demonstrate the model's capacity to precisely and efficiently recognize and classify various forging faults. The Support values, which span from 775.00 to 945.00 for each defect class, highlight the resilience of the data in the collection and the model's capacity to manage a variety of forging failure cases. Additionally, the Support Ratio values offer information. These measurements demonstrate the model's capacity to precisely and efficiently recognize and classify various forging faults. The Support values, which span from 775.00 to 945.00 for each defect class, highlight the resilience exhibited by the dataset and the model's capacity to manage a variety of forging failure cases. Additionally, the Support Percent values reveal information on the proportional abundance of defect classes in the whole set of data, with each class making a proportionate contribution to the composition of the entire dataset. Our algorithm performs exceptionally well in precisely predicting forging faults across the board, with a median accuracy of 98%. The model's efficacy and consistency are further confirmed by the 93.3% averages of the macro, weighted, and micro average measures. The results above demonstrate the validity and applicability of one's hybrid model. and its capacity to improve quality control procedures and transform fault prediction in industrial welding operations.

articleTitle: ENLS: Experimental Evaluation of Credit Card Fraud Identification System Using Elevated Neural Learning Scheme With Cybersecurity Features
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Rapid developments in e-commerce have led to a meteoric rise in credit card usage. More and more people are falling victim to credit card fraud as a result of this payment method's widespread use. Consequently, we want a robust and reliable fraud detection system to put a stop to these scams. We have covered the basics of credit card theft in this article. Finding a remedy to these sorts of scams is, thus, quite crucial. We developed a model to identify fraudulent credit card transactions in this article. The majority of the critical capabilities needed to identify fraudulent and unlawful transactions can be met by this system. The pattern and behaviour of illicit transactions are getting more difficult to trace due to the ongoing change in technology. Using technology that incorporates an enhanced deep learning scheme, known as an Elevated Neural Learning Scheme (ENLS), can help find a solution. In order to determine how effective the suggested scheme is, this method is cross-validated using the traditional learning technique known as Logistic Regression (LR). In order to do this, we apply various classification models to the data, including ENLS and LR, and then we quantify the model's performance using quantitative metrics like accuracy. Our study's conclusion describes the optimal classifier by training and testing with the suggested methods, which yields a superior answer.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Automotive Software Development through Integration of Engine Control Unit Signals for Adaptive Autonomous Emergency Braking
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper explores the integration of engine control unit (ECU) signals within an IoT-enabled automotive software development framework. The study focuses on leveraging ECU data for real-time decision-making in adaptive systems, enhancing automotive safety and performance through advanced software development and testing methodologies. It presents the design and implementation of an adaptive autonomous emergency braking (AEB) system for automotive safety applications, focusing on the integration of engine control unit (ECU) signals within an IoT-driven software framework. The system employs a network of sensors and cameras to continuously monitor the vehicle’s surroundings and detect potential obstacles. When the vehicle’s battery and ignition are switched on, the sensors/cameras send detected obstacle signals to the ECU, which in turn initiates signal processing via Controller Area Network (CAN) communication. The signal processing algorithm analyzes the obstacle’s distance and the vehicle’s speed to assess collision risks in real-time. Upon detecting a potential collision, the system triggers a warning on the Human-Machine Interface (HMI) to alert the driver. If the driver fails to respond promptly, the AEB system automatically activates the brakes to prevent a collision.

articleTitle: Building 'Peer Dorm' - A Next-Generation Social Networking Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Today's digital world provides the alter means of utilizing the technology for releasing the videos that has completely changed the scenario of information and educational content often gets underestimated. The following is from the standpoint of the society discussing the unsolved issues with the existing service channels regarding variety of educational requirements. It hints that by making a dedicated platform just for learning through video that will help to instead of get lost in unrelated content, remove distractions, making things easier to find the video related to learning. The widely different organization of video lessons, lack of active involvement, and problems with synchronicity are among the main obstacles. The proposed platform provides video lessons using the orderly structure as well as it offers a way of communicating with the users by messaging. It is as the technology that it adds value to online education which can attract a lot of learners with its high quality and interesting content and by community building. The research presented in this article offers a new way of tackling digital education through a collaborative engagement of users resulting in growth through knowledge.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Solar-Powered Electric Golf Cart
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The research uses MATLAB Simulink to simulate and analyze solar-powered electric golf carts to evaluate their sustainability, efficiency, and performance. Using Simulink, a thorough simulation model includes all necessary elements and assesses performance in various operational and environmental scenarios. According to the study, solar-powered electric golf carts can lower carbon emissions, lessen reliance on fossil fuels, and provide environmentally beneficial transportation options. Additional optimization techniques to improve the efficiency and performance of carts are discussed, such as improvements in battery technology, vehicle design, operating protocols, and solar panel efficiency. The applicability for real-world scenario simulations is demonstrated in an in-depth study with MATLAB Simulink. With its conclusions, suggestions, and directions for further study and improvement, this research adds to the conversation on solar-powered electric cars and sustainable transportation by utilizing MATLAB Simulink's capabilities for simulation and analysis.

Author Keywords: Environmental sustainability Simulation of Electric vehicle systems

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Cervical Cancer Prediction and Prevention in Women’s Health
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Cervical cancer remains a significant health concern worldwide, especially in regions with limited access to healthcare resources. Early detection and prevention are crucial for reducing the burden of this disease. In recent years, deep learning has emerged as a promising tool for analyzing medical data and improving diagnostic accuracy. This article explores the application of deep learning techniques in predicting and preventing cervical cancer. Pap smear screening is used to screen for cervical cancer in order to diagnose and categorize the disease. To identify and categorize cervical tissue abnormalities, Pap smear pictures of the cervical region are used. We presented a deep learning-based approach in this paper that can categorize pap smear images into different classifications. A computer-aided diagnosis method that classifies abnormalities in cervical imaging cells is designed using Pap smear images. Seven image classes are discriminated using automated features that were derived using ResNet101. The ability of the proposed approach to differentiate between the usual case levels with 95.02sensitivity and 95.93% accuracy. Furthermore, it has a 95.93 accuracy rate in differentiating between normal and a typical instance. After that, the high degree of anomaly is examined and accurately classified.

articleTitle: Real Time Mood Detection on Music Streaming Platforms: A Deep learning perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The facial expressions of a user can be used to identify their emotional state or mood. The device’s camera can also be used to capture these expressions as they are being displayed on the live stream. Machine learning is a promising tool for learning about human emotions. One of the most common methods for developing a trained model is through the MobileNet model with the Keras framework.The practice of determining a person’s emotions via a variety of facial expressions and visual signals is known as emotion detection. Since deep learning has become more and more popular, this discipline has expanded rapidly. Additionally, a lot of hitherto unimagined applications have been made possible by emotion recognition. Music is one of the things that is closely related to feelings. A person experiencing a certain mood may seek for a song that evokes the same emotion in them. Our emotion detection model allows us to associate these emotions with a music player that plays music in time with user experiences. The model we developed consists of two convolutional neural network (CNN) models: a global average pooling (GAP) model and a five-layer model.

articleTitle: Enhanced ResNet-18: A Novel Approach for Automated Classification and Early Detection of Eye Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Eye disease classification is a topic of much concern among states worldwide. The object is to apply advanced algorithms developed on the basis of research to a variety of previous models and thus make them more flexible in an attempt to accurately diagnose all sorts of eye diseases using photographs as evidence. This paper adopted the methods of machine learning and computer vision to classify images for four types of eye disorders: cataract, diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, and normal conditions. In this study, we retrained ResNet-18 with a learning rate of 5x10^-5 within the ResNet-18 block and 8x10^-4 for additional dense layers. The performance of our model was excellent, with an overall accuracy of 0.86. Especially notable was that the model had high precision, recall, and F1-score for diabetic retinopathy cataract. But for other glaucoma groups, it scored markedly lower on these metrics. These results clearly suggest the potential of the model for early discovery, diagnosis, supervision, and treatment plans for eye diseases and will thus be of immense benefit to human society in general as well as individual medical treatments. This will contribute to society by contributing positively to the general level of medical care. Doctors and nurses everywhere are using these results as a general reference manual, aiming for high-quality outcomes at a reasonable cost throughout the healthcare industry.

articleTitle: Integrating Deep Learning in Project Management: Improving Efficiency and Effectiveness in Project Planning and Execution
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to explore the use of deep learning technologies, namely the K-Nearest Neighbors model within the textile manufacturing process to test the improvement of the said process. To properly implement the model, we must use real-time data from the process and evaluate the improvement depending on a number of factors: how much does the maintenance cost decrease, how accurate is the inventory management, and how well the program forecasts demand, all of which should lead to an improvement of profit. First, the analysis of the results proved that the implementation of KNN model leads to a significant decrease of maintenance costs: while without the model the reduction was 15%, with it cost maintenance cost a 25% decrease. Second, the usage of a model improves inventory management accuracy: before the use of KNN, it was 85%, while after it rose to 95%. Third, demand forecasting becomes more accurate, as the difference was 75% to the positive without the model and 90% with it. The use of a model improved all aspects, and the most improved was profit: before the implementation of the KNN model, profit was 10%, and it was 40% after, which led to the conclusion that the implementation of deep learning models, namely the KNN model, improves the effectiveness of textile manufacturing process and positively affects the profitability and the production process as a whole.

articleTitle: Refining BERT Adversarial Attacks with Projected Gradient Descent
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Adversarial attacks against deep learning models represent a major threat to the security and reliability of natural language processing (NLP) systems. In this paper, we propose modifying the BERT-Attack framework, integrating Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) to enhance its effectiveness and robustness. The original BERT-Attack, designed for generating adversarial examples against BERT-based models, suffers from limitations such as a fixed perturbation budget and a lack of consideration for semantic similarity. The proposed approach in this work, PGD-BERT-Attack, addresses these limitations by leveraging PGD to iteratively generate adversarial examples while ensuring both imperceptibility and semantic similarity to the original input. Extensive experiments are conducted to evaluate the performance of PGD-BERT-Attack compared to the original BERT-Attack and other baseline methods. The results demonstrate that PGD-BERT-Attack achieves higher success rates in causing misclassification while maintaining low perceptual changes. Furthermore, PGD-BERT-Attack produces adversarial instances that exhibit greater semantic resemblance to the initial input, enhancing their applicability in real-world scenarios. Overall, the proposed modification offers a more effective and robust approach to adversarial attacks on BERT-based models, thus contributing to the advancement of defense against attacks on NLP systems.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Casting Surface Defects Using CNN-Random Forest Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the abstract, The article examines a classification model developed to find and classify surface flaws in casting processes, with an emphasis on five unique defect classes: strike, scar, scab, drop, or penetration. The efficacy of the model is thoroughly tested using accuracy, recall, or F1-Score metrics, and support values representing the number of examples in each class. The support proportion highlights the relative prevalence of each class in the sample. The model achieves impressive precision, and recall, with F1-Score values ranging from 97.74% to 98.22% across the various fault classes. The support values vary between 1335 to 1405, indicating the diversity in instances in each class. A precision of 99% demonstrates the model's general ability to make correct predictions. The macro-average, weighted-average, or micro-average metrics provide a comprehensive view of the model's performance, demonstrating its uniformity in predicting defects across categories. The investigation continues by emphasizing the model's durability and possible uses in real-world circumstances, demonstrating its dependability in detecting casting surface defects. The suggested model's high accuracy, as well as recall values, indicate that it can transform inspection processes in the metallurgical industry, resulting in improved product safety, effectiveness, and quality.

articleTitle: An Extensive Review: Models For Regional Language Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Speech is the most common form of communication. Speech recognition remains an important milestone as it facilitates human-computer interaction and makes the communication rather simpler. It remains an asset across endless domains including healthcare, education, robotics and automation. Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems have advanced significantly in their performance over the years, but transcribing languages remains a challenge. Hindi as a language has more than 600M speakers worldwide. The involvement of ASR systems is still far from the reach of these people. The primary reason for this challenge is the scattered and unorganised nature of available data. Our research aims to provide an analysis of mainstream and recognised speech recognition models for Hindi language: Wav2Vec2, Whisper, and DeepSpeech. Furthermore, our paper highlights each model’s strengths and limitations by diving into their architecture, learning methodologies, and unique characteristics. Noteworthy aspects of each model include Wav2Vec2’s self-supervised learning, Whisper’s reliance on multilingual datasets, and Deep Speech’s scalability in industry applications. By carefully weighing the pros and cons of each model, we intend to provide an analysis of the current status of advancements towards automatic speech recognition.

articleTitle: Metal Detectives: Investigating Defects in Narrow Strip Sheet Metal Using CNN-SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: According to this research, Ensuring the production of thin strip metal sheets with excellent quality standards is of utmost importance, as the presence of flaws such as Coil Set, Crossbow, and Torsion may have a substantial negative effect on the performance of the end product. This paper introduces a hybrid machine learning approach that efficiently detects and classifies these defects by combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with Support Vector Machines (SVMs). The system's efficacy was evaluated utilizing essential performance metrics, such as precision, recall, F1score, and accuracy. The suggested model demonstrated exceptional performance, with an overall accuracy of 98% across all fault categories. The results indicate that the CNN-SVM hybrid technique performs well and consistently in detecting faults. This method provides a reliable alternative for improving quality control in the manufacturing of metal sheets in industrial environments. This technology is crucial for the metal sheet sector since it helps cut manufacturing costs and improve product quality by enhancing fault detection procedures.

articleTitle: Advancing Metallurgical Quality Assurance: Predictive Modeling for Defect Detection using CNN-Random Forest Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the abstract, reliable metallurgical fault identification is a critical component of preserving metals' quality and dependability in a wide range of technical uses. With this work, we provide a unique method of automatic metallurgical defect detection that blends convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with Random Forests. The study thoroughly evaluates the model's efficacy across several defect classes, including discrimination, laminations, flaws, cold shutts, warm sobbing, gas porosity, surface oxidation, blowholes, particles, or hydrogen embrittlement. The classification system has exceptional precision and recall, with F1-Score values and overall accuracy exceeding 99%. The micro and macro averages show that the framework is consistent in finding flaws across classes, indicating that it can manage a variety of geometries including materials. The weighted average accounts for class size imbalances, illustrating the structure's adaptability to different defect prevalence scenarios. The micro average, which shows overall performance across all classes, indicates the model's ability to detect metallurgical flaws holistically. The amalgamation of CNNs and random forests uses CNNs' deep learning skills for spatial feature extraction and Randomised Forests' ensemble capacity for learning to improve the precision of classification. This research adds to the development of automated fault detection methods in metallurgy by offering a scalable and adaptable solution for use in reality. The recommended algorithm's excellent accuracy and recall values indicate it has the potential to alter metallurgical inspection procedures, leading to enhanced product safety, effectiveness, along quality.

articleTitle: Prediction of Student Alcoholism and Academic Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study examines the concerning rise of alcohol consumption among high school students and its negative consequences on academic achievement. We explore the influence of socio-educational factors, including socioeconomic background, peer relationships, and school environment, on alcohol use patterns. Additionally, we investigate the moderating role of parental engagement and family dynamics in the relationship between alcohol consumption and academic performance. Utilizing the Student Alcoholism and Academic Performance Dataset, we employ data preprocessing techniques, we address missing data, convert categorical variables into a suitable format for modelling, and normalize numerical features to prevent bias. Through exploratory data analysis, we gain insights into descriptive statistics, data distributions, and correlations, revealing the extent of alcohol's impact on academic outcomes. Dimensionality reduction via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) streamlines the dataset for further analysis. We implement the Random Forest Regression algorithm to develop predictive models for academic performance based on the identified socio-educational factors and alcohol consumption habits. Evaluating model performance using mean squared error calculations, we aim to provide actionable insights for designing targeted interventions. These interventions will focus on mitigating the detrimental effects of adolescent alcohol use on student success and promoting a healthier learning environment.

articleTitle: Integrated CNN-Random Forest Model for Accurate Rice Variety Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The rice variety classification model has impressive performance, highlighted in this summary. Using accuracy measures like precision and recall, it effectively distinguishes five rice varieties (Arborio, Basmati, Ipsala, Jasmine, Karacadag). Precision, measuring how accurate the model's positive predictions are, was consistently high, over 94%, with Arborio receiving the highest score (95.42%). Similarly, recall, which shows how well the model can find true positives, followed a similar pattern. The study of a dataset with 11,700 photos is shown in the Abstract. The model's remarkable 94.87% overall accuracy is the result of this examination. This shows that the model can accurately capture the characteristics that set each rice variety apart. The model's accuracy is impressive, with F1 scores consistently above 94.84%. These scores measure the balance between the model's ability to correctly identify events and minimize false positives. The weighted average measures overall performance, considering different class sizes. The model's precision, recall, and F1-Score all reach 94.87% in the weighted average, showcasing its reliability in handling varying class sizes and maintaining accuracy across the entire dataset. The model's overall performance was confirmed by very high average accuracy measures, with a consistent 94.87% accuracy across all rice varieties. The model's outstanding 98% accuracy rate highlights its precision in differentiating between five specific rice types: Arborio, Basmati, Ipsala, Jasmine, and Karacadag. Not only does this accuracy demonstrate the model's effectiveness in classification, but it also establishes it as a reliable tool for various applications in agriculture, such as management, trade, and quality control. The model's ability to detect subtle differences in rice varieties positions it as an essential tool for stakeholders in the agricultural industry, providing them with valuable information.

articleTitle: Stereo Matching for Terrain Mapping using Aerial Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In recent years, the demand for accurate and detailed terrain mapping has escalated in the field of urban planning and environmental monitoring. Advanced techniques like Stereo matching using Semi-Global Matching (SGM) have been in use for years to generate depth maps. In this paper, the use of this algorithm is expanded to generate depth maps for various terrain regions using SGM on stereo pair of aerial imagery. Five variations are compared with each other namely linear stretching followed by Gaussian blur, dilation, bilateral filtering, guided filtering and morphological operations. after fine-tuning the SGM variables for different terrains (ground, city, river, mountains, etc.). Pre-processing techniques for color enhancement and smoothening on input aerial images have been tested to determine their usability, along with post-processing methods for noise reduction, occlusion handling and edge preservation in order to produce an accurate disparity map. The results have been evaluated using RMSEs values and visual analysis. The proposed methodology serves as an effective way to generate 3D models for complex terrain regions without the need of generating expensive ground truths providing up to 8% greater accuracy compared to existing SGM models for different terrain types.

articleTitle: Impact of Channel Estimation on Load Balancing in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: With the proliferation of mobile devices and the Internet of Things (IoT) in 5G networks, it is crucial to make the most of the limited spectrum resources. The growing number of mobile users and the need for excellent communication service quality necessitate the implementation of ultra-dense heterogeneous networks (HetNets), composed of macro, micro, Pico, and femto cells. In HetNets, several cell types offer varying degrees of cell coverage and system capacity. For their adaptability in deployment and superior signal quality, small cells are a popular choice. A macrocell distributes its workload across numerous hotspot zones to accommodate a growing number of users with high traffic demands. The objective of this research is to examine the impact of channel conditions in the Het Nets on convergence based on load balancing techniques. In order to identify load imbalances, an LB algorithm continuously checks the network parameters. When user endpoints (UEs) in overloaded cells request connectivity, an optimization algorithm identifies potential base stations (BSs) to remove from the network. We methodically examine and graphically represent the findings, providing significant insights into the performance of the suggested strategy in various circumstances. In this research, we strictly aim to determine the transmission rate in the rural area scenario, both before and after the implementation of load balancing mechanisms such as Max-SINR, Q Learning, and Deep Q Learning. The best transmission rate achieved would be around 4.52 in the Deep Q Learning algorithm.

articleTitle: Automatic Regulation of Voltage using ANN, ANFIS, Fuzzy Logic Controller and combine LFC approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: A voltage regulator for synchronous generators that runs automatically. It is utilized by each electrical equipment that requires regulation and stability. an electrical device that automatically regulates the AVR's generated supply terminal voltage in order to maintain it at a certain level whether the amount of work is changing. AVR is widely utilized in power systems since it's important to produce appropriate consistency and accurately regulate diverse devices. However, AVR should be used with any suitable controller to get beyond sluggish response times brought on by disturbances, as this will result in effective stability. In order to demonstrate increasing time, undershoot, and overshoot in accordance with other study report assessments, this study examines (PID) proportional integral derivative Controllers. This article describes the adaptive neuro-fuzzy interference system (ANFIS), which blends Artificial neural networks (ANN) and fuzzy logic controller and load frequency control (LFC). In order to enhance the simulation result of the controller, we investigate AVR in this study employing several methodologies.

articleTitle: An Efficient Spell Checker System for Paragraphs and Baudot Codes Using Tries
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study describes an interactive spell- checking tool designed to improve text input accuracy and usability. Spell checking is necessary to reduce spelling errors such as phonetic errors and thus boost the overall message passing system. The purpose of this spell-checking tool is to alleviate the orthographic errors of the English language, which in most cases result in spelling mistakes and other typographical issues. It employs existing techniques, such as the trie data structure, to correct misspellings and offer adjustments thereby improving the overall user experience. In Our project we included Baudot code, is an early character encoding for telegraphical work. The project is divided into two phases: spell checking and baudot code integration. The spell-checking mechanism is designed to discover and handle misspelled words in user- provided input. If a word is determined as misspelled, the system returns the three closest suggestions. The project introduces the spell checking for Baudot code, a character encoding system represented in permutation and combination of ’+’ and ’-’ of length five for each alphabet. Words written in Baudot code are decoded and compared with the dictionary they contain, which makes it possible to transfer encoded messages, especially in limited-purpose stenographic work, like for spy- operations. HashMaps are used to store Baudot codes for each alphabet, allowing for faster and more efficient encoding and decoding mechanisms. This implemented spell-checking tool is projected to significantly improve the feasibility and practicability of text processing through the use of a two- phase technique. Spelling errors must be properly identified and eliminated.

articleTitle: Transforming Healthcare: AI Models for Predictive Analysis in Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: With significant ramifications for predictive analysis in medical applications, the introduction of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into healthcare represents a revolutionary change. This study examines how AI models could transform healthcare, especially in the areas of illness management, diagnosis, and treatment. AI may analyze enormous datasets, find patterns, and provide incredibly accurate patient outcome forecasts by utilizing sophisticated algorithms and machine learning approaches. The vast amounts of sensitive medical data required for AI analysis necessitate robust safeguards to protect patient confidentiality and prevent data breaches. The interpretability and transparency of judgments made by AI are also questioned due to the black-box aspect of some AI models, particularly deep learning algorithms. Ensuring the dependability and security of AI systems requires the establishment of defined protocols for data management, model validation, and performance monitoring. The establishment of a regulatory framework that promotes innovation and protects the interests of public health requires cooperation between regulatory agencies, healthcare facilities, and AI developers. To sum up, artificial intelligence (AI) models have great potential for predictive analysis in medical applications. They could completely transform patient care and the delivery of healthcare. By harnessing AI's power, healthcare providers can achieve earlier diagnoses, more effective treatments, and better resource management. However, realizing this potential requires addressing ethical, privacy, and regulatory challenges to ensure AI is deployed responsibly and effectively, paving the way for a more predictive, preventive, and personalized approach to medicine.

articleTitle: Innovative Insights: Unifying CNN and SVM for Broad Metal Sheet Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Through the use of a hybrid model that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM), this research study presents a novel approach to the identification and classification of faults in large metal sheets. Wavy edges, one-sided wavy edges, coil breaks, and central buckles are the four types of flaws that are especially investigated in this study. Not only does the model that was recommended have exceptional performance, but it also has an overall accuracy of 99% for all types of flaws. Each defect category consistently achieves accuracy, recall, and F1-scores that are higher than 96%, which is evidence of the model's reliability and longevity. Taking into consideration the fact that the accuracy, recall, and F1-scores for the macro, weighted, and micro averages are all 97.01%, it is clear that the model's performance is effectively balanced. The extraordinary accuracy and uniformity that was shown here highlights the possibilities of merging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with Support Vector Machines (SVMs) in order to offer effective quality control in the manufacturing of large metal sheets.

articleTitle: Disentangled Attention Based Multi-Task Learning with Structural Estimations for Audio Feature Processing and Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Self-supervised learning utilizes unlabelled data to extract latent representations, replacing conventional input features in downstream tasks. In the realm of audio and speech signal processing, an array of features has been engineered over time through extensive research. Interestingly, predicting these features has emerged as a pertinent pretext task, yielding valuable self-supervised representations that prove effective for subsequent tasks. However, the effective fusion of these pretext tasks to enhance performance in downstream tasks lacks comprehensive exploration and understanding. In this paper, We applied attention base knowledge transfer (ATK) base proposed model with DeBERTa using the specified dataset and proceeded to compare its accuracy against established state-of-the-art models. Subsequently, we evaluated the training, validation, and testing loss of our multitask model in comparison with high-performing existing models. The results demonstrated that our proposed model exhibited the lowest test loss, reaching a remarkable value of 0.018. Moreover, we can extend this research to cover more complex tasks beyond audio data classification with large unlabelled datasets.

articleTitle: An Egg Incubator with IoT-Based Control and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This study explores the design, development, and implementation of an innovative IoT-based smart egg incubator to enhance efficiency and reliability in poultry farming. The incubator integrates advanced monitoring and control systems to regulate temperature, humidity, and egg rotation, optimizing conditions for successful hatch rates. Farmers can remotely monitor and manage incubation processes using IoT technology and a mobile application interface, ensuring continuous oversight and timely responses to environmental changes. Key features include an automated emergency power backup system and motion detection with a live camera feed for real-time monitoring of egg development. Results demonstrate significant improvements in energy efficiency, environmental control, and operational reliability, positioning the smart incubator as a sustainable solution for modern poultry farming practices.

articleTitle: Investigating Charging and Discharging Behaviors of Electric Vehicle Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The exponential spread of electric vehicles (EVs) has brought the need to understand battery charging and discharging behavior to improve its efficiency and lifespan. This study describes the learning process using simulation and various analyses. The usage of EVs in the automotive industry is a prospective branch because the future of transportation is unimaginable without the reliability of their batteries. Efficient charging and discharging processes are possible ways to ensure that batteries will last longer and not lose their power, which requires learning of such a battery’s behavior in different environments. The simscape battery protection simulation for the charging and discharging processes was run founded on MATLAB programing. The thermal impact, SoC, SoH, and voltage were analyzed. Moreover, a Battery Management System (BMS) was executed to monitor the stability of the battery. The C rate should be sustained during charging and discharging. In general, the first scenario illustrated the significant impact of battery discharge rates on battery capacity and health. Thus, strategies for optimizing discharge should be pursued. The second scenario also indicated the difficulty in integrating real-world driving conditions, which are known as strong battery management systems. The third scenario revealed the negative implications of high temperatures on the charging process, highlighting the importance of effective thermal management systems. These lessons can aid in the development of EV performance. In addition, further studies might develop battery management systems for different operating conditions and create solutions to the problem of high temperatures. These factors would further increase the availability of EVs as a sustainable means of transportation.

articleTitle: An Explanatory Machine Learning Method for the Identification of DDoS Attacks in SDN Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Online services are the backbone of the digital world. A distributed denial of service (DDoS) attack is a persistent risk to the accessibility of internet facilities. Detecting DDoS attacks as they occur is only one of the problems; tracking down attack streams is another major obstacle to mitigation. However, DDoS attacks are difficult, if not impossible, to detect using current attack detection systems. In this paper, an innovative methodology is proposed to classify the traffic flow as DDoS attacks in software-defined networking. The proposed system is comprised of three steps. The initial stage involves pre-AI modeling explanations, where the data is presented visually to extract valuable insights. In addition, the data undergoes pre-processing to detect and eliminate any null values. One hot encoding approach is utilized to transform String features into numerical ones. The next step involves using machine learning modeling techniques, where a range of ML algorithms are applied to the pre-processed data. Out of all the ML models available, the decision tree and random forest models stand out as the top performers with an accuracy of 100%. The last step involves explaining the predictions made by the ML models. In order to clarify the predictions, Explainable Artificial Intelligence is utilized. Implementing the proposed approach in real-time will enhance the ability to precisely distinguish DDoS attacks and provide clear explanations for the predictions made.

articleTitle: Improved Skin Disease Classification By Segmentation and Feature Mapping using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: In the realm of medical diagnostics, the accurate classification of skin diseases through imaging represents a significant advancement, potentially enhancing patient outcomes through timely and precise treatment. This study critically examines the effectiveness of four advanced machine learning models—XGBoost, CNN, LSTM_RNN, and Residual-XGBoost—in the classification of skin lesions from dermatological images. Following a rigorous methodology, the research involved the collection, preprocessing, and segmentation of a substantial dataset of skin lesion images, subsequently applying the ResNet architecture for feature extraction and leveraging XGBoost in an ensemble approach for the classification task. Among the evaluated models, the Residual-XGBoost demonstrated exceptional performance, achieving the highest scores across all metrics in both binary and multiclass classification scenarios. Specifically, it attained an accuracy of 99.12%, precision of 95.12%, recall of 95.34%, F1-Score of 96.34%, and an AUC of 97.34% in binary classification tasks. This outperformance underscores its potential as a leading tool in the automated diagnosis of skin diseases. In contrast, the LSTM_RNN model showed notable strengths in precision (96.34%) and recall (96.34%), making it especially valuable for identifying true positive cases, whereas CNNs offered a balanced performance across accuracy (91.23%) and F1-Score (92.12%), suggesting their applicability in tasks requiring a harmonious balance of precision and recall.

articleTitle: AI-driven Solutions for Autonomous Maintenance and Fault Detection in Electrical Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Efficient and reliable power grids are crucial for the functioning of modern society. However, increasing energy demand and renewable sources can lead to power failures. Traditional methods struggle. AI, particularly Random Forest Classifiers, offers a promising approach. These classifiers analyse vast amounts of grid data to identify patterns indicative of faults. This allows for real-time anomaly detection. This research investigates the efficacy of Random Forest models for fault classification, focusing on optimising data preprocessing and collection. Transparency in data collection and model development is crucial for data privacy. While simulated environments pose challenges for early fault detection, real-world data presents even greater complexities. The effectiveness of Random Forest Classifiers in early fault detection is critical for grid reliability, reducing power outages, and enhancing long-term operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Improving Foot Deformity Detection in Children: Synthetic Plantar Pressure Data Generation with GMM and GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The identification of leg deformities in children is pivotal for ensuring timely and effective medical intervention. Plantar pressure is the pressure field that acts between the foot and the support surface during everyday locomotor activities. Prior works on automatic identification of foot deformities based on plantar pressure made use of machine learning approaches. Of late, deep learning techniques have been providing state of the art performance in classification tasks. However, these algorithms require a sufficiently large labelled training data for good performance. This paper proposes two different methods for generating plantar pressure data synthetically. The first approach makes use of Gaussian Mixture Models(GMM) for generating the plantar pressure data for three distinct foot types: flat, normal, and pes cavus. The second approach makes use of one dimensional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) for synthetic data production. The synthetically generated plantar pressure data is augmented into an existing database and subsequently classified using various machine learning approaches and one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). Experiments conducted on the publicly available plantar pressure dataset show an improvement in accuracy on the incorporation of the synthetic plantar pressure data.

articleTitle: Kavach - An Investigation tool for Cryptocurrency Forensics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The expansion of decentralized cryptocurrencies poses notable complexities for law enforcement in terms of detecting unlawful behaviors, as well as in the identification of individuals and the retrieval of transaction histories of perpetrators who take advantage of the pseudonymous nature inherent in the cryptocurrency system. This research paper puts forth a solution called Kavach. The designated user of Kavach will be an investigator. The tool leverages graph machine learning for the categorization of transactions as illicit or legitimate. It utilizes graph-based embeddings for the recognition of potentially suspicious addresses within the bitcoin network. The tool incorporates a predefined watch list for such suspicious addresses and will have the capability to trace the digital trail of these addresses using Open Source Intelligence (OSINT).

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Proportional to Absolute Temperature (PTAT) Pulse Generator for Integrated Temperature Sensing in 180nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The study introduces a Low Power Pulse Generator for on-chip temperature sensing purposes, achieving a Proportional to Absolute Temperature (PTAT) current reference ranging from 3.49uA to 4.28uA as temperature increases from 0 to 100 degrees Celsius. Through two simulations, the impact of a sleep transistor on power dissipation in a voltage-controlled oscillator was evaluated, resulting in a notable decrease in power consumption from 126.1344 uW without the sleep transistor to 17.7691 uW with its integration. Analysis indicates that the oscillator's output pulse varies proportionally with temperature changes, ranging from 318 MHz to 1.09 GHz within the 0 to 100 degrees Celsius range. Both current and output pulse exhibit proportional increases relative to temperature variations, suggesting a correlation with absolute temperature. Furthermore, the circuit showcases low power consumption, remaining below 30 uA, with the pulse generator consuming only 26.8304 uW, underscoring its efficiency for low-power applications.

articleTitle: OEE Dashboard using Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: To assess the productivity of the equipment, the overall equipment effectiveness, a crucial performance metric, is used (OEE). The goal of this work includes examining and analyzing OEE growth and identifying potential regions for future development. The usefulness of the current dashboards is discussed in this study along with a thorough analysis of the literature and cutting-edge analytical techniques. When analyzing equipment’s utilization capacity and unit production, the individual stoppages and break times must be taken into consideration. The findings of OEE must also be changed accordingly. Correlation between technical and management difficulties is the fundamental strategy used to get the desired results. Analysis results are made available to the employee who look after the production statistics, here the results prepared using modern tool. The major difference in traditional and modern tool result visualization is, tools give more interactive analysis which can be easily interpreted by a non-technical person as well. Real-world efficiency has increased, but as technology develops, new opportunities for improvement frequently appear.

articleTitle: Exploring the Effectiveness of Attention Based Visual Question Answering Model for Addressing Language Prior Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The objective of a Visual Question Answering (VQA) system is to accurately generate the response to a user’s query considering an image and a question associated with the image. The VQA system requires processing images and text to obtain valuable features and utilize these features for answer generation. The model trained on an imbalanced dataset may produce an incorrect outcome for the query with similar staring words, making VQA a challenging task. The paper explores the importance of an attention-based approach to focus on specific regions of image and question. A balanced VQA dataset is derived from the original dataset and used for experimentation. The re-attention framework utilizing cross-attention between question and image is used to obtain valuable features and predict correct outcomes. The experimentation evaluation of the re-attention framework achieves an accuracy of 68.91% on the balance VQA dataset. The comparative assessment shows that the attention-based approach efficiently overcomes the limitation of VQA and handles the language prior problem.

articleTitle: Integrated Approaches for Agricultural Landscape Monitoring and Plant Disease Management
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: India, a major agricultural hub, ranks among the top global crop producers. Despite this, Indian farmers often face social and economic challenges. Choosing the best and most lucrative crop for a specific area is difficult because of the varied soil types found in different regions. To address this challenge, Machine Learning (ML) model is utilized to create a crop recommendation system. This system would examine factors including region, type of the soil, yield as well as selling price to forecast the most suitable crop for successful cultivation. Plant diseases are prevalent in agriculture, posing challenges for farmers. Detecting these diseases, especially in extensive fields, is crucial. Farmers face difficulties switching between disease control methods. Traditional approaches rely on surveillance and monitoring by experts, particularly for identifying tomato leaf diseases. If not addressed, plant quality and production suffer. One possible approach to tackle these difficulties is by introducing a crop recommendation system that utilizes Machine Learning. This system aims to enhance disease detection and improve overall crop management for better agricultural outcomes. This system aims to assist farmers by analyzing diverse parameters like region, soil type, yield, and market prices to suggest optimal crops for cultivation. Additionally, the discussion highlights the growing importance of plant disease detection through technological advancements, emphasizing the need for effective disease monitoring to safeguard crop quality and production.

articleTitle: Unlocking Democracy: A Blockchain Odyssey in E-Voting Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: Embarking on a transformative journey, a pioneering blockchain-based e-voting system is unveiled, set to redefine democratic processes with tamper-resistant elections and transparent voting through smart contracts. The system provides real-time results. Each vote is instantly recorded and can be witnessed by the participant. To ensure secure participation, Google authentication with Firebase and MongoDB is introduced for user verification on public forums. Private organizations can also limit their voting to specific groups using their credentials with added security through a JWT-based authentication system. This enables organizations to control voting access, minimizes the risk of unauthorized access and manipulation. Securely generating and storing JWTs on the server side ensures participants remain anonymous and secure throughout the prototype. This setup demonstrates a peer-to-peer voting system that grants equal power to everyone involved and provides real-time results. Additionally, the significance and evolutionary principles of blockchain in e-voting are briefly discussed, emphasizing the importance of transparent and secure democratic participation.

articleTitle: Practical Applications of Cyber security: A Research Paper on Knowledge Graphs for Real-World Security Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The realm of cybersecurity is riddled with intricate and ever-evolving cyber-attack activities, presenting formidable obstacles to cybersecurity professionals. By incorporating knowledge graphs into this field, one may help with threat identification and situational awareness by visualizing the intricate cybersecurity landscape. But creating these knowledge graphs might add noise and conflicts, which could result in incorrect conclusions. The goal of this work is to address the difficulties involved in creating and assessing cybersecurity knowledge graphs. To offer a more flexible framework appropriate for different data properties, we improved the current cybersecurity ontology and put together a cybersecurity knowledge graph dataset (CS13K). The cybersecurity knowledge graph is made with Neo4j. In addition, we developed an AttTucker model to evaluate knowledge graph quality, which is based on Transformer architecture. In order to reduce the dimensionality of knowledge embeddings and capture latent links among entities and relations, this model uses multiple self-attention heads, producing assessment results that are similar to those of higher dimensionally embedding. Additionally, in the AttTucker model-based evaluation procedure, we incorporated path-level data from knowledge graph entities. Our method significantly improves F1 value and accuracy, surpassing current models in knowledge graph quality evaluation tasks, according to an experimental investigation using cybersecurity and general datasets.

articleTitle: ConvAE-512: Bandwidth-Efficient Image Compression in Edge with Auto-Encoders
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)

authors.preferredName: Murukuri S V S V Vasanth

abstract: The exponential growth in data creation and transmission, particularly high-resolution images, poses a significant challenge to network bandwidth, necessitating advanced compression techniques. This paper introduces ConvAE-512, a novel convolutional neural network-based encoder-decoder architecture optimized for edge computing environments. Our approach significantly outperforms existing lossy compression algorithms in image fidelity while efficiently reducing data transmission size and network utilization. ConvAE-512 achieves a compression rate of 6x, outperforming traditional Direct Compression with a higher Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) of 0.9150 and a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) of 27.15 dB, underscoring its efficiency in preserving image quality despite compression. These results establish ConvAE-512 as an advanced alternative for efficient image compression, adeptly balancing quality retention and compression ratio.

articleTitle: Smart Cane for the Visually Impaired Using FPGA Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel smart cane for visually impaired users, leveraging a Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) to enhance mobility and safety. The cane utilizes an ultrasonic sensor for obstacle detection and distance measurement. Real-time feedback is provided through an auditory alert system. As an object approaches, a vibration motor will get activated with increasing frequency, creating intuitive proximity cues. Furthermore, to improve user visibility in low-light environments, a Light Dependent Resistor (LDR) automatically triggers an LED, alerting others to the user's presence. A 7-segment display provides a visual representation of the distance to obstacles. The FPGA serves as the central processing unit, enabling real-time data processing and customization of the cane's functionality to cater to individual user preferences. This integrated and cost-effective solution promotes increased situational awareness and improved navigation, highlighting the potential of advanced assistive technologies to empower visually impaired individuals and enhance their quality of life.

articleTitle: Investigating the performance of Machine Learning algorithms over SMOTE and ADASYN oversampling techniques in Darknet Traffic Classifier System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: The clandestine nature of darknet activities has presented an escalating challenge to cybersecurity efforts, necessitating sophisticated methods for identifying patterns in the classification of network traffic associated with these covert operations. One of the most significant challenges in this domain is the inherent class imbalance within Darknet traffic datasets. The malicious traffic, which is often the target of interest, constitutes a minority of the overall data. This imbalance hampers the ability of machine learning algorithms to effectively discriminate between normal and malicious network behavior, leading to a high rate of false negatives and missed threats. Boosting algorithms, such as AdaBoost and Gradient Boosting, coupled with decision trees, offer a formidable combination for effective network traffic classification. The proposed system introduces a novel approach to address this challenge by proposing the development of a multistage machine learning classifier. The classifier, leveraging the synergies between decision trees and boosting algorithms, aims to significantly improve the performance of analysis on the darknet network traffic. To address this issue, this research explores the application of Oversampling techniques namely, Synthetic Minority Oversampling (SMOTE) and Adaptive Synthetic Sampling (ADASYN) for the elimination of the class imbalance issue in the classification of Darknet traffic.

articleTitle: Optimized Control of Indirect Matrix Converter Under Unbalanced Voltage Conditions: 3DOF-TFOPIDN-FOPDN With EGOA
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asian Conference on Innovation in Technology (ASIANCON)
abstract: To enhance an inverse matrix converter's functionality (IMC) in situations with imbalanced voltage, a novel control method is presented in this study. The IMC operation is driven by dual objectives: improving the power quality by attaining sinusoidal load currents and fine-tuning the input power factor for enhanced efficiency. The proposed approach utilizes three degrees of freedom cascade controller with a derivative filter and tilting mechanism (3DOF-TFOPIDN-FOPDN) technique. By incorporating tilt control, the FOPIDN controller can effectively dampen oscillations and bring the system to a steady state more quickly and smoothly. By cascading FOPDN with a 3DOF TFOPIDN controller, the control accuracy can be improved, allowing for better tracking of desired setpoints. Moreover, the FOPDN controller provides an additional degree of freedom for controlling the system dynamics. To determine the optimal gains for the 3DOF-TFOPIDN-FOPDN control, an advanced optimization algorithm known as the Enhanced Gazelle Optimization Algorithm (EGOA) is utilized. This step ensures that the control parameters are finely tuned, contributing to the overall efficiency of the IMC system. The experimental results indicate a superior transient response characterized by reduced settling time (0.201 sec) and rise time (0.034 sec), with no overshoot. Furthermore, the EGOA demonstrates rapid convergence in comparison to currently employed optimization algorithms.
